IAO_0000115: A type of monocyte characterized by low expression of CCR2, low responsiveness to monocyte chemoattractant CCL2/MCP1, low phagocytic activity, and decrease size relative to classical monocytes, but increased co-stimulatory activity. May also play a role in tissue repair.

LABEL: splenic white pulp macrophage
IAO_0000115: A splenic macrophage found in the white pulp of the spleen. Markers include F4/80-negative, CD68-positive, and macrosialin-positive.

LABEL: splenic tingible body macrophage
IAO_0000115: A splenic white pulp macrophage found in and around the germinal centers of the white pulp of the spleen that participates in phagocytosis of apoptotic B cells from the germinal centers. A marker for a cell of this type is Mertk-positive.

LABEL: central nervous system macrophage
hasExactSynonym: CNS macrophage
IAO_0000115: A tissue-resident macrophage found in the central nervous system.

LABEL: meningeal macrophage
hasExactSynonym: subdural leptomeningeal macrophage|subdural meningeal macrophage
IAO_0000115: A border associated macrophage that is part of a meninx. This macrophage type is elongated and amoeboid spindle-shaped with limited mobility. This macrophage is highly phagocytic, expresses scavenger receptors, has dynamic protrusions and extends its processes during inflammation.

LABEL: choroid plexus macrophage
IAO_0000115: A border associated macrophage found at the interface between the blood and the cerebrospinal fluid in the brain. This central nervous system macrophage has a star-like shaped body and expresses scavenger receptors.

LABEL: perivascular macrophage
IAO_0000115: A border associated macrophage that is adjacent to a small blood vessel of a brain. A perivascular macrophage expresses the markers CD14, CD16 and CD163. In homeostatic conditions, this central nervous system macrophage has a non-motile cell body with extending and retracting projections through the blood vessel wall.

LABEL: thymic medullary macrophage
IAO_0000115: A thymic macrophage found in the thymic medulla.

LABEL: thymic cortical macrophage
IAO_0000115: A thymic macrophage found in the thymic cortex.

LABEL: mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage
IAO_0000115: A tissue-resident macrophage found in the mucosa associated lymphoid tissue.

LABEL: gut-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage
IAO_0000115: A mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in the mucosa-associated lymphoid tissues of the gut.

LABEL: nasal and broncial associated lymphoid tissue macrophage
IAO_0000115: A mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in the nasal and bronchial mucosa-associated lymphoid tissues.

LABEL: lymph node subcapsular sinus macrophage
IAO_0000115: A lymph node macrophage found in the subcapsular sinus of lymph nodes that participates in sensing, clearance, and antigen presentation of lymph-borne particulate antigens. This macrophage is capable of activating invaraint NKT cells and is CD169-positive.

LABEL: lymph node tingible body macrophage
IAO_0000115: A lymph node macrophage found in the cortex of lymph nodes, in particular in and around the germinal centers, and that participates in phagocytosis of apoptotic B cells from the germinal centers.

LABEL: myeloid suppressor cell
IAO_0000115: An immature myeloid leukocyte of heterogeneous phenotype found particularly in cancer and sepsis patients that is capable of suppressing activity of T cells in ex vivo assays. This cell type is CD45-positive, CD11b-positive.

LABEL: M2 macrophage
hasExactSynonym: alternatively activated macrophage
IAO_0000115: An elicited macrophage characterized by low production of pro-inflammatory and Th1 polarizing cytokines and high expression of arginase-1, and associated with tissue remodelling.

LABEL: thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: thymic lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: An immature T cell located in the thymus.

LABEL: DN1 thymic pro-T cell
hasExactSynonym: DN1 thymic pro-T lymphocyte|DN1 thymic pro-T-cell|DN1 thymic pro-T-lymphocyte|DN1 thymic progenitor T cell|DN1 thymocyte|double negative 1|preT.DN1.Th
IAO_0000115: A pro-T cell that has the phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-positive, and CD25-negative.

LABEL: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: T.4Nve.Sp|Th0|naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: An antigen inexperienced CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive and CD62L-positive. This cell type develops in the thymus. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high, and CD44-low.

LABEL: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A recently activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, and CD25-positive.

LABEL: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
hasExactSynonym: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte|CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T-cell|CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has differentiated into a memory T cell.

LABEL: naive T cell
hasExactSynonym: naive T lymphocyte|naive T-cell|naive T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: Mature T cell not yet exposed to antigen with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD45RA-positive, and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high and CD44-low.

LABEL: T-helper 17 cell
hasExactSynonym: IL-17-producing CD4+ T helper|T helper cells type 17|T(H)-17 cell|Th17 CD4+ T cell|Th17 T cell|Th17 T lymphocyte|Th17 T-cell|Th17 T-lymphocyte|Th17 cell|helper T cell type 17
IAO_0000115: CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype RORgamma-t-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-positive, and capable of producing IL-17.

LABEL: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: naive thymus-dervied CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|naive thymus-dervied CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|naive thymus-dervied CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has not experienced activation via antigen contact and has the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CCR7-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high and CD44-low.

LABEL: Tr1 cell
hasExactSynonym: T-regulatory T cell type 1|Tr1 T cell|Tr1 T lymphocyte|Tr1 T-cell|Tr1 T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell with regulatory function that produces IL-10.

LABEL: induced T-regulatory cell
hasExactSynonym: iTreg|induced Treg|induced regulatory T cell|induced regulatory T lymphocyte|induced regulatory T-cell|induced regulatory T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD25-positive, CTLA-4-positive, and FoxP3-positive with regulatory function.

LABEL: natural T-regulatory cell
hasExactSynonym: nTreg|natural Treg|natural regulatory T cell|natural regulatory T lymphocyte|natural regulatory T-cell|natural regulatory T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype FoxP3-positive, CD25-positive, CD62L-positive, and CTLA-4 positive with regulatory function.

LABEL: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: central CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell|central CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte|central CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T-cell|central CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T-lymphocyte|central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.

LABEL: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell|effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte|effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T-cell|effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T-lymphocyte|effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.

LABEL: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, CD25-positive, and CCR7-negative.

LABEL: central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: central CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell|central CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte|central CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T-cell|central CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T-lymphocyte|central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.

LABEL: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T cell
hasExactSynonym: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T lymphocyte|CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T-cell|CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, and CD25-positive, that secretes cytokines.

LABEL: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
hasExactSynonym: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte|CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T-cell|CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has differentiated into a memory T cell.

LABEL: cytotoxic T cell
hasExactSynonym: cytotoxic T lymphocyte|cytotoxic T-cell|cytotoxic T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A mature T cell that differentiated and acquired cytotoxic function with the phenotype perforin-positive and granzyme-B positive.

LABEL: effector T cell
hasExactSynonym: effector T lymphocyte|effector T-cell|effector T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A differentiated T cell with ability to traffic to peripheral tissues and is capable of mounting a specific immune response.

LABEL: helper T cell
hasExactSynonym: T-helper cell|helper T lymphocyte|helper T-cell|helper T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A effector T cell that provides help in the form of secreted cytokines to other immune cells.

LABEL: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
hasExactSynonym: effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell|effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte|effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T-cell|effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T-lymphocyte|effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte|effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-cell|effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.

LABEL: immature NK T cell
hasExactSynonym: immature NK T lymphocyte|immature NK T-cell|immature NK T-lymphocyte|immature NKT cell
IAO_0000115: An immature alpha-beta T-cell that express Egr2. These cells give rise to T cells expressing NK markers.

LABEL: CD8-alpha-alpha-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell

IAO_0000115: A type I NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma and interleukin-4, and has phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD69-positive, and downregulated NK markers.

hasExactSynonym: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell secreting IFN-gamma|CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma|CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-cell secreting interferon-gamma|CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma|CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NKT cell secreting interferon-gamma
IAO_0000115: A mature NK T cell that secretes interferon-gamma and enhances Th1 immune responses.

IAO_0000115: A type II NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma and interleukin-4, and has the phenotype CD69-positive and downregulated NK markers.

IAO_0000115: A type II NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma, and has the phenotype CD69-positive and downregulated NK markers.

hasExactSynonym: type II NK T cell secreting IL-4|type II NK T lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4|type II NK T-cell secreting interleukin-4|type II NK T-lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4|type II NKT cell secreting interleukin-4
IAO_0000115: A type II NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interleukin-4, and has the phenotype CD69-positive and downregulated NK markers.

IAO_0000115: A class switched memory B cell that expresses IgE on the cell surface.

LABEL: IgD plasmablast

LABEL: IgE plasmablast
IAO_0000115: A plasmablast that secretes IgE.

LABEL: IgE short lived plasma cell
IAO_0000115: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgE.

LABEL: preBCR-positive large pre-B-II cell
IAO_0000115: An preBRC-positive large pre-B-II cell is a large pre-B-II cell that is pre-B cell receptor-positive, composed of surrogate light chain protein (SL), which is composed of VpreB , Lambda 5/14.1, in complex with immunoglobulin mu heavy chain (IgHmu) on the cell surface.

LABEL: preBCR-negative large pre-B-II cell
IAO_0000115: A pre-BCR-negative large pre-B-II cell is a large pre-B-II cell that is pre-B cell receptor-negative, composed of surrogate light chain protein (SL), which is composed of VpreB and Lambda 5/14.1, in complex with immunoglobulin mu heavy chain (IgHmu), on the cell surface, and lack a DNA rearrangement of immunoglobulin light chain genes.

LABEL: small pre-B-II cell
hasExactSynonym: small pre-BII cell
IAO_0000115: A small pre-B-II cell is a pre-B-II cell that is Rag1-positive, Rag2-positive, pre-BCR-negative, and BCR-negative, is not proliferating, and carries a DNA rearrangement of one or more immunoglobulin light chain genes.

LABEL: pre-B-II cell
hasExactSynonym: pre-B-lymphocyte|pre-BII cell
IAO_0000115: A pre-B-II cell is a precursor B cell that expresses immunoglobulin mu heavy chain (IgHmu+), and lack expression of CD34, TdT, immunoglobulin kappa light chain and immunoglobulin lambda light chain.

LABEL: pre-B-I cell
hasExactSynonym: pre-BI cell
IAO_0000115: A pre-B-I cell is a precursor B cell that expresses CD34 and surrogate immunoglobulin light chain (VpreB , Lambda 5 (mouse)/14.1 (human)) on the cell surface, and TdT, Rag1,and Rag2 intracellularly. hasExactSynonym: large pre-BII cell

hasExactSynonym: T1 B lymphocyte|T1 B-cell|T1 B-lymphocyte|transitional stage 1 B cell

LABEL: T2 B cell
hasExactSynonym: T2 B lymphocyte|T2 B-cell|T2 B-lymphocyte|transitional stage 2 B cell

hasExactSynonym: An1 B cell|T3 B lymphocyte|T3 B-cell|T3 B-lymphocyte|transitional stage 3 B cell
IAO_0000115: A transitional stage B cell that expresses surface IgM and IgD, and CD62L. This cell type has also been described as IgM-low, CD19-positive, B220-positive, AA4-positive, and CD23-positive (i.e. this cell-type is distinguished from T2 cells by surface expression of IgM).

LABEL: Bm1 B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm1 B lymphocyte|Bm1 B-cell|Bm1 B-lymphocyte

LABEL: Bm2 B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm2 B lymphocyte|Bm2 B-cell|Bm2 B-lymphocyte

LABEL: Bm3-delta B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm3-delta B lymphocyte|Bm3-delta B-cell|Bm3-delta B-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A germinal center B cell that develops from a Bm3 B cell. This cell has the phenotype IgM-negative, IgD-positive, and CD38-positive.

LABEL: Bm2' B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm2' B lymphocyte|Bm2' B-cell|Bm2-prime B cell|Bm2-prime B-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A germinal center B cell that founds a germinal center, and has the phenotype IgD-positive, CD38-positive, and CD23-negative.

LABEL: Bm3 B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm3 B lymphocyte|Bm3 B-cell|Bm3 B-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A germinal center B cell that is rapidly dividing and has the phenotype IgD-negative, CD38-positive, and CD77-positive. Somatic hypermutation of the immunoglobulin V gene region can occur during proliferation of this cell type.

LABEL: Bm4 B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm4 B lymphocyte|Bm4 B-cell|Bm4 B-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A germinal center B cell that has the phenotype CD77-negative, IgD-negative, and CD38-positive. These cells have undergone somatic mutation of the B cell receptor.

LABEL: Bm5 B cell
hasExactSynonym: Bm5 B lymphocyte|Bm5 B-cell|Bm5 B-lymphocyte

hasExactSynonym: class switched memory B lymphocyte|class switched memory B-cell|class switched memory B-lymphocyte

hasExactSynonym: IgA memory B lymphocyte|IgA memory B-cell|IgA memory B-lymphocyte|memory IgA B cell|memory IgA B lymphocyte|memory IgA B-cell|memory IgA B-lymphocyte
IAO_0000115: A class switched memory B cell that expresses IgA.

LABEL: short lived plasma cell
IAO_0000115: A fully differentiated plasma cell that lives for months.

LABEL: IgG short lived plasma cell
IAO_0000115: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgG.

LABEL: IgM short lived plasma cell
IAO_0000115: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgM.

IAO_0000115: A fully differentiated plasma cell that secretes IgM.

IAO_0000115: A fully differentiated plasma cell that secretes IgA.

mature CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell

hasExactSynonym: DC.8+
IAO_0000115: CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-negative, CD4-negative and is CD205-positive and CD8-alpha-positive.

LABEL: immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
IAO_0000115: Immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

IAO_0000115: Mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

IAO_0000115: Mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

IAO_0000115: Immature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

IAO_0000115: Mature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

IAO_0000115: A B220-positive CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-positive, and IgG-negative.

LABEL: B220-low CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
IAO_0000115: A B220-low CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype B220-low, CD38-positive, and IgG-positive.

LABEL: CD27-positive gamma-delta T cell
hasExactSynonym: gammadelta27-positive|gd27-positive
IAO_0000115: A circulating gamma-delta T cell that is CD27-positive and capable of producing IFN-gamma.

LABEL: CD27-negative gamma-delta T cell
hasExactSynonym: gammadelta-17 cells
IAO_0000115: A circulating gamma-delta T cell that expresses RORgamma(t), is CD27-negative and is capable of IL-17 secretion.

LABEL: CD25-positive, CD27-positive immature gamma-delta T cell
IAO_0000115: A CD25-positive, CD27-positive immature gamma-delta T cell found in the thymus that has an immature phenotype (i.e. CD24-high, CD25-high, CD62L-high, CD44-high, CD2-low, CD5-low).

LABEL: innate effector T cell
IAO_0000115: A T cell with a receptor of limited diversity that is capable of immediate effector functions upon stimulation.

LABEL: Tc17 cell
hasExactSynonym: CD8-positive Th17 cell|Tc17 CD8+ T cell|Tc17 T cell|Tc17 T lymphocyte|Tc17 T-cell|Tc17 T-lymphocyte|Th17 CD8-positive T cell|Th17 non-TFH CD8-positive T cell
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has the phenotype CXCR3-negative, CCR6-positive, CCR5-high, CD45RA-negative, and capable of producing IL-17 and some IFNg.

LABEL: endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel
hasExactSynonym: LEC|lymphatic endothelial cell
IAO_0000115: A endothelial cell of a lymphatic vessel. The border of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell of initial lymphatics are joined by specialized buttons. The discontinuous feature of buttons distinguishes them from zippers in collecting lymphatics, but both types of junctions are composed of proteins typical of adherens junctions and tight junctions found in the endothelium of blood vessels. Buttons seal the sides of flaps of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell, leaving open the tips of flaps as routes for fluid entry without disassembly and reformation of intercellular junctions.

LABEL: capillary endothelial cell
IAO_0000115: An endothelial cell found in capillaries.

LABEL: epithelioid macrophage
hasExactSynonym: epithelioid histocyte|epitheloid macrophage
IAO_0000115: Epithelioid macrophage is an activated macrophage that resembles an epithelial cell with finely granular, pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and central, ovoid nucleus (oval or elongate). This cell type is able to merge into one another to form aggregates. The presence of such aggregates may characterize some pathologic conditions, mainly granulomatous inflammation.

LABEL: late promyelocyte
IAO_0000115: A promyelocyte that is considerably smaller, with more condensed chromatin, and nucleoli are no longer conspicuous.

LABEL: early promyelocyte
IAO_0000115: A promyelocyte with a nucleus that is indented and contains more marginated heterochromatin compared to its precursor cell (myeloblast); cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains numerous mitochondria and meandering cysternae of endoplasmic reticulum; largest of the granulocyte lineages.

LABEL: echinocyte
hasExactSynonym: burr cell
IAO_0000115: A crenated erythrocyte with 30+ crenations, bumps or spurs that are the result of damage due to age or disease.

LABEL: basal cell of epidermis
hasExactSynonym: epidermal basal cell|epidermal basal keratinocyte
IAO_0000115: A mitotically active, columnar-shaped keratinocyte located in the stratum basale of the epidermis and attached to the basement membrane. This cell exhibits heterogeneity, encompassing stem and progenitor subpopulations with distinct molecular and proliferative characteristics (Haensel et al., 2020), and serves as the primary source of new keratinocytes for epidermal renewal, homeostasis, and regeneration.

LABEL: glomerular endothelial cell
IAO_0000115: An endothelial cell that is part of the glomerulus of the kidney. This cell is flattened, highly fenestrated, and plays a vital role in the formation of glomerular ultrafiltrate.

LABEL: granulocytopoietic cell
IAO_0000115: A cell involved in the formation of a granulocyte.

LABEL: metamyelocyte
IAO_0000115: A eosinophil precursor in the granulocytic series, being a cell intermediate in development between a myelocyte and a band form cell. The nucleus becomes indented where the indentation is smaller than half the distance to the farthest nuclear margin; chromatin becomes coarse and clumped; specific granules predominate while primary granules are rare.

LABEL: myelocyte
IAO_0000115: A cell type that is the first of the maturation stages of the granulocytic leukocytes normally found in the bone marrow. Granules are seen in the cytoplasm. The nuclear material of the myelocyte is denser than that of the myeloblast but lacks a definable membrane. The cell is flat and contains increasing numbers of granules as maturation progresses.

LABEL: monopoietic cell
IAO_0000115: A cell involved in the formation of a monocyte (monopoiesis).

LABEL: renal beta-intercalated cell
hasExactSynonym: type B intercalated cell|type B-IC
IAO_0000115: A renal intercalated cell that secretes base and reabsorbs acid in the distal segments of the kidney tubule to maintain acid/base balance.

LABEL: tuft cell
hasExactSynonym: brush cell|caveolated cell|fibrillovesicular cell|multivesicular cell|peculiar cell
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell found in various organs, including the gastrointestinal and respiratory tracts, characterized by a tuft of 120-140 blunt microvilli on its apical surface. This cell exhibits diverse functions depending on its location, which includes chemosensation, initiation of immune responses, contribution to mucociliary clearance, and defense against parasites.

LABEL: intermediate trophoblast cell
IAO_0000115: A trophoblast that leaves the placenta and invades the endometrium and myometrium. This cell type is crucial in increasing blood flow to the fetus.

LABEL: immature dendritic epithelial T cell precursor
hasExactSynonym: immature DEC precursor|immature DETC precursor
IAO_0000115: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that has as part a Vgamma3 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus with highest numbers occurring at E17-E18.

LABEL: epithelial cell of prostate
hasExactSynonym: prostate epithelial cell
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the prostate.

LABEL: peripheral blood stem cell
hasExactSynonym: PBSC
IAO_0000115: A hematopoeitic stem cell found in the blood. Normally found in very limited numbers in the peripheral circulation (less than 0.1% of all nucleated cells).

LABEL: pleural macrophage
IAO_0000115: A tissue macrophage that is in the pleural space.

LABEL: pluripotent stem cell
IAO_0000115: A pluripotent stem cell has the ability to form cells from all three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm). However, unlike totipotent stem cells, they cell can not generate all the cells of the whole organism such as placenta.

LABEL: epithelial cell of large intestine
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the lining of the large intestine.

LABEL: pancreatic PP cell
hasExactSynonym: PP cell of pancreatic islet|PP-cell of pancreatic islet|pancreatic polypeptide-secreting cell
IAO_0000115: A PP cell located in the islets of the pancreas.

LABEL: epithelial cell of thymus
hasExactSynonym: epithelial cell of thymus gland|epithelial reticular cell|epithelial reticular cell of thymus|thymic epithelial cell
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the thymus. Epithelial reticular cells are pleomorphic, stellate, non-phagocytic cells which seem to be supportive in function and are held together by desmosomes. They replace the fibroblastoid reticular cells found in other lymphoid organs. Other epithelial cells in the medulla have the ultrastructure of secretory cells. Although different epithelial cells throughout the thymus appear alike by light microscopy their ultrastructure and function varies.

LABEL: somatotroph
hasExactSynonym: somatotrope|somatotropic cell|somatrophic cell
IAO_0000115: An acidophilic cell of the anterior pituitary that produces growth hormone, somatotropin.

LABEL: peripheral blood mesothelial cell
IAO_0000115: A mesothelial cell capable of circulating in the blood by first losing its squamous character. This cell can incorporate into the regenerating mesothelium.

LABEL: neural cell
IAO_0000115: A cell that is part of the nervous system.

LABEL: embryonic cell (metazoa)
IAO_0000115: A cell of the embryo.

LABEL: embryonic stem cell
hasExactSynonym: ESC
IAO_0000115: A stem cell of embryonic origin.

LABEL: mammary gland epithelial cell
hasExactSynonym: breast epithelial cell|mammary epithelial cell
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the mammary gland.

LABEL: bronchial epithelial cell
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the bronchus.

LABEL: preadipocyte
IAO_0000115: An undifferentiated fibroblast that can be stimulated to form a fat cell.

LABEL: CD56-positive, CD161-positive immature natural killer cell, human
IAO_0000115: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature, has the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive, CD122-positive,and CD161-positive.

LABEL: circulating endothelial cell
IAO_0000115: A circulating endothelial cell of the phenotype CD146-positive, CD105-positive, CD45-negative. This cell type is indicative of recent vascular damage.

LABEL: decidual natural killer cell, human
hasExactSynonym: dNK cell|decidual NK cell
IAO_0000115: A natural killer cell subset that is found in the decidual of the uterus and is CD56-high, Galectin-1-positive and CD16-negative. This cell type represents the most abundant immune cell type in the decidual during the first trimester of pregnancy.

LABEL: CD56-negative, CD161-positive immature natural killer cell, human
IAO_0000115: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature, has the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-negative, CD117-positive, CD122-positive,and CD161-positive.

LABEL: CD27-low, CD11b-low immature natural killer cell, mouse
IAO_0000115: An immature natural killer cell that is NK1.1-positive, DX5-positive, Ly49-positive, CD27-low and CD11b-low. This cell type is found in high numbers in the liver.

LABEL: Dx5-negative, NK1.1-positive immature natural killer cell, mouse
IAO_0000115: An immature natural killer cell that is NK1.1-positive and DX-5 negative.

LABEL: CD27-high, CD11b-high natural killer cell, mouse
IAO_0000115: A mature natural killer cell that is CD27-high and CD11b-high. This cell type is capable of interferon-gamma secretion.

LABEL: CD27-low, CD11b-high natural killer cell, mouse
IAO_0000115: A CD27-low, CD11b-high natural killer cell that has a higher threshold of activation due to higher expression of inhibitory receptors.

LABEL: CD27-high, CD11b-low natural killer cell, mouse
IAO_0000115: A natural killer cell that is CD27-high and CD11b-low.

LABEL: progenitor cell of endocrine pancreas
hasExactSynonym: pancreatic endocrine progenitor|pancreatic islet progenitor cell
IAO_0000115: A progenitor cell that is able to differentiate into the pancreas alpha, beta and delta endocrine cells. This cell type expresses neurogenin-3 and Isl-1.

LABEL: gestational hematopoietic stem cell
IAO_0000115: A hematopoietic stem cell that exists during embryogenesis.

LABEL: fetal liver hematopoietic progenitor cell
IAO_0000115: A hematopoietic stem cell that resides in the fetal liver. In mice, this cell type is first observed at E10.5. This cell type is MHC-positive, HSA-positive, AA4.1-positive, CD45-positive, Sca-1 positive, CD150-positive, CD48-negative and CD244-negative.

LABEL: yolk sac hematopoietic stem cell
hasExactSynonym: hemangioblast precursor
IAO_0000115: A hematopoietic stem found in the yolk sac. In mice, this cell type is Sca-1-negative, CD45-negative, MHC-negative, HSA-positive, AA4.1-positive, CD44-positive.

LABEL: primitive red blood cell
hasExactSynonym: primitive erythroblast|primitive erythrocyte|primitive erythroid cell
IAO_0000115: A large nucleated basophilic erythrocyte found in mammalian embryos. This cell type arises from the blood islands of yolk sacs and expresses different types of hemoglobins (beta-H1, gamma-1 and zeta) than adult erythrocytes. Considered a type of erythroblast as this cell type can enucleate in circulation.

LABEL: primitive reticulocyte
hasExactSynonym: megalocyte
IAO_0000115: A primitive erythrocyte that has undergone enucleation. This cell type is 3-6 fold bigger than the fetal derived erythrocytes that they co-circulate with during fetal development. Expresses epsilon-gamma hemoglobin chains.

LABEL: fetal derived definitive erythrocyte
hasExactSynonym: macrocyte
IAO_0000115: A fetal liver derived enucleated erythrocyte. This erythrocyte resembles adult erythrocytes in that they are small (3- to 6- times smaller than primitive erythrocytes) and produce adult hemaglobins.

LABEL: pyrenocyte
IAO_0000115: Derived from the Greek word pyren (the pit of a stone fruit), this is a transient nucleated cell type that results from exclusion of the nucleus from the primitive erythrocyte.

LABEL: placental hematopoietic stem cell
IAO_0000115: A hematopoietic stem cell of the placenta. This cell type is first observed E10.5 This cell type may give rise to fetal liver hematopoietic stem cells.

LABEL: AGM hematopoietic stem cell
IAO_0000115: A hematopoietic stem cell from the aorta-gonad-mesonephros region of the developing embryo. First seen at E10.5 in mouse embryos. May give rise to fetal liver HSC.

LABEL: primitive erythroid progenitor
hasExactSynonym: EryP-CFC|inner blood island hemangioblast
IAO_0000115: A progenitor cell that is capable of forming colonies of primitive erythrocytes in the blood island of the yolk sac. First arrive at E7.5 in mouse and expresses CD41.

LABEL: keratocyte
hasExactSynonym: corneal fibroblast|corneal keratocyte
IAO_0000115: A keratocyte is a specialized fibroblast?residing in the cornea stroma that has a flattened, dendritic morphology; located between the lamellae with a large flattened nucleus, and lengthy processes which communicate with neighboring cells. This?corneal?layer, representing about 85-90% of corneal thickness, is built up from highly regular collagenous lamellae and extracellular matrix components. Keratocytes play the major role in keeping it transparent, healing its wounds, and synthesizing its components. This cell type secretes collagen I, V, VI, and keratan sulfate.

LABEL: cortical thymic epithelial cell
hasExactSynonym: cTEC
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the cortical portion of the thymus. Epithelial cells in this region are required for positive selection of CD8-positive T cells.

LABEL: medullary thymic epithelial cell
hasExactSynonym: mTEC
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the medullary thymus. This cell type expresses a diverse range of tissue-specific antigens. This promiscuous gene expression is a cell-autonomous property of medullary epithelial cells and is maintained during the entire period of thymic T cell output.

LABEL: respiratory tract epithelial cell
hasExactSynonym: airway epithelial cell|respiratory epithelial cell
IAO_0000115: An epithelial cell of the respiratory tract epithelium.  These cells have an endodermal origin.

LABEL: respiratory tract goblet cell
hasExactSynonym: respiratory goblet cell|respiratory mucosa goblet cells
IAO_0000115: A simple columnar epithelial cell that secretes mucin. Rough endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria, the nucleus, and other organelles are concentrated in the basal portion. The apical plasma membrane projects microvilli to increase surface area for secretion.

LABEL: obsolete somatic cell
IAO_0000115: OBSOLETE. A cell of an organism that does not pass on its genetic material to the organism's offspring (i.e. a non-germ line cell).

LABEL: immature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive and is found in the fetal thymus.

LABEL: intermediate monocyte
IAO_0000115: A monocyte that has characteristics of both patrolling and inflammatory monocytes.

LABEL: CD141-positive myeloid dendritic cell
IAO_0000115: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood, lymph nodes, tonsil, bone marrow, and spleen that is CD141-positive (BDCA-3), XCR1-positive, and Clec9A-positive. This cell-type can cross-present antigen to CD8-positive T cells and can produce inteferon-beta.

LABEL: Gr1-high classical monocyte
IAO_0000115: A resident monocyte that is Gr-1 high, CD43-negative, CX3CR1-negative, CD115-positive, and B220-negative.

LABEL: CD14-low, CD16-positive monocyte
hasExactSynonym: non-classical monocyte, human
IAO_0000115: A patrolling monocyte that is CD14-low and CD16-positive.

LABEL: CD14-positive, CD16-positive monocyte
hasExactSynonym: CD16+ monocyte
IAO_0000115: A CD14-positive monocyte that is also CD16-positive and CCR2-negative.

LABEL: Gr1-positive, CD43-positive monocyte
IAO_0000115: An intermediate monocyte that is Gr1-positive, CD43-positive.

LABEL: CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell
IAO_0000115: A myeloid dendritic cell that is CD1c-positive.

LABEL: fraction B/C precursor B cell
IAO_0000115: A precursor B cell that is AA4-positive, IgM-negative, CD19-positive, CD43-positive and HSA-positive.

LABEL: mature dendritic epithelial T cell precursor
hasExactSynonym: mature DEC precursor|mature DETC precursor
IAO_0000115: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that has as part a Vgamma3 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus with highest numbers occurring at E17-E18.

LABEL: Peyer's patch B cell
hasExactSynonym: Peyers patch B cell
IAO_0000115: A resting mature B cell within the Peyer's patch that is CD19-positive, B220-positive, IgM-positive, AA4-negative, CD23-positive, CD43-negative, and CD5-negative.

LABEL: mature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: fetal Vgamma2-positive
IAO_0000115: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus.

LABEL: fetal thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A thymocyte found in the fetal thymus.

LABEL: gamma-delta thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: gammadelta thymocyte|gd thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A post-natal thymocyte expressing components of the gamma-delta T cell receptor. This cell type is always double-negative (i.e. CD4-negative, CD8-negative).

LABEL: immature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

LABEL: mature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: Vgamma2-positive
IAO_0000115: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

LABEL: immature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

LABEL: mature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: Vgamma2-negative
IAO_0000115: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain the Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

LABEL: pancreatic stellate cell
hasExactSynonym: PaSC|pancreas stellate cell
IAO_0000115: A cell that is found in the periacinar space of the exocrine pancreas and in perivascular and periductal regions of the pancreas, and has long cytoplasmic processes that encircle the base of the acinus. Expresses several intermediate filament proteins including vimentin and nestin. Shares many of the characteristics of hepatatic stellate cells, but not stellate cells of the central nervous system. Upon activation, this cell type undergoes morphological and gene expression changes that make the cell suggestive of being a type of myofibroblast.

LABEL: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: Vg1.1-positive, Vd6.3-negative T cell
IAO_0000115: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1 but does not express Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

LABEL: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: Vg1.1+Vd6.3+ T cell
IAO_0000115: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1-Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

LABEL: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

LABEL: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

LABEL: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: immature Vg1.1+Vd6.3+ T cell
IAO_0000115: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

LABEL: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: mature Vg1.1+Vd6.3+ T cell
IAO_0000115: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

LABEL: primitive erythroid lineage cell
IAO_0000115: An immature or mature cell of the first erythroid lineage to arise during embryonic development.

LABEL: mature T cell
hasExactSynonym: CD3e-positive T cell|mature T-cell
IAO_0000115: A T cell that expresses a T cell receptor complex and has completed T cell selection.

LABEL: immature T cell
hasExactSynonym: immature T-cell
IAO_0000115: A T cell that has not completed T cell selection.

LABEL: nucleated reticulocyte
IAO_0000115: A reticulocyte that retains the nucleus and other organelles. Found in birds, fish, amphibians and reptiles.

LABEL: enucleated reticulocyte
IAO_0000115: A reticulocyte lacking a nucleus and showing a basophilic reticulum under vital staining due to the presence of ribosomes.

LABEL: DN2a thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-hi.

LABEL: DN2b thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-low.

LABEL: early T lineage precursor
hasExactSynonym: ETP|preT.ETP.Th
IAO_0000115: A pro-T cell that is lin-negative, CD25-negative, CD127-negative, CD44-positive and kit-positive.

LABEL: CD11b-positive, CD27-positive natural killer cell, mouse
IAO_0000115: A mature natural killer cell that is CD11b-positive and CD27-positive.

LABEL: resting double-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.DP.sm.Th
IAO_0000115: A double-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte that is small and not proliferating.

LABEL: double-positive blast
hasExactSynonym: T.DPb.Th|activated double-positive thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A double-positive thymocyte that is large (i.e. has a high forward scatter signal in flow cytometry) and is actively proliferating.

LABEL: CD69-positive double-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.DP69+.Th
IAO_0000115: A double-positive thymocyte that is CD69-positive and has begun positive selection.

LABEL: CD4-intermediate, CD8-positive double-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.4int8+.Th|T_4int8+_Th
IAO_0000115: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD4 co-receptor.

LABEL: CD4-positive, CD8-intermediate double-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.4+8int.Th|T_4+8int_Th
IAO_0000115: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD8 co-receptor.

LABEL: CD24-positive, CD4 single-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: CD24-positive, CD4 single-positive semimature thymocyte|T.4SP24int.Th
IAO_0000115: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

LABEL: CD69-positive, CD4-positive single-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.4SP69+.Th|intermediate CD4-single-positive
IAO_0000115: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

LABEL: CD24-positive, CD8 single-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: CD24-positive, CD8 single-positive semimature thymocyte|T.8SP24int.Th
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

LABEL: CD69-positive, CD8-positive single-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.8SP69+.Th|intermediate CD8-single-positive
IAO_0000115: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

LABEL: mature CD4 single-positive thymocyte
IAO_0000115: A mature CD4-positive, CD8-negative alpha-beta T cell found in the thymus that is CD24-low and has high expression of the T cell receptor.

LABEL: mature CD8 single-positive thymocyte
hasExactSynonym: T.8SP24-.Th
IAO_0000115: A mature CD8-positive, CD4-negative alpha-beta T cell found in the thymus that is CD24-low and has high expression of the T cell receptor.

LABEL: NK1.1-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.sp|NK1.1-positive NK cell
IAO_0000115: A mature NK cell that is NK1.1-positive.

LABEL: NKGA2-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.G2A+.SP
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is NKGA2-positive.

LABEL: Ly49D-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.49D+.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-positive.

LABEL: CD94-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.94+.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive.

LABEL: CD94-negative, Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: CD94- Ly49I-negative NK cell|NK.49Cl-94-.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative and Ly49Cl-negative.

LABEL: Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: Ly49I-positive NK cell|NK.49Cl+.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-positive.

LABEL: Ly49H-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: LyH49H-positive
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-positive.

LABEL: Ly49D-negative natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.49D-.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-negative.

LABEL: Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: Ly49I-negative NK cell|NK.49Cl-.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-negative.

LABEL: CD94-negative natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.94-.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative.

LABEL: Ly49H-negative natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: LyH49H-negative
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-negative.

LABEL: CD94-positive Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
hasExactSynonym: NK.49Cl+94+.Sp
IAO_0000115: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive and Ly49Cl-positive.

LABEL: mammary stem cell
IAO_0000115: A multi-fate stem cell that is the source of cells for growth of the mammary gland during puberty and gestation. This cell type gives rise to both the luminal and myoepithelial cell types of the gland, and have been shown to have the ability to regenerate the entire organ in mice. This cell type also plays an important role in carcinogenesis of the breast. This cell type is Lin-, CD24-positive, CD29-hi.

LABEL: oligodendrocyte precursor cell
IAO_0000115: A proliferative and migratory glial progenitor cell that derives from a neural stem cell and resides within the central nervous system. Over 20,000 nematode species have been described, most of them are free-living but many are successful parasites of humans, animals, and plants, causing diseases of major socio-economic importance globally.

IAO_0000115: A plant treatment (EO:0001001) involving the application of a biotic or biological factor such as a microbe, insect, animal, or plant or a combination thereof. [database_cross_reference: PO:cooperl][database_cross_reference: GR:pj]

LABEL: polarization microscopy
hasExactSynonym: anisotropy/polarization microscopy|polarized light microscopy
IAO_0000115: A form of light microscopy that uses polarized light. Such form can be used to image samples that exibit optical anisotropy.

LABEL: scanning electron microscopy (SEM)
IAO_0000115: Image is formed by scanning the surface of the specimen with a beam of electrons in a raster pattern

LABEL: atomic force microscopy
IAO_0000115: The scanning probe is maintained at a fixed distance above the surface e of the specimen by van der Waals forces

LABEL: recorded image
IAO_0000115: Methods and devices used for capturing an image of a real object; distinct from images created by artwork

LABEL: scanning probe microscopy
IAO_0000115: Imaging by means of a physical probe that passes over the sample

LABEL: ANSOM
IAO_0000115: Aperture-less NSOM.

LABEL: FLIP
IAO_0000115: Fluorescence loss in photobleaching; a method of determining whether two populations of fluorophore are in diffusive communication with one another by observing the decrease in brightness of one population when the other population is subjected to continuous photobleaching.

LABEL: FRAP
IAO_0000115: Fluorescence loss in photobleaching; a method of determining the rate and extent of exchange between a localized population of fluorophore and a non-localized diffusible pool, by observing the rate of recovery of brightness of the localized population after photobleaching.

LABEL: FRET
IAO_0000115: Fluorescence (or Forster) resonance energy transfer; a method of estimating the distance between two fluorophores by measuring the extent of non-radiative energy transfer between the two. Experimentally, this involves selective excitation of one while observing emission from the other.

LABEL: fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy
hasExactSynonym: FLIM
IAO_0000115: A fluorescence microscopy method in which the image contrast is derived from the fluorescence lifetime at each point in a two-dimensional image and not the local concentration and/or intensity of the fluorophore.

LABEL: selective plane illumination fluorescence microscopy
hasExactSynonym: SPIM|light-sheet fluorescence microscopy|light-sheet microscopy
IAO_0000115: A fluorescence microscopy method where the sample is illuminated from the side in a well-defined volume around the focal plane of the detection optics.

LABEL: coherent Raman anti-Stokes microscopy
hasExactSynonym: CARS microscopy
IAO_0000115: A form of microscopy that can detect molecularly specific contrasts based on the vibrational spectra of the sample molecules, by producing and detecting Raman-scattered photons.

LABEL: OCT
IAO_0000115: Optical coherence tomography; an interferometric method of imaging using back-scattered photons (elastic scattering)

LABEL: secondary_electron imaging
IAO_0000115: Image created using the electrons generated by ionization of a sample due to inelastic scattering of the primary beam of radiation

LABEL: back-scattered_electron imaging
IAO_0000115: Imaged formed using electrons undergoing elastic scattering at very high angles, with emission of characteristic X-rays

LABEL: slit-scan confocal microscopy
IAO_0000115: Illumination and detection via a thin slit

LABEL: array-scan confocal microscopy
IAO_0000115: Fixed array of sources focused to an array of spots that is swept over the specimen in raster fashion

LABEL: serial block face scanning electron microscopy
hasExactSynonym: SBF-SEM
IAO_0000115: A method of reconstructing 3D structure by combining in-situ serial sectioning with scanning EM.

LABEL: fluorescence polarization microscopy
hasExactSynonym: FAIM|fluorescence anisotropy imaging
IAO_0000115: A mode of microscopy that detects the rotational motion of fluorophores.

LABEL: tomography

LABEL: computed tomography
IAO_0000115: Tomography in which virtual sections are taken from multiple angles and the results are processed via tomographic reconstruction software to produce 2 or 3D images.

LABEL: focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy
hasExactSynonym: FIB-SEM|focussed ion beam scanning electron microscopy
IAO_0000115: A method of reconstructing 3D structure by combining focussed ion beam milling to remove sucessive layers from a sample block with scanning EM to image the exposed surface between each milling step.

LABEL: mesectoderm anlage
IAO_0000115: Contiguous region of early embryonic cells of the ectoderm anlage that forms a single-cell border between the anlagen of the mesoderm and ventral ectoderm (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997; Stathopoulos and Newcomb, 2020). As the mesoderm invaginates and the ventral furrow closes, the two rows of cells come together to form the mesectoderm at the ventral midline of the embryo (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997).

LABEL: head mesoderm
hasExactSynonym: hms|procephalic mesoderm
IAO_0000115: Anterior region of mesoderm that forms a vertical plate beside the anterior midgut rudiment (Campos Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997). After its initial ingression during ventral furrow formation, it continues to recruit cells from the surface of the embryo until the end of stage 10 (Campos Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997). It gives rise to the pharyngeal musculature, hemocytes, the corpus cardiacum and the visceral muscle of the esophagus (Campos Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997; de Velasco et al., 2006).

LABEL: posterior spiracle primordium
hasExactSynonym: embryonic posterior spiracle
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the posterior spiracle of the larva. Originates in the posterior half of the lateral ectoderm of abdominal segment 8 during stage 12. A group of cells that are more basophilic that those surrounding them form a deep groove and fuse with the posterior arm of the tracheal primordium of A8 (tracheal metamere 10).

LABEL: anterior endoderm anlage
hasExactSynonym: anterior midgut anlage
IAO_0000115: Region of cells of the early embryo that will invaginate from the anterior ventral embryo during gastrulation to form the anterior part of the endoderm (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997). It is a precursor to the anterior midgut (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997).

LABEL: hindgut proper primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some rectum primordium and some large intestine primordium and some small intestine primordium and some embryonic primordium of adult hindgut precursor. It develops from some inclusive hindgut primordium.

LABEL: Malpighian tubule primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some Malpighian tubule tip cell primordium and some Malpighian tubule main body primordium. It develops from some inclusive hindgut primordium.

LABEL: anterior midgut primordium
IAO_0000115: The primordium that will develop into the anterior midgut of both larva and adult. This forms during stage 8 when anterior endoderm cells, which have invaginated at the anterior end of the ventral furrow, divide and undergo an epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. During stage 9, its cells divide a second time. During stage 10, the primordium attaches to the internal end of the stomodeum and spreads posteriorly with the stomodeal invagination, splitting into two lobes extending on either side of the yolk sac. A separate group of cells fuse with this primordium during stage 11. These cells delaminate from the stomodeum, becoming mesenchymal and mingling with the existing cells of the primordium. Fate mapping suggests that these cells will form the anterior-most part of the midgut, including the gastric caeca (Technau and Campos-Ortega, 1985). Adult midgut progenitors separate from the primordium during late stage 11 and stage 12. The remaining cells reorganize to become epithelial plates which then begin to fuse with the posterior midgut primordium during stage 12, forming the fused midgut primordium.

LABEL: posterior endoderm anlage
hasExactSynonym: posterior midgut anlage
IAO_0000115: Region of cells of the early embryo that will invaginate from the posterior dorsal embryo during gastrulation to form the posterior part of the endoderm (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997). It is a precursor to the posterior midgut (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997).

LABEL: embryonic inner optic lobe primordium
hasExactSynonym: P1 IOA
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the late extended germ band and closure embryo that gives rise to the larval inner optic anlage. It develops from the anterior lip of the visual primordium.

LABEL: embryonic stomatogastric nervous system
IAO_0000115: The stomatogastric system of the embryo.

LABEL: midline glial cell
hasExactSynonym: AMG|MGA|MGM|anterior midline glia|midline glia|ventral midline glia
IAO_0000115: Glial cell that is derived from the mesectoderm (Ito et al., 1995). It is located on or close to the midline of the ventral nerve cord (Ito et al., 1995). At embryonic stage 11, these cells form two populations, an anterior cluster of around 6 cells per neuromere and a posterior cluster of around 4 cells per neuromere (Wheeler et al., 2006). Three of the anterior cells persist into the larval stage, with the rest of the midline glia being lost by apoptosis (Wheeler et al., 2009). In the larva, these cells ensheath the anterior and posterior axon commissures (Ito et al., 1995).

LABEL: embryonic ganglion mother cell
IAO_0000115: Any ganglion mother cell of the embryo.

LABEL: embryonic/larval plasmatocyte
hasExactSynonym: Pl|macrophage|podocyte
IAO_0000115: Hemocyte of the embryo and larva. Relatively large, irregularly shaped hemocyte (Brehelin, 1982). At the end of the third instar larval stage, plasmatocytes contains numerous inclusions, digitations and pinocytotic vesicles, well developed rough endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and small lysosome-like bodies. By the end of the third instar period they also contain numerous phagosomes. Plasmatocytes represent 90-95% of all mature larval hemocytes. They function in the removal of dead cells and microbial pathogens.

LABEL: prothoracic gland
hasExactSynonym: PTG|thoracic gland
IAO_0000115: Component of the larval ring gland that is continuous with the corpus cardiacum at its ventroposterior end, encircles the aorta, and surrounds the medially-located corpus allatum at its dorsoanterior end (Dai and Gilbert, 1991; de Velasco et al., 2004; Nassel and Zandawala, 2020). It is composed of very few cells in the late embryo, but these increase in size and number during larval development (de Velasco et al., 2004). It produces ecdysone and is most active in the early wandering third instar (Dai and Gilbert, 1991; Nassel and Zandawala, 2020). During pupal development, its cells separate, shrink and degenerate and none are found attached to the adult corpus allatum or corpus cardiacum after eclosion (Dai and Gilbert, 1991).

LABEL: imaginal disc
IAO_0000115: A sac shaped epithelial structure in the larva that gives rise to part of the adult integumentary system. One side of the sac consists of peripodial epithelium, the other of columnar epithelium. A single anterior-posterior compartment boundary bisects both peripodial membrane and columnar epithelium. Cells do not cross this boundary during growth and development of the disc.

LABEL: eye-antennal disc
IAO_0000115: Imaginal disc that, in the adults, gives rise to the eye, antenna, head capsule (including all bristles and external membranes) and the maxillary palps (Cohen, 1993).

LABEL: eye disc
IAO_0000115: Anterior, bulbous portion of the eye-antennal disc that gives rise to the eye as well as contributing to the head capsule (Cohen, 1993).

LABEL: prothoracic leg disc
hasExactSynonym: 1st leg disc|T1 leg disc|ventral prothoracic disc
IAO_0000115: Imaginal disc of the ventral prothoracic segment. Precursor of structures of the adult ventral prothorax including the prothoracic (1st) leg.

LABEL: optic nerve
IAO_0000115: Nerve that carries photoreceptor axons to the optic lobe.

LABEL: insulin secreting cell of pars intercerebralis
hasExactSynonym: insulin producing cell of brain|m-NSC DILP
IAO_0000115: Insulin-producing neuron with a cell body in the pars intercerebralis. These cells coexpress the genes Insulin-like peptide (Ilp) 2, Ilp3 and Ilp5 (Reinhard et al., 2024). There are approximately 7-9 of these cells per hemisphere and they fasciculate with the nervus corporis cardiaci (McKim et al., 2024).

LABEL: hindgut anlage
IAO_0000115: A(n) anlage that develops into some inclusive hindgut primordium. It develops from some hindgut anlage in statu nascendi.

LABEL: ventral ectoderm anlage
hasExactSynonym: presumptive neuroectoderm|ventral/neuroectoderm anlage
IAO_0000115: Anlage that develops into the ventral ectoderm. It is found in the lateroventral trunk region of the embryo at the cellular blastoderm stage, prior to gastrulation (Stathopoulos and Newcomb, 2020).

LABEL: capitellum
IAO_0000115: Bulbous, distal-most segment of the haltere.

LABEL: pole plasm
IAO_0000115: Specialized region of the posterior egg/embryo cytoplasm characterized by the presence of non-membrane limited electron dense bodies (polar granules) (Okada, 1998).

LABEL: female accessory gland
hasExactSynonym: appendicular gland|colleterial gland|female AcGl|parovarium
IAO_0000115: Small, bilaterally paired gland that lies caudal to the spermathecae and is connected to the uterus by a duct (McQueen et al., 2022). The gland wall consists of a single layer of secretory cells, each with a large vacuole and a minute acidophilic granule towards the gland lumen (McQueen et al., 2022). It arises from the segment 9 (male genital) primordium in the female genital disc (McQueen et al., 2022).

LABEL: fat body primordium
IAO_0000115: The fat body primordium after the gonadal sheath primordium splits from it during stage 14. By stage 15, the different primordia fuse to form a continuous layer (Hoshizaki et al., 1994). The precursor fat cells it contains continue differentiating until stage 17, when the primordium becomes the fat body proper (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997).

LABEL: circular intestinal visceral muscle fiber
hasExactSynonym: circular visceral muscle fibers
IAO_0000115: Circular fiber of the intestinal visceral muscle.

LABEL: amnioserosa anlage in statu nascendi
hasExactSynonym: Asn amnioser
IAO_0000115: Anlage in statu nascendi of the amnioserosa in a stage 5 embryo that will give rise to the amnioserosa anlage.

LABEL: hindgut anlage in statu nascendi
hasExactSynonym: Asn iHiGP
IAO_0000115: Anlage in statu nascendi of the hindgut in a stage 5 embryo that will give rise to the hindgut anlage.

LABEL: foregut anlage
IAO_0000115: Anlage of the embryonic foregut.

LABEL: hypopharynx anlage
IAO_0000115: A(n) anlage that develops into some hypopharynx inclusive primordium. It develops from some hypopharynx anlage in statu nascendi.

LABEL: pericardial cell primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some pericardial cell. It develops from some cardiogenic mesoderm.

LABEL: dorsal pharyngeal muscle primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell. It develops from some dorsal pharyngeal muscle anlage.

LABEL: Malpighian tubule main body primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic posterior Malpighian tubule. It develops from some Malpighian tubule primordium.

LABEL: small intestine primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic small intestine. It develops from some hindgut proper primordium.

LABEL: large intestine primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic large intestine. It develops from some hindgut proper primordium.

LABEL: rectum primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic/larval rectum. It develops from some hindgut proper primordium.

LABEL: mushroom body primordium
hasExactSynonym: embryonic central brain mushroom body
IAO_0000115: Embryonic structure from which the mushroom body is derived. The development of the mushroom body proceeds as follows: axonogenesis of embryonic Kenyon cells starts late in embryonic stage 14. The axons from these cells extend towards the lateral protocerebral tract (LTP). During stage 16, a second set of Kenyon cell fibers form a second tract, closely apposed to the first. By late stage 16, both tracts extend anteriorly beyond the LTP to form the distal part of the peduncle. These tracts make a sharp medial turn close to the boundary with the deutocerebrum to form the medial lobe. By late stage 17 the vertical lobe has emerged as a collateral outgrowth from the point where these tracts bend. Finally, the calyx forms near to the end of embryogenesis.

LABEL: antennal primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic antennal sense organ. It develops from some antennal anlage.

LABEL: pars intercerebralis primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the late embryonic pars intercerebralis. At stage 12, the primordium of each hemisphere forms a narrow cluster of approximately 40-50 cells, in the antero-medial procephalon, behind the furrow that separates the procephalon from the clypeolabrum. The primordium then invaginates from the procephalic ectoderm between stages 11 to 13. During stages 13 to 14, the invagination pinches off the surface ectoderm and forms small vesicles in between the outer epithelium and the brain surface.

LABEL: salivary gland body primordium
hasExactSynonym: P1 SalG
IAO_0000115: Primordium that will form the secretory body of the embryonic/larval salivary gland. This primordium is first apparent as two epidermal placodes on the medial surface of the labial buds during stage 11. These placodes invaginate during embryonic stage 11 to form simple tubes on each side of the embryo that are positioned approximately along the dorso-ventral axis. Once internalized, the primordia migrate posteriorly during embryonic stage 12. They fuse to the developing salivary gland common duct by stage 13 and shortly after begin to show signs of secretory activity.

LABEL: embryonic primordium of adult muscle precursor
hasExactSynonym: adult muscle precursor primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the late extended germ band and dorsal closure embryo that will give rise to the embryonic precursor of the adult muscle.

LABEL: somatic muscle primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the larval segmentally-repeated body wall musculature. It arises from the outer layer of the trunk mesoderm. During germ band shortening (stage 13), it segregates into loose segmental clusters. Within these clusters, muscle formation proceeds by fusion of fusion competent myoblasts to muscle founder cells. Formation of the embryonic/larval somatic musculature is complete by stage 17.

LABEL: trunk visceral muscle primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium that is derived from the trunk mesoderm and produces larval visceral musculature (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997). This produces all of the visceral muscle except for that of the esophagus (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997; de Velasco et al., 2006).

LABEL: inclusive hindgut primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some hindgut proper primordium and some Malpighian tubule primordium. It develops from some hindgut anlage.

LABEL: midline primordium
IAO_0000115: Region of the developing embryonic central nervous system that is derived from the mesectoderm and found at the midline (Kearney et al., 2004). The mesectodermal cells have undergone further cell division and differentiation and a metameric organization is now more apparent (Kearney et al., 2004).

LABEL: gnathal primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some cibarium primordium and some labial sensory complex primordium and some maxillary sensory complex primordium and some larval foregut atrium. It develops from some dorsal ectoderm.

LABEL: foregut primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some foregut.

LABEL: stomatogastric nervous system primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some proventricular ganglion primordium and some frontal ganglion primordium and some hypocerebral/paraesophageal ganglion primordium. It develops from some stomatogastric nervous system anlage.

LABEL: central brain primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the embryonic central brain in the extended germ band and dorsal closure embryo.

LABEL: maxillary sensory complex primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic maxillary sensory complex. It develops from some gnathal primordium.

LABEL: labial sensory complex primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic labial sensory complex. It develops from some gnathal primordium.

LABEL: labral sensory complex primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some larval labral sensory complex. It develops from some clypeo-labral primordium.

LABEL: head mesoderm anlage
IAO_0000115: A(n) anlage that develops into some head mesoderm.

LABEL: proventriculus primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic proventriculus.

LABEL: ventral sensory complex primordium
IAO_0000115: A(n) primordium that develops into some embryonic ventral sensory organ precursor cluster group. It develops from some ventral sensory complex anlage and some ventral epidermis primordium.

LABEL: ventral nerve cord primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium which is formed by the delamination of neuroblasts from the ventral neurogenic region. The first of five waves of delamination starts towards the end of embryonic stage 8. During stage 11, the mesectoderm loses contact with the outer surface and forms neuronal and glial precursors in the midline of this primordium.

LABEL: apoptotic amnioserosa
IAO_0000115: Amnioserosa following dorsal closure (Reed et al., 2004). It initially invaginates to form a tube with its perimeter cells aligning on the dorsal side of the tube, beneath the dorsal midline of the embryo (Reed et al., 2004). Individual cells dissociate from the tube and are engulfed by hemocytes, dying by anoikis (Reed et al., 2004).

LABEL: embryonic ventral midline neuroblast
IAO_0000115: Neuroblast of the embryonic ventral midline that is a precursor to larval ventral midline neurons, which are found in the ventralmost part of the ventral nerve cord (Kearney et al., 2004). There are four of these cells per neuromere and each divides once to produce two progeny cells (Kearney et al., 2004).

LABEL: obsolete ventral midline neuron
IAO_0000115: Neuron of the embryonic or larval ventral midline. Two sets of neurons can be distinguished: 3 neurons in the ventral region (UMI, VUM interneuron and VUM motorneuron) and 2 in the medial region (MP1 and MNB).

LABEL: embryonic antennal sense organ
hasExactSynonym: embryonic dorsal organ
IAO_0000115: Sense organ of the embryonic antennal segment that gives rise to the dorsal organ of the larval head. It is posterior to the embryonic brain by stage 13 and migrates ventrally and anteriorly to establish its final position, dorsal to the terminal organ, by stage 17.

LABEL: embryonic tracheole
IAO_0000115: Tracheole of the embryo.

LABEL: embryonic foregut
IAO_0000115: Foregut of the embryo.

LABEL: embryonic proventriculus inner layer
IAO_0000115: Inner layer of the proventriculus of the embryo. It corresponds to the invaginated esophagus.

LABEL: embryonic proventriculus intermediate layer
IAO_0000115: Intermediate layer of the proventriculus of the embryo. It corresponds to the invaginated foregut with alveolar cells. It contains imaginal cells at the level of the intermediate layer at the anterior end of the proventriculus.

LABEL: embryonic proventriculus outer layer
IAO_0000115: Outer layer of the proventriculus of the embryo. It corresponds to the visceral mesoderm, containing cells that secrete the peritrophic membrane.

LABEL: embryonic precursor of adult foregut
hasExactSynonym: adult foregut precursor
IAO_0000115: Imaginal cell, set aside during embryonic development, that will give rise to the adult posterior foregut. These cells are found in a ring at the anterior part of the proventriculus, the foregut imaginal ring.

LABEL: embryonic esophagus
IAO_0000115: Esophagus of the embryo. It invaginates to form part of the proventriculus.

LABEL: embryonic epipharynx
IAO_0000115: Floor of the embryonic pharynx.

LABEL: embryonic foregut sensory structure
IAO_0000115: Any internal compound sense organ (FBbt:00007236) that is part of some embryonic foregut (FBbt:00005606).

LABEL: embryonic maxillary sensory complex
hasExactSynonym: embryonic terminal organ
IAO_0000115: Sense organ of the embryonic maxillary segment that gives rise to the terminal organ of the larval head. It is posterior and ventral to the embryonic brain by stage 13 and migrates ventrally and anteriorly to establish its final position, ventral to the dorsal organ, by stage 17.

LABEL: embryonic labial sensory complex
IAO_0000115: Developing labial sensory organ that has not yet reached its mature larval state. It starts to become distinct, and the developing neurons form nerves, during stage 13 (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997). As foregut structures move inwards, it becomes incorporated into the ventral part of atrium around stage 15 (Campos-Ortega and Hartenstein, 1997).

LABEL: embryonic hindgut
IAO_0000115: Posterior region of the embryonic gut, posterior to the embryonic midgut. It is divided into 3 domains: small and large intestine and rectum. Border cells separate these three regions.

LABEL: embryonic Malpighian tubule tip cell
IAO_0000115: Tip cell of the embryonic Malpighian tubule. It persists throughout tubule elongation during stages 13-16 and contacts a specific target by the end of the process (Weavers and Skaer, 2013). It adopts a specialized morphology with the cell body projecting from the tubule tip on the end of a microtubule-enriched stalk (Weavers and Skaer, 2013). It can extend filopodia and lamellipodia to explore its environment and remains free of basement membrane (Weavers and Skaer, 2013).

LABEL: embryonic precursor of adult hindgut
hasExactSynonym: adult hindgut precursor
IAO_0000115: Imaginal cell, set aside during embryonic development, that will give rise to the adult hindgut. These cells are found in two rings of the hindgut; immediately posterior to the ureters of the Malpighian tubules, and at the anus. These two rings grow out and eventually unite.

LABEL: embryonic central brain
IAO_0000115: Brain of the embryo that excludes the optic lobes. It includes the protocerebrum, deutocerebrum and tritocerebrum.

LABEL: embryonic central brain glial cell
hasExactSynonym: embryonic central brain glia
IAO_0000115: Glial cell of the embryonic central brain.

LABEL: embryonic central brain surface glial cell
hasExactSynonym: embryonic central brain surface glia
IAO_0000115: Surface glial cell of the embryonic central brain.

LABEL: embryonic central brain neuron
IAO_0000115: Neuron of the embryonic central brain.

LABEL: embryonic pars intercerebralis
hasExactSynonym: embryonic central brain pars intercerebralis
IAO_0000115: Pars intercerebralis of the late embryo that develops from the pars intercerebralis primordium. From stage 15, the primordia of both hemispheres merge at the midline.

LABEL: embryonic frontal ganglion
IAO_0000115: A small paired ganglion of the embryonic stomatogastric nervous system attached to the anterior surface of the brain. It consists of approximately 25-30 neurons that form a U-shaped ganglion wedged between the anterior aspect of the brain hemispheres and the dorsal pharynx. The somata of the neurons surround a sparse neuropil domain and are enclosed in a glial sheath. Lateral projections from these neurons form the frontal connective. Medial projections that turn anteriorly on reaching the midline form the frontal nerve. Medial projections that turn posteriorly on reaching the midline form the recurrent nerve.

LABEL: embryonic hypocerebral ganglion
IAO_0000115: Small ganglion of the embryonic stomatogastric nervous system. By stage 16 it is located on the left hand side of the embryo, between the two brain hemispheres and behind the supraesophageal commissure. It is more compact than the paraesophageal ganglion and occupies a more dorsal position. It contains approximately 10-12 neurons.

LABEL: larval lateral VNC glial cell
hasExactSynonym: lateral cord glia
IAO_0000115: Larval glial cell that derives from the embryonic lateral cord.

LABEL: lateral cord neuron
IAO_0000115: Neuron that develops from a precursor found in the embryonic lateral cord.

LABEL: embryonic dorsal epidermis
IAO_0000115: Epidermis of the dorsal region of the embryo.

LABEL: embryonic dorsal apodeme
IAO_0000115: Dorsal halve of an embryonic apodeme. The discontinuity between dorsal and ventral halves is visible on a lateral view.

LABEL: embryonic leading edge cell
IAO_0000115: Cell at the leading edge of the dorsal epidermis during dorsal closure.

LABEL: embryonic anal pad
IAO_0000115: Anal pad of the embryo.

LABEL: embryonic ventral apodeme
IAO_0000115: Ventral halve of an embryonic apodeme. The discontinuity between dorsal and ventral halves is visible on a lateral view.

LABEL: embryonic outer optic lobe primordium
hasExactSynonym: P1 OOA
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the late extended germ band and closure embryo that gives rise to the larval outer optic anlage. It develops from the posterior lip of the visual primordium.

LABEL: larval lateral VNC surface glial cell
hasExactSynonym: lateral cord surface glia
IAO_0000115: Larval surface glial cell that derives from the embryonic lateral cord.

LABEL: ventral imaginal tissue
IAO_0000115: Imaginal tissue that has a ventral location.

LABEL: endocrine system component
hasExactSynonym: endocrine organ
IAO_0000115: Any material anatomical entity (FBbt:00007016) that is capable of has target end location some hormone secretion (GO:0046879) that has target end location some circulatory system (FBbt:00005057).

LABEL: central brain anlage
hasExactSynonym: A CenBr
IAO_0000115: Anlage of the embryonic central brain in the gastrula embryo that will give rise to the central brain primordium.

LABEL: hypopharynx anlage in statu nascendi
hasExactSynonym: Asn HyPh
IAO_0000115: Anlage in statu nascendi in the blastoderm embryo that will give rise to the hypopharynx anlage.

LABEL: posterior pharyngeal sense organ primordium
hasExactSynonym: P3 HySens|hypopharyngeal sense organ primordium
IAO_0000115: Primordium of the late extended germ band and closure stage embryo that will give rise to the posterior pharyngeal sense organ.

LABEL: larval midline neuron
IAO_0000115: Larval unpaired primary neuron with its cell body found along the midline of the nervous system (Fontana and Crews, 2012). There are around 18 of these per segment in the late embryo, which are derived from midline precursors (MP1-6) or the median neuroblast (MNB) (Fontana and Crews, 2012). Two sets of neurons can be distinguished; ventral neurons (including MP3 and VUM neurons) and medial neurons (including MP1 and MNB descendants) (Kearney et al., 2004).

LABEL: amnioserosa primordium
hasExactSynonym: P1 amnioserosa
IAO_0000115: Dorsalmost region of the ectoderm, which will develop into the amnioserosa (Stathopoulos and Newcomb, 2020).

LABEL: visceral tracheal branch primordium
hasExactSynonym: P1 VisTra|embryonic visceral branch|visceral branch specific anlage
IAO_0000115: Tracheal primordium that develops into the embryonic/larval visceral branch. It branches anteriorly from the dorsal portion of the transverse connective primordium during stage 12, coursing anteriorly and inwardly towards the gut.

LABEL: longitudinal trunk visceral muscle primordium
hasExactSynonym: CVM|P1 LoViMus|caudal visceral mesoderm|longitudinal visceral muscle precursor
IAO_0000115: This primordium first becomes distinct at around stage 11 as a group of cells at the posterior tip of the trunk visceral mesoderm (the tail end of the germ-band). During germ-band retraction these cells migrate anteriorly and split into two clusters - one on either side of the posterior midgut primordium.
