IAO_0000115: Excessive growth (overgrowth) of the facial bones, that is of the facial skeleton.

LABEL: Flat occiput
hasExactSynonym: Flat posterior cranium|Posterior flattening of the skull
IAO_0000115: Reduced convexity of the occiput (posterior part of skull).

LABEL: Decreased calvarial ossification
hasExactSynonym: Poorly ossified calvaria|Poorly ossified calvarium|Soft calvaria|Soft skullcap|Undermineralized calvarium
IAO_0000115: Abnormal reduction in ossification of the calvaria (roof of the skull consisting of the frontal bone, parietal bones, temporal bones, and occipital bone).

LABEL: Secondary microcephaly
hasExactSynonym: Acquired microcephaly|Deceleration of head growth|Microcephaly, acquired|Microcephaly, postnatal|Postnatal deceleration of head circumference|Postnatal microcephaly
IAO_0000115: Head circumference which falls below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender because of insufficient head growth after birth.

LABEL: Prominent metopic ridge
hasExactSynonym: Prominent frontal ridge|Prominent metopic suture|Ridging of metopic suture
IAO_0000115: Vertical bony ridge positioned in the midline of the forehead.

LABEL: Monoclonal elevation of circulating IgM concentration
IAO_0000115: Presence of a monoclonal immunoglobulin M protein in the serum.

LABEL: Increased mean corpuscular volume
hasExactSynonym: Erythrocyte macrocytosis|Increased MCV
IAO_0000115: Larger than normal size of erythrocytes.

LABEL: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
IAO_0000115: Disseminated intravascular coagulation is characterized by the widespread activation of coagulation, which results in the intravascular formation of fibrin and ultimately thrombotic occlusion of small and midsize vessels.

LABEL: Bone marrow hypocellularity
hasExactSynonym: Bone marrow failure|Bone marrow hypoplasia|Hypoplastic bone marrow|Myeloid hypoplasia
IAO_0000115: A reduced number of hematopoietic cells present in the bone marrow relative to marrow fat.

LABEL: Macrocytic dyserythropoietic anemia
hasExactSynonym: Macrocytic dyserythropoietic anaemia

LABEL: Transient myeloproliferative syndrome
hasExactSynonym: TMD|Transient leukaemia of Down syndrome|Transient leukemia of Down syndrome|Transient myeloproliferative disorder
IAO_0000115: A unique clonal neoplastic disorder that is linked to trisomy 21, is restricted to neonatal period, and spontaneously regresses. It often has characteristics of megakaryocytic lineage and is associated with GATA1 mutations in myeloblasts.

LABEL: Congenital agranulocytosis
IAO_0000115: Persistent absence of detectable circulating granulocytes in the blood with no detected secondary cause. Usually a value of less than 50 granulocytes per microliter is considered to be an absence.

LABEL: Multiple renal cysts
hasExactSynonym: Multiple kidney cysts
IAO_0000115: The presence of many cysts in the kidney.

LABEL: Reduced renal corticomedullary differentiation
hasExactSynonym: Loss of definition of corticomedullary differentiation
IAO_0000115: Reduced differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.

LABEL: Macular hypopigmented whorls, streaks, and patches
Hypopigmentation of hair
hasExactSynonym: Hair hypopigmentation|Loss of hair color|Loss of hair colour

LABEL: Large cafe-au-lait macules with irregular margins
IAO_0000115: Large hypermelanotic macules with jagged borders.

LABEL: Gallbladder dysfunction
hasExactSynonym: Gallbladder dysfunction

LABEL: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the femur
hasExactSynonym: Absent/small thighbone|Absent/underdeveloped thighbone|Hypoplastic to absent femora|Hypoplastic/aplastic femora
IAO_0000115: Absence or underdevelopment of the femur.

IAO_0000115: An abnormally increased rate of skeletal maturation. Accelerated skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.

LABEL: Hyperextensible hand joints

LABEL: Positional foot deformity

LABEL: Bilateral triphalangeal thumbs

IAO_0000115: A bilateral form of triphalangeal thumb.

LABEL: 2-3 toe cutaneous syndactyly

LABEL: Lethal skeletal dysplasia
hasExactSynonym: Lethal dwarfism identifiable at birth

LABEL: Supernumerary ribs
hasExactSynonym: Extra ribs

LABEL: Dysharmonic delayed bone age

LABEL: Multiple prenatal fractures

IAO_0000115: The presence of bone fractures in the prenatal period that are diagnosed at birth or before.

LABEL: Pseudoarthrosis
hasExactSynonym: Pseudoarthroses
IAO_0000115: A pathologic entity characterized by a developmental defect in a long bone leading to bending and pathologic fracture, with inability to form a normal bony callus with subsequent fibrous nonunion, leading to the pseudarthrosis (or "false joint").

LABEL: Polysyndactyly of hallux
hasExactSynonym: Polysyndactyly of big toe|Polysyndactyly of great toe
IAO_0000115: Combined syndactyly and polydactyly of the great toe.

LABEL: Congenital finger flexion contractures
hasExactSynonym: Congenital finger contractures
IAO_0000115: Multiple bent (flexed) finger joints that cannot be straightened actively or passively.

LABEL: Biliary atresia
hasExactSynonym: Atresia of bile ducts|Biliary duct atresia
IAO_0000115: Atresia of the biliary tree.

LABEL: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the metacarpal bones
hasExactSynonym: Absent or hypoplastic metacarpals|Absent/small long bones of hand|Absent/underdeveloped long bones of hand|Aplastic/hypoplastic metacarpals|Hypoplastic metacarpals|Hypoplastic/absent metacarpal bones|Hypoplastic/absent metacarpals|Metacarpal aplasia/hypoplasia
IAO_0000115: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the metacarpal bones.

IAO_0000115: Bilateral lack of development of the lungs.

LABEL: Apneic episodes in infancy

LABEL: Impaired gluconeogenesis
hasExactSynonym: Gluconeogenesis impaired

LABEL: Limitation of neck motion

LABEL: Dermatochalasis

IAO_0000115: Loss of elasticity of the upper and lower eyelids causing the skin to sag and bulge.

LABEL: Cleft mandible
hasExactSynonym: Cleft lower jaw|Mandibular cleft
IAO_0000115: Midline deficiency of the mandible and some or all overlying tissues.

LABEL: Midline defect of mandible
hasExactSynonym: Midline cleft of mandible

LABEL: Chordoma
IAO_0000115: A chordoma is a tumor that arises from embryonic remnants of the notochord along the length of the neuraxis. Chordomas generally occur in the sacrum, intracranially at the clivus, or along the spinal axis.

LABEL: Pilonidal sinus
hasExactSynonym: Pilonidal cyst
IAO_0000115: A sinus in the coccygeal region (the region of the intergluteal cleft). A pilonidal sinus often contains hair and skin debris.

LABEL: Pilonidal abscess
hasExactSynonym: Sacrococcygeal fistula
IAO_0000115: A hair-containing cyst or sinus usually in the coccygeal region.

LABEL: Anomalous pulmonary venous return
IAO_0000115: A developmental defect characterized by abnormal connection of one or more pulmonary veins to the superior or inferior vena cava, the right atrium, or the coronary sinus, resulting in a left-to-right shunt of oxygenated blood.

LABEL: Erythema
hasExactSynonym: Redness of skin or mucous membrane
IAO_0000115: Redness of the skin, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.

LABEL: Bifid nail
hasExactSynonym: Notched nail|duplicated nail
IAO_0000115: A digit with two nails, with at least some soft tissue between them.

LABEL: Impaired visuospatial constructive cognition
IAO_0000115: Reduced ability affecting mainly visuospatial cognition which may be tested using pattern construction (for example by Differential Ability Scales, which test a person's strengths and weaknesses across a range of intellectual abilities).

LABEL: Tented upper lip vermilion
hasExactSynonym: Inverted V-shaped upper lip
IAO_0000115: Triangular appearance of the oral aperture with the apex in the midpoint of the upper vermilion and the lower vermilion forming the base.

LABEL: Upturned corners of mouth
hasExactSynonym: Upturned corners of mouth|Upturned mouth|Upturned oral commisures
IAO_0000115: Oral commissures positioned superior to the midline labial fissure.

LABEL: Protruding tongue
hasExactSynonym: Lingual prolapse|Lingual prominence|Lingual protrusion|Prolapse of tongue|Prominent tongue|Protruding tongue|Tongue protrusion|Tongue sticking out of mouth
IAO_0000115: Tongue extending beyond the alveolar ridges or teeth at rest.

LABEL: Abnormal number of hair whorls
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal number of hair swirls|Abnormal number of hair whorls|Double crown (hair whorls)|Extra hair swirls|Extra hair whorl|Supernumary hair swirls|Supernumary hair whorl
IAO_0000115: More than two clockwise hair whorls.

LABEL: Nevus sebaceous
hasExactSynonym: Naevus sebaceous|Organoid nevus|Sebaceous mole|Sebaceous naevus|Sebaceous nevus
IAO_0000115: A congenital, hairless plaque consisting of overgrown epidermis, sebaceous glands, hair follicles, apocrine glands and connective tissue. They are a variant of epidermal naevi. Sebaceous naevi most often appear on the scalp, but they may also arise on the face, neck or forehead. At birth, a sevaceous nevus typically appears as a solitary, smooth, yellow-orange hairless patch. Sebaceous naevi become more pronounced around adolescence, often appearing bumpy, warty or scaly.

LABEL: Generalized tonic seizure
hasExactSynonym: Generalised hypertonic seizure|Generalised tonic seizure|Generalised tonic seizures|Generalized hypertonic seizure|Generalized tonic seizures
IAO_0000115: A generalized tonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening without a subsequent clonic phase. The tonic activity can be a sustained abnormal posture, either in extension or flexion, sometimes accompanied by tremor of the extremities.

LABEL: Atonic seizure
hasExactSynonym: Astatic seizure|Astatic seizures|Atonic seizures|Drop attacks|Drop seizures|Hypotonic seizure
IAO_0000115: Atonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1 to 2 seconds, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.

LABEL: Impaired temperature sensation
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of temperature sensation|Impaired temperature sensation|Impaired thermal sensitivity|Loss of temperature sensation
IAO_0000115: A reduced ability to discriminate between different temperatures.

LABEL: Abnormality of pain sensation
IAO_0000115: Pain is an unpleasant sensation that can range from mild, localized discomfort to agony, whereby the physical part of pain results from nerve stimulation and is often accompanied by an emotional component. This term groups abnormalities in pain sensation presumed to result from abnormalities related to the specific nerve fibers that carry the pain impulses to the brain.

LABEL: Decreased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
hasExactSynonym: Decreased ceruloplasmin concentration|Decreased ceruloplasmin level|Decreased ceruloplasmin level in blood|Decreased serum ceruloplasmin|Decreased serum ceruloplasminA|Hypoceruloplasminaemia|Hypoceruloplasminemia|Reduced ceruloplasmin concentration|Reduced ceruloplasmin level|Reduced ceruloplasmin level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Multifocal epileptiform discharges
hasExactSynonym: Multifocal EEG abnormality
IAO_0000115: An abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG) and being identified at multiple locations (foci).

LABEL: EEG with generalized slow activity
hasExactSynonym: EEG with generalised slow activity|EEG: generalised slow activity|EEG: generalized slow activity
IAO_0000115: Diffuse slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

LABEL: EEG with spike-wave complexes
IAO_0000115: Complexes of spikes (<70 ms) and sharp waves (70-200 ms), which are sharp transient waves that have a strong association with epilepsy, in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

LABEL: EEG with periodic abnormalities
hasExactSynonym: EEG: periodic abnormalities
IAO_0000115: Periodically recurring abnormalities in the EEG.

LABEL: Delayed fine motor development
IAO_0000115: A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the fingers and hands.

LABEL: Receptive language delay
IAO_0000115: A delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.

LABEL: Severe intellectual disability
hasExactSynonym: Early and severe mental retardation|Intellectual disability, severe|Mental retardation, severe|Severe mental retardation
IAO_0000115: Severe intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by severely sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 20-34.

LABEL: Age-inappropriate oppositional behavior
hasExactSynonym: Developmentally inappropriate oppositional behavior|Excessive oppositional behavior
IAO_0000115: A pervasive and characteristic pattern of arguing, defiance, and hostility toward others, particularly authority figures, that goes beyond the occasional oppositionality seen as a normal behavior in individuals at a certain age, e.g., during child and adolescent development.

LABEL: Dyssynergia
IAO_0000115: A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed. With dyssynergia, a voluntary movement appears broken down into its component parts.

LABEL: Monocular strabismus
hasExactSynonym: Unilateral strabismus
IAO_0000115: A type of strabismus in which the fixating eye is always the same one, while the other eye is constantly deviated. Monocular strabismus is to be distinguished from alternating strabismus, in which either of the eyes 'squints' at different times.

LABEL: Fetal cystic hygroma
hasExactSynonym: Foetal cystic hygroma
IAO_0000115: The presence during the prenatal period of a cystic mass with multiple septa with multiple, asymmetric, thin-walled cysts near the posterior aspect of the neck. Fetal cystic hygroma can be defined as nuchal translucency with or without septations measuring greater than 3.0 mm. Increased NT refers to a measurement above the 95th centile, and the term is used irrespective of whether the collection of fluid is septated or not, and whether it is confined to the neck or envelopes the whole fetus. After 14 weeks, increased NT usually resolves, but in some cases it evolves into nuchal edema or cystic hygromas.

LABEL: Increased nuchal translucency
IAO_0000115: Nuchal translucency is the sonographic appearance of subcutaneous accumulation of liquid in the back of the fetal neck in the first trimester of pregnancy (11-14 gestational weeks of pregnancy).

LABEL: Abnormality of the umbilical cord
hasExactSynonym: Umbilical cord issue
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the umbilical cord, which is the cord connecting the developing embryo or fetus to the placenta.

LABEL: Pulmonary valve atresia
IAO_0000115: A congenital disorder of the pulmonary valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop.

LABEL: Acromelia
IAO_0000115: Shortening of the extremities affecting primarily the distal parts of the limbs (hands and feet) in relation to the other segments of the limbs.

LABEL: Avascular necrosis
hasExactSynonym: Aseptic bone necrosis|Aseptic necrosis|Bone infarction|Death of bone due to decreased blood supply|Ischaemic bone necrosis|Ischemic bone necrosis|Osteochondronecrosis|Osteonecrosis
IAO_0000115: A disease where there is cellular death (necrosis) of bone components due to interruption of the blood supply.

LABEL: Osteochondritis dissecans
hasExactSynonym: Osteochondrosis dissecans
IAO_0000115: A joint disorder caused by blood deprivation in the subchondral bone causing the subchondral bone to die in a process called avascular necrosis. The bone is then reabsorbed by the body, leaving the articular cartilage it supported prone to damage. The result is fragmentation (dissection) of both cartilage and bone, and the free movement of these osteochondral fragments within the joint space, causing pain and further damage.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating serine family amino acid concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal serine family amino acid level|Abnormality of serine family amino acid metabolism
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal concentration of serine family amino acid in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Hypervalinemia
hasExactSynonym: Elevated valine concentration|Elevated valine level|Elevated valine level in blood|High blood valine concentration|Increased valine concentration|Increased valine level|Increased valine level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of valine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Hyperleucinemia
hasExactSynonym: Elevated leucine concentration|Elevated leucine level|Elevated leucine level in blood|High blood leucine concentration|Increased leucine concentration|Increased leucine level|Increased leucine level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of leucine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Aculeiform cataract
hasExactSynonym: Fasciculiform cataract|Frosted cataract|Needle-shaped cataract
IAO_0000115: A kind of nuclear cataract characterized by fiberglasslike or needlelike crystals projecting in different directions, through or close to the axial region of the lens.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating sodium concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal blood Na+ levels|Abnormal blood sodium concentration|Abnormal circulating Na concentration|Abnormal sodium(1+) level|Abnormality of sodium homeostasis
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal concentration of sodium in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Echogenic fetal bowel
hasExactSynonym: Echogenic bowel|Echogenic foetal bowel|Hyperechogenic fetal bowel|Hyperechogenic foetal bowel|Prenatal ultrasound: hyperechogenic bowel
IAO_0000115: Echogenic bowel is defined as fetal bowel with homogenous areas of echogenicity that are equal to or greater than that of surrounding bone.

LABEL: Abnormal renal pelvis morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the renal pelvis
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the renal pelvis.

LABEL: Fetal pyelectasis
hasExactSynonym: Fetal renal pelvic dilatation|Foetal pyelectasis|Foetal renal pelvic dilatation|Mild fetal hydronephrosis|Mild foetal hydronephrosis
IAO_0000115: Mild pyelectasis is defined as a hypoechoic spherical or elliptical space within the renal pelvis that measures at least 5mm and not more than 10 mm. The measurement is taken on a transverse section through the fetal renal pelvis using the maximum anterior-to-posterior measurement.

LABEL: Abnormal fetal cardiovascular morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the fetal cardiovascular system|Abnormality of the fetal circulation system|Abnormality of the foetal cardiovascular system|Abnormality of the foetal circulation system
IAO_0000115: A structural abnormality of the fetal circulation system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.

LABEL: Mild fetal ventriculomegaly
hasExactSynonym: Mild foetal ventriculomegaly
IAO_0000115: A kind of ventriculomegaly occurring in the fetal period and usually diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound. Cerebral ventriculomegaly is defined by atrial measurements 10 mm or more. Mild ventriculomegaly (MVM) is defined as measurements between 10 and 15 mm. Measurements are obtained from an axial plane at the level of the thalamic nuclei just below the standard image to measure the BPD (PMID:16100637).

LABEL: Fetal megacystis
hasExactSynonym: Foetal megacystis
IAO_0000115: Fetal megacystis is an abnormally enlarged bladder identified at any gestational age.

LABEL: Blood group antigen abnormality
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of an erythrocyte cell surface molecule.

LABEL: Anemia of inadequate production
hasExactSynonym: Anaemia of inadequate production|Anemia, dyserythropoietic|Defective erythropoiesis|Dyserythropoietic anaemia|Dyserythropoietic anemia|Ineffective erythropoiesis
IAO_0000115: A kind of anemia characterized by inadequate production of erythrocytes.

LABEL: Decreased total B cell count
hasExactSynonym: B cell deficiency|B cell lymphopenia|B lymphocytopenia|Decreased B cell count|Low B cell count|Reduction in B cell number
IAO_0000115: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is below the lower limit of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

LABEL: Abnormality of immune system physiology
IAO_0000115: A functional abnormality of the immune system.

LABEL: Hyperlipoproteinemia
IAO_0000115: An abnormal increase in the level of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.

LABEL: Abnormal cellular immune system morphology
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the morphology or counts of the cells that make up the immune system.

LABEL: Stress urinary incontinence
IAO_0000115: Involuntary urine leakage synchronous with exertion, or actions such as sneezing, or coughing.

LABEL: Increased bone mineral density
hasExactSynonym: Increased bone density|Increased bone mineral density|Osteosclerosis|Osteosclerosis of bones
IAO_0000115: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density, that is, of the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones which is often referred to as osteosclerosis. Osteosclerosis can be detected on radiological examination as an increased whiteness (density) of affected bones.

LABEL: Osteopetrosis
hasExactSynonym: Harder, denser, fracture-prone bones
IAO_0000115: Abnormally increased formation of dense trabecular bone tissue. Despite the increased density of bone tissue, osteopetrotic bones tend to be more fracture-prone than normal.

LABEL: Acute
hasExactSynonym: Acute onset
IAO_0000115: Sudden appearance of disease manifestations over a short period of time.

LABEL: Chronic
hasExactSynonym: Chronic
IAO_0000115: Slow, creeping onset, slow progress and long continuance of disease manifestations.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating carbohydrate concentration
IAO_0000115: A deviation from the normal concentration of a carbohydrate in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Abnormal glucose homeostasis
IAO_0000115: Abnormality of glucose homeostasis.

LABEL: Abnormal blood glucose concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of blood glucose concentration
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the concentration of glucose in the blood.

LABEL: Abnormal cellular physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of cell physiology
IAO_0000115: An abnormality in a cellular process.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating enzyme concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of circulating enzyme level
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal concentration of an enzyme in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the GI tract|Abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract.

LABEL: Abnormal cardiovascular system physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of cardiovascular system physiology
IAO_0000115: Abnormal functionality of the cardiovascular system.

LABEL: Abnormality of blood circulation
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of blood circulation.

LABEL: Abnormality of iron homeostasis
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the homeostasis (concentration) of iron cation.

LABEL: Abnormal renal cortex morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of renal cortex morphology
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the cortex of the kidney.

LABEL: Decreased urine output
IAO_0000115: A decreased rate of urine production.

LABEL: Abnormal intrahepatic bile duct morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the intrahepatic bile duct
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the intrahepatic bile duct.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating adrenocorticotropin concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of circulating corticotropin level
IAO_0000115: An abnormal concentration of corticotropin in the blood.

LABEL: Impacted tooth
hasExactSynonym: Impacted tooth|Retained tooth
IAO_0000115: A tooth that has not erupted because of local impediments (overcrowding or fibrous gum overgrowth).

LABEL: Fused teeth
hasExactSynonym: Fused teeth|Fusion of teeth|Joined teeth
IAO_0000115: The union of two separately developing tooth germs typically leading to one less tooth than normal in the affected dental arch.

LABEL: Increased overbite
hasExactSynonym: Increased overlap of upper and lower incisors|Overbite|Supraocclusion
IAO_0000115: Maxillary teeth cover the mandibular teeth when biting to an increased degree. The feature is defined as a vertical overlap of the maxillary incisors over the mandibular incisors that exceeds 2 mm.

LABEL: Peripheral demyelination
hasExactSynonym: Demyelination
IAO_0000115: A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.

LABEL: Epileptic spasm
hasExactSynonym: Epileptic spasms|Salaam convulsion|Salaam convulsions|Salaam seizure|Salaam seizures
IAO_0000115: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: Grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. Epileptic spasms frequently occur in clusters. Infantile spasms are the best known form, but spasms can occur at all ages

LABEL: Speech apraxia
hasExactSynonym: Apraxia of speech|Verbal dyspraxia
IAO_0000115: A type of apraxia that is characterized by difficulty or inability to execute speech movements because of problems with coordination and motor problems, leading to incorrect articulation. An increase of errors with increasing word and phrase length may occur.

LABEL: Spastic hemiparesis
hasExactSynonym: Spastic hemiplegia
IAO_0000115: Unilateral paresis (weakness) with spasticity of the affected muscles and increased tendon reflexes.

LABEL: Hypervolemia
hasExactSynonym: Fluid overload in blood
IAO_0000115: An increase in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.

LABEL: Hypovolemia
hasExactSynonym: Depleted blood volume
IAO_0000115: An decrease in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.

LABEL: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis
hasExactSynonym: Recurrent canker sores|Recurrent oral aphthae
IAO_0000115: Recurrent episodes of ulceration of the oral mucosa, typically presenting as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border.

LABEL: Recurrent sinusitis
hasExactSynonym: Recurrent sinus infections|Sinusitis, recurrent
IAO_0000115: A recurrent form of sinusitis.

LABEL: Recurrent tonsillitis
hasExactSynonym: Recurrent inflammation of tonsils
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the tonsils that has occurred repeatedly. The definition of recurrent may vary somewhat, but the criteria used recently as a measure of severity were five or more episodes of true tonsillitis per year, symptoms recurring for at least a year, and episodes that are disabling and that prevent normal functioning. In some cases recurrent tonsillitis may be related to immunosusceptibility. Evidence exists for a genetic predisposition for recurrent tonsillitis.

LABEL: Abnormal nasal dorsum morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the dorsum of nose|Abnormality of the nasal dorsum|Abnormality of the nasal ridge|Anomaly of the nasal ridge
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the nasal dorsum, also known as the nasal ridge.

LABEL: Concave nasal ridge
hasExactSynonym: Boxer's nasal deformity|Boxer's nose deformity|Concave dorsum of nose|Concave nasal dorsum|Saddle nose|Saddle shaped nasal dorsum|Ski jump nose
IAO_0000115: Nasal ridge curving posteriorly to an imaginary line that connects the nasal root and tip.

LABEL: Abnormal skin morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal skin structure|Abnormality of skin morphology
IAO_0000115: Any morphological abnormality of the skin.

LABEL: Abnormal skin physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of skin physiology
IAO_0000115: Any abnormality of the physiological function of the skin.

LABEL: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal tendency to infections of the skin|Inflammatory abnormality of the skin|Skin inflammation
IAO_0000115: The presence of inflammation of the skin. That is, an abnormality of the skin resulting from the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes.

LABEL: Bilateral fetal pyelectasis
hasExactSynonym: Bilateral fetal pyelectasia|Bilateral foetal pyelectasia|Bilateral foetal pyelectasis
IAO_0000115: A bilateral form of fetal pyelectasis.

LABEL: Age-related cataract
hasExactSynonym: Clouding of the lens of the eye with age
IAO_0000115: A type of cataract (opacification of the lens) that forms during the course of aging.

LABEL: Age-related nuclear cataract
IAO_0000115: A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the nucleus of the lens.

LABEL: Age-related cortical cataract
IAO_0000115: A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the cortex of the lens.

LABEL: Typical absence seizure
hasExactSynonym: Typical absence|Typical absence seizures
IAO_0000115: A typical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by its sudden onset, interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare, possibly a brief upward deviation of the eyes. Usually the patient will be unresponsive when spoken to. Duration is a few seconds to half a minute with very rapid recovery. Although not always available, an EEG would usually show 3 Hz generalized epileptiform discharges during the event.

LABEL: Myoclonic absence seizure
hasExactSynonym: Myoclonic absence|Myoclonic absences
IAO_0000115: Myoclonic absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by an interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare and rhythmic three-per-second myoclonic movements, causing ratcheting abduction of the upper limbs leading to progressive arm elevation, and associated with 3 Hz generalized spike-wave discharges on the electroencephalogram. Duration is typically 10-60 s. Whilst impairment of consciousness may not be obvious the ILAE classified this seizure as a generalized non-motor seizure in 2017.

LABEL: Early onset absence seizures
hasExactSynonym: Early onset petit mal seizures
IAO_0000115: Typical absence seizures starting before the age of 4 years.

LABEL: Focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features
hasExactSynonym: Focal somatosensory seizure|Partial somatosensory seizure|Somatosensory aura|Somatosensory auras
IAO_0000115: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move as its first clinical manifestation.

LABEL: Generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure
hasExactSynonym: Generalised myoclonic-atonic seizure|Myoclonic atonic seizures|Myoclonic-astatic seizure
IAO_0000115: A generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a myoclonic jerk followed by an atonic motor component.

LABEL: Complex febrile seizure
hasExactSynonym: Complex febrile convulsion|Complex febrile seizures|Complex fever fit
IAO_0000115: A febrile seizure that has any of the following features: focal semiology (or associated with post-ictal neurologic abnormalities beyond drowsiness, such as a Todd's paresis), prolonged seizure beyond 15 minutes, or recurring (occurring more than once) in a 24 hour period.

LABEL: Interictal epileptiform activity
hasExactSynonym: Epileptiform EEG discharges
IAO_0000115: Epileptiform activity refers to distinctive EEG waves or complexes distinguished from background activity found in in a proportion of human subjects with epilepsy, but which can also be found in subjects without seizures. Interictal epileptiform activity refers to such activity that occurs in the absence of a clinical or subclinical seizure.

LABEL: EEG with focal epileptiform discharges
hasExactSynonym: Focal EEG Abnormality
IAO_0000115: EEG discharges recorded in particular areas of a localized (focal) abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

LABEL: Bilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
IAO_0000115: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in both hemispheres.

LABEL: EEG with generalized epileptiform discharges
hasExactSynonym: EEG with generalised epileptiform discharges
IAO_0000115: EEG discharges recorded on the entire scalp typically seen in persons with epilepsy.

LABEL: EEG with abnormally slow frequencies
IAO_0000115: EEG with abnormally slow frequencies.

LABEL: Prominent forehead
hasExactSynonym: Prominence of frontal region|Prominent forehead|Pronounced forehead|Protruding forehead
IAO_0000115: Forward prominence of the entire forehead, due to protrusion of the frontal bone.

LABEL: Elevated circulating C-reactive protein concentration
hasExactSynonym: Elevated C-reactive protein concentration|Elevated C-reactive protein level|Elevated C-reactive protein level in blood|Increased C-reactive protein concentration|Increased C-reactive protein level|Increased C-reactive protein level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of C-reactive protein in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Broad eyebrow
hasExactSynonym: Broad eyebrow|Broad eyebrows|Flared eyebrow|Increased vertical height of eyebrow|Increased vertical thickness of eyebrow
IAO_0000115: Regional increase in the width (height) of the eyebrow.

LABEL: Cryptotia
hasExactSynonym: Buried ear|Hidden ear
IAO_0000115: Invagination of the superior part of the auricle under a fold of temporal skin.

LABEL: Vascular skin abnormality
hasExactSynonym: Skin vascular malformation

LABEL: Abnormality of the urinary system physiology
Abnormal digit morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of digit|Abnormality of fingers or toes|Digital anomalies
IAO_0000115: A morphological abnormality of a digit, i.e., of a finger or toe.

LABEL: Prominent digit pad
hasExactSynonym: Prominent digit pad
IAO_0000115: A soft tissue prominence of the ventral aspects of the fingertips or toe tips.

LABEL: Sydney crease
IAO_0000115: Extension of the proximal transverse crease (five finger crease) to the ulnar edge of the palm.

LABEL: Abnormal long bone morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal shape of long bone|Abnormality of long bone morphology|Abnormality of the tubular bones
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of size or shape of the long bones.

LABEL: Bicoronal synostosis
hasExactSynonym: Bilateral coronal craniosynostosis|Bilateral coronal suture craniosynostosis|Bilateral coronal suture synostosis
IAO_0000115: Synostosis affecting the right and the left coronal suture.

LABEL: Posterior plagiocephaly
hasExactSynonym: Deformational posterior plagiocephaly|Occipital plagiocephaly
IAO_0000115: Asymmetry of the posterior part of the skull.

LABEL: Metopic synostosis
hasExactSynonym: Metopic craniosynostosis|Metopic suture craniosynostosis
IAO_0000115: Premature fusion of the metopic suture.

LABEL: Facial shape deformation
hasExactSynonym: Facial shape compression|Facial shape deformation

LABEL: Abnormality of mouth size
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of mouth size|Anomaly of mouth size

LABEL: Abnormality of mouth shape
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of mouth shape|Anomaly of mouth shape
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the outline, configuration, or contour of the mouth.

LABEL: Long upper lip
hasExactSynonym: Elongation of upper lip|Increased height of upper lip|Increased vertical length of upper lip|Long upper lip
IAO_0000115: Increased width of the upper lip.

LABEL: Mild global developmental delay
hasExactSynonym: Global developmental delay, mild
IAO_0000115: A mild delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

LABEL: Moderate global developmental delay
hasExactSynonym: Global developmental delay, moderate
IAO_0000115: A moderate delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

LABEL: Severe global developmental delay
hasExactSynonym: Global developmental delay, severe
IAO_0000115: A severe delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

LABEL: Mild expressive language delay
IAO_0000115: A mild delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.

LABEL: Epidermal thickening
IAO_0000115: Thickening of the epidermal layer of the skin.

LABEL: Abnormal semicircular canal morphology
hasExactSynonym: Morphological abnormality of the semicircular canal
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the morphology of the semicircular canal.

LABEL: Enlarged vestibular aqueduct
hasExactSynonym: Dilated vestibular aqueduct|Widened vestibular aqueduct
IAO_0000115: Increased size of the vestibular aqueduct.

LABEL: Abnormal spinal cord dorsal column morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the dorsal column of the spinal cord
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the dorsal columns, i.e., of the dorsal portion of the gray substance of the spinal cord. The dorsal column consists of the fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus and itself is part of the dorsal funiculus.

LABEL: Abnormal CNS myelination
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal formation of myelin sheaths
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of myelination of nerves in the central nervous system.

LABEL: Forceps delivery
hasExactSynonym: Forceps delivery

LABEL: Ventouse delivery
hasExactSynonym: Vacuum extraction|Vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery
IAO_0000115: Delivery of newborn by means of a ventouse, a vacuum device used to assist the delivery of a baby when the second stage of labor has not progressed adequately.

LABEL: Hyperchloremia
hasExactSynonym: Elevated chloride concentration|Elevated chloride level|Elevated chloride level in blood|Increased chloride concentration|Increased chloride level|Increased chloride level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of chloride in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Short fetal femur length
hasExactSynonym: Short fetal thigh bone length|Short foetal femur length|Short foetal thigh bone length
IAO_0000115: A short femur length is defined as either a measurement below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or a measurement that is less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The femur should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637).

LABEL: Maternal teratogenic exposure
IAO_0000115: A medical history of exposure of the mother of a child or fetus to a teratogenic substance during pregnancy.

LABEL: Abnormal central motor function
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of central motor function
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the control or production of movement in the central nervous system.

LABEL: Abnormality of coordination
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of coordination|Coordination issue

LABEL: Abnormality of mental function
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of higher mental function
IAO_0000115: Cognitive, psychiatric, or memory anomaly.

LABEL: Primary microcephaly
hasExactSynonym: Congenital decreased head circumference|Congenital microcephaly|Congenital small skull|Decreased head circumference present at birth|Microcephaly present at birth|Small cranium present at birth
IAO_0000115: Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender at birth.

LABEL: Abdominal symptom
IAO_0000115: A subjective manifestation of disease localized to the abdomen.

LABEL: Childhood onset
hasExactSynonym: Symptoms begin in childhood
IAO_0000115: Onset of disease at the age of between 1 and 5 years.

LABEL: Gastrostomy tube feeding in infancy
IAO_0000115: Feeding problem necessitating gastrostomy tube feeding.

LABEL: Childhood onset sensorineural hearing impairment
IAO_0000115: Sensorineural hearing impairment with childhood onset.

LABEL: Profound sensorineural hearing impairment
hasExactSynonym: Profound sensorineural hearing loss
IAO_0000115: Complete loss of hearing related to a sensorineural defect.

LABEL: Unilateral microphthalmos
hasExactSynonym: Abnormally small eyeball on one side
IAO_0000115: A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of one eye.

LABEL: Anterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
hasExactSynonym: Anterior synechiae|Cornea-iris adhesion|Iridocorneal adhesions|Iridocorneal synechia
IAO_0000115: Adhesions between the iris and the cornea.

LABEL: Generalized opacification of the cornea
hasExactSynonym: Generalised opacification of the cornea
IAO_0000115: Generalized reduced transparency of the stroma of the cornea.

LABEL: Mydriasis
hasExactSynonym: Dilated pupil
IAO_0000115: Abnormal dilatation of the iris.

LABEL: Bull's eye maculopathy
IAO_0000115: Progressive maculopathy characterized by concentric regions of hyper- and hypopigmentation, with an initial foveal sparing and whose appearance is said to resemble the central target of a dart board.

LABEL: Macular schisis
IAO_0000115: Splitting of the retina in the macular region.

LABEL: Double inlet left ventricle
IAO_0000115: The condition in which both atria are joined to the left ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. Usually there is a hypoplastic right ventricle, which may be on the opposite side of the heart as usual.

LABEL: Common atrium
hasExactSynonym: Single atrium
IAO_0000115: Complete absence of the interatrial septum with common atrioventricular valve and two atrioventricular connections.

LABEL: Cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet
IAO_0000115: Cleft in the anterior mitral valve leaflet not associated with an atrioventricular canal defect.

LABEL: Double aortic arch
IAO_0000115: A conenital abnormality of the aortic arch in which the two embryonic aortc arches form a vascular ring that surrounds the trachea or esophagus and then join to form the descending aorta. Double aortic arch can cause symptoms because of compression of the esophagus (dysphagia, cyanosis while eating) or trachea (stridor).

LABEL: Interrupted aortic arch
hasExactSynonym: Atretic transverse aortic arch
IAO_0000115: Non-continuity of the arch of aorta with an atretic point or absent segment.

LABEL: Muscular ventricular septal defect
hasExactSynonym: Type 4 ventricular septal defect
IAO_0000115: The trabecular septum is the largest part of the interventricular septum. It extends from the membranous septum to the apex and superiorly to the infundibular septum. A defect in the trabecular septum is called muscular VSD if the defect is completely rimmed by muscle.

LABEL: Scimitar anomaly
hasExactSynonym: Pulmonary venolobar syndrome|Scimitar syndrome
IAO_0000115: Right pulmonary venous return to the inferior vena cava.

LABEL: Anomalous origin of coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
IAO_0000115: A coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta.

LABEL: Patent ductus arteriosus after premature birth
IAO_0000115: Abnormal persistent patency of the ductus arteriosus when birth was at less than 37 weeks completed gestation.

LABEL: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent pulmonary valve
hasExactSynonym: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent pulmonary valve syndrome
IAO_0000115: Features of tetralogy of Fallot with either rudimentary ridges or the complete absence of pulmonic valve tissue.

LABEL: Right ventricular cardiomyopathy
hasExactSynonym: Cardiomyopathy, right ventricular
IAO_0000115: Right ventricular dysfunction (global or regional) with functional and morphological right ventricular abnormalities, with or without left ventricular disease.

LABEL: Left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
hasExactSynonym: Left ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy
IAO_0000115: Left ventricular non-compaction (LVNC) is characterized by prominent left ventricular trabeculae and deep inter-trabecular recesses. The myocardial wall is often thickened with a thin, compacted epicardial layer and a thickened endocardial layer. In some patients, LVNC is associated with left ventricular dilatation and systolic dysfunction, which can be transient in neonates.

LABEL: Arrhythmia
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal heart rate|Arrhythmias|Cardiac arrhythmia|Cardiac arrhythmias|Cardiac rhythm disturbances|Heart rhythm disorders|Irregular heart beat|Irregular heartbeat
IAO_0000115: Any cardiac rhythm other than the normal sinus rhythm. Such a rhythm may be either of sinus or ectopic origin and either regular or irregular. An arrhythmia may be due to a disturbance in impulse formation or conduction or both.

LABEL: Perimembranous ventricular septal defect
hasExactSynonym: Conoventricular ventricular septal defect|Membranous ventricular septal defect|Paramembranous ventricular septal defect|Perimembraneous ventricular septal defect|Type 2 ventricular septal defect
IAO_0000115: A ventricular septal defect that is confluent with and involves the membranous septum and is bordered by an atrioventricular valve, not including the type 3 VSDs.

LABEL: First degree atrioventricular block
IAO_0000115: Delay of conduction through the atrioventricular node, which is manifested as prolongation of the PR interval in the electrocardiogram (EKG). All atrial impulses reach the ventricles.

LABEL: Second degree atrioventricular block
IAO_0000115: An intermittent atrioventricular block with failure of some atrial impulses to conduct to the ventricles, i.e., some but not all atrial impulses are conducted through the atrioventricular node and trigger ventricular contraction.

LABEL: Complete right bundle branch block
hasExactSynonym: Right bundle branch block|Right bundle-branch block
IAO_0000115: A conduction block of the right branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a prolongation of the QRS complex (greater than 0.12 s) with delayed activation of the right ventricle and terminal delay on the EKG.

LABEL: Left bundle branch block
IAO_0000115: A conduction block of the left branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a generalized disturbance of QRS morphology on EKG.

LABEL: Abnormality of the pulmonary veins
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of lung veins
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the pulmonary veins.

LABEL: Primary hyperaldosteronism
IAO_0000115: A form of hyperaldosteronism caused by a defect within the adrenal gland.

LABEL: Ectopic posterior pituitary
hasExactSynonym: Ectopic neurohypophysis|Ectopic posterior pituitary lobe
IAO_0000115: An abnormal anatomical location of the posterior lobe of the hypophysis, also known as the neurohypophysis. The posterior pituitary is normally present in the dorsal portion of the sella turcica, but when ectopic is usually near the median eminence. This defect is likely to be due to abnormal migration during embryogenesis.

LABEL: Central hypothyroidism
IAO_0000115: A type of hypothyroidism due to an insufficient stimulation of an otherwise normal thyroid gland. Central hypothyroidism is caused by either pituitary (secondary hypothyroidism) or hypothalamic (tertiary hypothyroidism) defects.

LABEL: Midface retrusion
hasExactSynonym: Decreased size of midface|Flat midface|Hypoplasia of midface|Midface deficiency|Midface hypoplasia|Midface retrusion|Midface, flat|Retrusive midface|Underdevelopment of midface
IAO_0000115: Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle.

LABEL: Hamartoma of tongue
hasExactSynonym: Lingual hamartoma
IAO_0000115: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the tongue.

LABEL: Abnormal muscle physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of muscle physiology|Issue with muscle function
IAO_0000115: A functional abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

LABEL: Abnormal skeletal muscle morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal muscle morphology|Abnormality of muscle morphology|Abnormally shaped muscle|Issue with muscle structure
IAO_0000115: A structural abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

LABEL: Decreased patellar reflex
hasExactSynonym: Decreased knee jerk reflex|Decreased patellar reflexes
IAO_0000115: Decreased intensity of the patellar reflex (also known as the knee jerk reflex).

LABEL: Abnormal facial skeleton morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of facial skeleton|Anomaly of facial skeleton
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of one or more of the set of bones that make up the facial skeleton.

LABEL: Chin with horizontal crease
hasExactSynonym: Chin with horizontal crease|Chin with horizontal furrow|Chin with horizontal groove|Chin with horizontal sulcus|Horizontal chin skin cleft|Horizontal menton crease
IAO_0000115: Horizontal crease or fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin, with the face at rest.

LABEL: Abnormal T cell physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of T cell physiology|Impaired T cell function
IAO_0000115: A functional anomaly of T cells.

LABEL: Ventricular flutter
IAO_0000115: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia characterized by an extremely rapid, hemodynamically unstable ventricular tachycardia (150-300 beats/min) with a large oscillating sine-wave appearance.

LABEL: Abnormal skeletal morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of skeletal morphology|Abnormally shaped skeletal
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the form, structure, or size of the skeletal system.

LABEL: Abdominal colic
IAO_0000115: A type of abdominal pain that comes and goes in waves, most often starting and ending suddenly and being of severe intensity.

LABEL: Reduced factor IX activity
hasExactSynonym: Low factor IX activity
IAO_0000115: Decreased activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

LABEL: Sciatica
IAO_0000115: Pain in the lower back and hip radiating in the distribution of the sciatic nerve.

LABEL: Abnormal platelet function
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly in the function of thrombocytes.

LABEL: Impaired arachidonic acid-induced platelet aggregation
IAO_0000115: Abnormal response to arachidonic acid as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of arachidonic acid.

LABEL: Impaired ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation
IAO_0000115: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin.

LABEL: Impaired thrombin-induced platelet aggregation
IAO_0000115: Abnormal response to thrombin or thrombin mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thrombin (or thrombin mimetics).

LABEL: Abnormal platelet morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal shape of platelets
IAO_0000115: An anomaly in platelet form, ultrastructure, or intracellular organelles.

LABEL: Increased mean platelet volume
hasExactSynonym: Large platelets
IAO_0000115: Average platelet volume above the upper limit of the normal reference interval.

LABEL: Hyphema
IAO_0000115: Bleeding in the anterior chamber of the eye.

LABEL: Impaired thromboxane A2 agonist-induced platelet aggregation
IAO_0000115: Abnormal response to thromboxane as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thromboxane A2 receptor agonists.

LABEL: Hypofibrinogenemia
hasExactSynonym: Low fibrinogen activity|Low fibrinogen level
IAO_0000115: Decreased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

LABEL: Abnormal hemoglobin
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal Hb|Abnormal haemoglobin
IAO_0000115: Anomaly in the level or the function of hemoglobin, the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes.

LABEL: Persistence of hemoglobin F
hasExactSynonym: Increased haemoglobin F|Increased hemoglobin F|Persistence of HbF|Persistence of haemoglobin F
IAO_0000115: Hemoglobin F (HbF) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin gamma chains. It is the main form of hemoglobin in the fetus during the last seven months of intrauterine development and in the half year of postnatal life. In adults it normally makes up less than one percent of all hemoglobin. This term refers to an increase in HbF above this limit. In beta thalassemia major, it may represent over 90 percent of all hemoglobin, and in beta thalassemia minor it may make up between 0.5 to 4 percent.

LABEL: Reduced beta/alpha synthesis ratio
IAO_0000115: A reduction in the ratio of production of beta globin to that of alpha globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of beta thalassemia.

LABEL: Shortening of all phalanges of fingers
hasExactSynonym: Shortening of all finger bones
IAO_0000115: Abnormal reduction in length affecting all phalanges.

LABEL: Lumbar hypertrichosis
IAO_0000115: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the lumbar region.

LABEL: Clinodactyly of the 4th toe
IAO_0000115: Bending or curvature of a fourth toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

LABEL: Abnormal activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
IAO_0000115: An increased or decreased activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.

LABEL: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex I
IAO_0000115: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex I, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

LABEL: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex III
IAO_0000115: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

LABEL: Decreased activity of mitochondrial ATP synthase complex
hasExactSynonym: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex V|Mitochondrial complex V deficiency
IAO_0000115: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, which makes ATP via oxidative phosphorylation, and is sometimes described as Complex V of the electron transport chain.

LABEL: Respiratory tract infection
hasExactSynonym: Respiratory infection|Respiratory tract infection
IAO_0000115: An infection of the upper or lower respiratory tract.

LABEL: Acute infectious pneumonia
IAO_0000115: Acute inflammation of the lung due to an infection.

LABEL: Unusual bronchiolitis
IAO_0000115: Increased susceptibility to bronchiolitis (inflammation of the bronchioles) as manifested by recurrent or severe epsiodes of bronchiolitis.

LABEL: Aspiration pneumonia
IAO_0000115: Pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

LABEL: Non-obstructive azoospermia
hasExactSynonym: Testicular azoospermia
IAO_0000115: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from a defect in the production of spermatozoa in the testes. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.

LABEL: Obstructive azoospermia
IAO_0000115: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from post-testicular obstruction or retrograde ejaculation. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.

LABEL: Feeding difficulties
hasExactSynonym: Decreased oral intake|Feeding difficulties|Feeding problems|Poor feeding
IAO_0000115: Impaired ability to eat related to problems gathering food and getting ready to suck, chew, or swallow it.

LABEL: Myelofibrosis
IAO_0000115: Replacement of bone marrow by fibrous tissue.

LABEL: Atrial septal dilatation
IAO_0000115: A bulging of the interatrial septum towards one side. In adults, atrial septal aneurysm can be defined as a protrusion of the aneurysm of >10 mm beyond the plane of the atrial septum as measured by transesophageal echocardiography.

LABEL: Paranoia
hasExactSynonym: Paranoia
IAO_0000115: The feeling and belief that one is being targeted or is a focus of negative or untoward actions, overt or covert, from others. The affected individual expresses a concern that people are in general against the individual and are engaging in subtle behaviors to make things difficult for them. The origins of such thinking may arise from real events and become amplified over time. Paranoia may also arise in the absence of any action or interaction between the person and their environment.

LABEL: EEG with temporal focal spikes
IAO_0000115: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the temporal region.

LABEL: Lens luxation
hasExactSynonym: Completely dislocated lens|Completely dislocated lenses
IAO_0000115: Complete dislocation of the lens of the eye.

LABEL: Persistent patent ductus venosus
IAO_0000115: Persistence of blood flow through the ductus venosus for longer than the normal time after birth.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating ornithine concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal ornithine level
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal concentration of ornithine in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Hyperornithinemia
hasExactSynonym: Elevated ornithine concentration|Elevated ornithine level|Elevated ornithine level in blood|High blood ornithine levels|Increased ornithine concentration|Increased ornithine level|Increased ornithine level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of ornithine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Aspirin-induced asthma
hasExactSynonym: Aspirin-induced asthma
IAO_0000115: A type of asthma in which aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) that inhibit cyclooxygen-ase 1 (COX-1) exacerbate bronchoconstriction.

LABEL: Decreased circulating calcitriol concentration
hasExactSynonym: Low serum 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol|Low serum 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3|Low serum calcitriol
IAO_0000115: The concentration of calcitriol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Personality disorder
IAO_0000115: A personality disorder is a deeply ingrained pattern of behavior of a specified kind that deviates markedly from the norms of generally accepted behavior. It is typically apparent by the time of adolescence and causes long-term difficulties in personal relationships or functioning in society.

LABEL: Borderline personality disorder
hasExactSynonym: BPD|EUPD|Emotionally unstable personality disorder
IAO_0000115: A personality disorder characterized by impulsive behavior and unpredictable, capricious mood. Affected individuals show a tendency to have outbursts of emotion and an inability to control these behavioral explosions. They generally experience an intense fear of abandonment or instability and also struggle with feelings of emptiness.

LABEL: Abnormal urinary color
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal urinary color|Abnormal urine color|Abnormal urine colour
IAO_0000115: An abnormal color of the urine, that is, the color of the urine appears different from the usual straw-yellow color.

LABEL: Edema of the dorsum of feet
hasExactSynonym: Edema of dorsum of feet|Oedema of dorsum of feet|Oedema of the dorsum of feet
IAO_0000115: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet.

LABEL: Abnormality of the mitochondrion
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration.

LABEL: Rhizomelic leg shortening
IAO_0000115: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the leg (i.e. the femur).

LABEL: Hypoplasia of the pons
hasExactSynonym: Pontine hypoplasia
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of the pons.

LABEL: Hepatitis
hasExactSynonym: Liver inflammation
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the liver.

LABEL: Methylmalonic aciduria
hasExactSynonym: High blood methylmalonic acid levels|Methymalonicaciduria
IAO_0000115: Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine.

LABEL: Erythroid hypoplasia
hasExactSynonym: Erythroblastopenia
IAO_0000115: Decreased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.

LABEL: Reduced quantity of Von Willebrand factor
IAO_0000115: Decreased quantity of von Willebrand factor.

LABEL: Hemophagocytosis
IAO_0000115: Phagocytosis by macrophages of erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets, and their precursors in bone marrow and other tissues.

LABEL: Internal carotid artery dissection
IAO_0000115: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the internal carotid artery wall.

LABEL: Hair-pulling
hasExactSynonym: Trichotillomania
IAO_0000115: A phenomenon in which persons repetitively pull out their own hair, resulting in noticeable hair loss.

LABEL: Self-biting
IAO_0000115: Habitual biting of one's own body.

LABEL: Stereotypical hand wringing
hasExactSynonym: Hand clasping|Hand-wringing|Handwringing
IAO_0000115: Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.

LABEL: Stereotypical body rocking
IAO_0000115: Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.

LABEL: Hyperplastic colonic polyposis
IAO_0000115: Presence of multiple hyperplastic polyps in the colon. Hyperplastic polyps are generally about 5 mm in size and show hyperplastic mucosal proliferation.

LABEL: Constrictive median neuropathy
IAO_0000115: Injury to the median nerve caused by its entrapment at the wrist as it traverses through the carpal tunnel. Clinically, constrictive median neuropathy is characterized by pain, paresthesia, and weakness in the median nerve distribution of the hand.

LABEL: Increased erythrocyte protoporphyrin concentration
IAO_0000115: Concentration of protoporphyrins in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Episodic hemiplegia
IAO_0000115: Transient episodes of weakness of the arm, leg, and in some cases the face on one side of the body.

LABEL: Cluster headache
IAO_0000115: A type of headache characterized by repeated attacks of unilateral pain lasting 15 to 180 minutes and associated with local autonomic signs.

LABEL: Globozoospermia
IAO_0000115: Any structural anomaly of the acrosome resulting in a round sperm head.

LABEL: Reduced sperm motility
hasExactSynonym: Asthenospermia|Asthenozoospermia|Reduced sperm motility
IAO_0000115: An abnormal reduction in the mobility of ejaculated sperm.

LABEL: Abnormal renal morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal kidney morphology|Abnormally shaped kidney|Kidney malformation|Kidney structure issue|Renal malformation|Structural anomalies of the renal tract|Structural kidney abnormalities|Structural renal anomalies
IAO_0000115: Any structural anomaly of the kidney.

LABEL: Abnormal renal physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal kidney function|Abnormal renal function|Abnormality of renal physiology|Kidney function issue|Renal functional abnormality
IAO_0000115: An abnormal functionality of the kidney.

LABEL: Erythema nodosum
IAO_0000115: An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral.

LABEL: Urethral stricture
IAO_0000115: Narrowing of the urethra associated with inflammation or scar tissue.

LABEL: Tension-type headache
hasExactSynonym: Tension-type headache
IAO_0000115: A type of headache that last hours with continuous pain of mild or moderate intensity, bilateral location, a pressing/tightening (non-pulsating) quality and that is not aggravated by routine physical activity such as walking or climbing stairs.

LABEL: Shortened QT interval
IAO_0000115: Decreased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).

LABEL: Absence of circulating granulocytes
hasExactSynonym: Agranulocytosis
IAO_0000115: Absence of detectable circulating granulocytes in the blood. Usually a value of less than 50 cells per microliter is considered to be an absence.

LABEL: Drug-induced agranulocytosis
IAO_0000115: Absence of detectable circulating granulocytes in the blood caused by an exposure to a drug. Usually a value of less than 50 granulocytes per microliter is considered to be an absence.

LABEL: Abnormal sex determination
IAO_0000115: Anomaly of primary or secondary sexual development or characteristics.

LABEL: Sex reversal
IAO_0000115: Development of the reproductive system is inconsistent with the chromosomal sex.

LABEL: Prolonged PR interval
hasExactSynonym: Electrocardiographic long PR interval|Lengthened PR interval on EKG
IAO_0000115: Increased time for the PR interval (beginning of the P wave to the beginning of the QRS complex).

LABEL: Dynein arm defect of respiratory motile cilia
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the dynein arms of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

LABEL: Absent inner and outer dynein arms
IAO_0000115: Complete absence of the dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, that is, absence of the inner and the outer dynein arms, which normally are situated inside and outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

LABEL: Abnormal ciliary motility
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly of the normal motility of motile cilia. Evaluation of ciliary beat frequency and ciliary beat pattern requires high-speed videomicroscopy of freshly obtained ciliary biopsies that are maintained in culture media under controlled conditions.

LABEL: Increased carotid artery intimal medial thickness
IAO_0000115: An increase in the combined thickness of the intima and media of the carotid artery.

LABEL: Digital flexor tenosynovitis
hasExactSynonym: Trigger finger
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the flexor digitorum tendon, often associated with the Kanavel signs: (i) finger held in slight flexion, (ii) fusiform swelling, (iii) tenderness along the flexor tendon sheath, and (iv) pain with passive extension of the digit.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating serine concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal serine level
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal concentration of serine in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Abnormal occipital bone morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the occipital bone
IAO_0000115: Abnormality of the occipital bone of the skull.

LABEL: Hypoplastic aortic arch
hasExactSynonym: Aortic arch hypoplasia|Underdeveloped aortic arch
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of the arch of aorta.

LABEL: Decreased total monocyte count
hasExactSynonym: Low blood monocyte number|Monocytopenia
IAO_0000115: Abnormal decrease of absolute number of monocytes in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

LABEL: Sacroiliac arthritis
hasExactSynonym: Sacroiliitis
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the sacroiliac joint, generally accompanied by lower back pain.

LABEL: Sleep myoclonus
IAO_0000115: Myoclonus that occurs during the initial phases of sleep.

LABEL: Cementoma
IAO_0000115: An odontogenic tumor of the cementum of tooth.

LABEL: Abnormal autonomic nervous system physiology
hasExactSynonym: Autonomic dysfunction|Autonomic dysregulation|Dysautonomia
IAO_0000115: A functional abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.

LABEL: Microprolactinoma
IAO_0000115: A pituitary prolactin cell adenoma of less than 10 mm diameter.

LABEL: Abnormal glycosylation
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of a glycosylation process, i.e., a process involved in the covalent attachment of a glycosyl residue to a substrate molecule.

LABEL: Abnormal protein O-linked glycosylation
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of protein O-linked glycosylation, i.e., of the process in which a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit is added to a protein via the hydroxyl group of a serine or threonine residue.

LABEL: Decreased urinary potassium
hasExactSynonym: Decreased urinary K|Hypokaliuria|Hypokaluria|Low urine potassium levels
IAO_0000115: A decreased concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

LABEL: Basilar invagination
IAO_0000115: Projection of the tip of the dens more than 5 mm above a line joining the hard palate to the posterior lip of the foramen magnum (Chamberlain's line) or the tip of the dens is greater than 7 mm above McGregor's line (the back of the hard palate to the lowest point of the occipital squama).

LABEL: Flat face
hasExactSynonym: Flat face|Flat facial profile|Flat facial shape|Flat facies
IAO_0000115: Absence of concavity or convexity of the face when viewed in profile.

LABEL: Hyperplasia of midface
hasExactSynonym: Midface hyperplasia|Midfacial excess|Midfacial prominence
IAO_0000115: Abnormally anterior positioning of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased convexity of the face, or increased nasolabial angle. The midface includes the maxilla, the cheeks, the zygomas, and the infraorbital and perialar regions of the face

LABEL: Abnormal eye morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal eye structure|Abnormality of the globe|Abnormally shaped eye
IAO_0000115: A structural anomaly of the globe of the eye, or bulbus oculi.

LABEL: Fatigue
hasExactSynonym: Fatigue|Tired|Tiredness
IAO_0000115: A subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.

LABEL: Left-to-right shunt
IAO_0000115: Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from the left side of the heart to the right.

LABEL: Camptodactyly
hasExactSynonym: Permanent flexion of the finger or toe
IAO_0000115: The distal interphalangeal joint and/or the proximal interphalangeal joint of the fingers or toes cannot be extended to 180 degrees by either active or passive extension.

LABEL: Acute bronchitis
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the large airways of the lung with rapid onset and short course usually associated with cough, mucus production, shortness of breath, wheezing, and chest tightness.

LABEL: Appendicular hypotonia
IAO_0000115: Muscular hypotonia of one or more limbs.

LABEL: Anal fissure
IAO_0000115: A small tear in the thin, moist tissue (mucosa) that lines the anus. It appears as a crack or slit in the mucous membrane of the anus.

LABEL: Allergy
hasExactSynonym: Allergy
IAO_0000115: An allergy is an immune response or reaction to substances that are usually not harmful.

LABEL: Peripheral edema
hasExactSynonym: Peripheral oedema
IAO_0000115: An abnormal accumulation of interstitial fluid in the soft tissues of the limbs.

LABEL: Pure red cell aplasia
hasExactSynonym: Red cell aplasia
IAO_0000115: A type of anemia resulting from suppression of erythropoiesis with little or no abnormality of leukocyte or platelet production. Erythroblasts are virtually absent in bone marrow; however, leukocyte and platelet production show little or no reduction.

LABEL: Hypoxemia
hasExactSynonym: Low blood oxygen level
IAO_0000115: An abnormally low level of blood oxygen.

LABEL: Chorioretinitis
IAO_0000115: An inflammation of the choroid and retina.

LABEL: Optic disc drusen
hasExactSynonym: Optic nerve head drusen
IAO_0000115: Optic disc drusen are acellular, calcified deposits within the optic nerve head. Optic disc drusen are congenital and developmental anomalies of the optic nerve head, representing hyaline-containing bodies that, over time, appear as elevated, lumpy irregularities on the anterior portion of the optic nerve.

LABEL: Cerebral white matter hypoplasia
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.

LABEL: Chronic fatigue
hasExactSynonym: Chronic extreme exhaustion|Chronic fatigue
IAO_0000115: Subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation that persists for six months or longer.

LABEL: Delayed early-childhood social milestone development
hasExactSynonym: Delayed milestone development|Delayed social development
IAO_0000115: A failure to meet one or more age-related milestones of social behavior.

LABEL: Abnormal gallbladder physiology
IAO_0000115: A functional anomaly of the gallbladder.

LABEL: Abnormal biliary tract morphology
hasExactSynonym: Anomaly of the biliary tract
IAO_0000115: A structural abnormality of the biliary tree.

LABEL: Abnormal brain morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal shape of brain|Abnormality of brain morphology|Abnormality of the brain
IAO_0000115: A structural abnormality of the brain, which has as its parts the forebrain, midbrain, and hindbrain.

LABEL: Brain atrophy
hasExactSynonym: Brain degeneration|Brain wasting
IAO_0000115: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of brain tissue that was once present.

LABEL: Abnormal myelination
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly in the process by which myelin sheaths are formed and maintained around neurons.

LABEL: Delayed myelination
IAO_0000115: Delayed myelination.

LABEL: Sacroiliac joint synovitis
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the synovial membrane of the sacroiliac joint.

LABEL: Chronic constipation
hasExactSynonym: Chronic constipation|Infrequent bowel movements
IAO_0000115: Constipation for longer than three months with fewer than 3 bowel movements per week, straining, lumpy or hard stools, and a sensation of anorectal obstruction or incomplete defecation.

LABEL: Setting-sun eye phenomenon
hasExactSynonym: Setting-sun eye phenomenon|Sun setting eyes|Sunsetting eye
IAO_0000115: An ophthalmologic sign in young children resulting from upward-gaze paresis. In this condition, the eyes appear driven downward, the sclera may be seen between the upper eyelid and the iris, and part of the lower pupil may be covered by the lower eyelid.

LABEL: Thick vermilion border
hasExactSynonym: Full lips|Increased volume of lip|Increased volume of lip vermillion|Plump lips|Prominent lips|Thick lips
IAO_0000115: Increased width of the skin of vermilion border region of upper lip.

LABEL: Cerebral venous angioma
hasExactSynonym: Developmental Venous Anomaly
IAO_0000115: A congenital malformation of veins which drain normal brain characterized by a caput medusae or an umbrellalike convergence of multiple venules on a single, or occasionally multiple, enlarged parenchymal or medullary vein, like the trunk of a tree or the shank of an umbrella. This dilated terminal vein penetrates the cortex to drain either (a) superficially to cortical veins or sinuses, (b) deeply to subependymal veins of the lateral ventricle and then into the galenic system, (c) to the fourth ventricle and then to the pontomesencephalic vein, or (d) to the precentral cerebellar vein and into the galenic system.

LABEL: Abnormal dense granules
IAO_0000115: Defective structure, size or content of dense granules, platelet organelles that contain granules proaggregatory factors such as adenosine diphosphate (ADP), adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ionized calcium, histamine and serotonin.

LABEL: Middle cerebral artery stenosis
IAO_0000115: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the middle cerebral artery.

LABEL: Descending aortic dissection
hasExactSynonym: Type B aortic dissection
IAO_0000115: A separation of the layers within the wall of the descending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.

LABEL: Lower limb pain
hasExactSynonym: Leg pain|Lower limb pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the leg.

LABEL: Hip flexor weakness
IAO_0000115: Reduced ability to flex the femur, that is, to pull the knee upward.

LABEL: Dilation of Virchow-Robin spaces
hasExactSynonym: Dilated Virchow-Robin spaces|Perivascular spaces
IAO_0000115: Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. Perivascular spaces are commonly microscopic, and not visible on conventional neuroimaging. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually magnetic resonance imaging). The dilatations are regular cavities that always contain a patent artery.

LABEL: Abnormal platelet shape
IAO_0000115: A deviation from the normal discoid platelet shape.

LABEL: Abnormal dense granule content
IAO_0000115: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain adenosine triphosphate (ATP), adenosine diphosphate (ADP), serotonin, calcium, and pyrophosphate, which are secreted when platelets are activated.

LABEL: Pain
hasExactSynonym: Pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.

LABEL: Chronic pain
hasExactSynonym: Chronic pain|Long-lasting pain
IAO_0000115: Persistent pain, usually defined as pain that has lasted longer than 3 to 6 months.

LABEL: Abnormal synaptic transmission
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of neurotransmitter metabolism
IAO_0000115: An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse. This is a four step process, comprising (i) synthesis and storage of neurotransmitters; (ii) neurotransmitter release; (iii) activation of postsynaptic receptors by the neurotransmitter; and (iv) inactivation of the neurotransmitter. Thus, this term is defined as an anomaly of neurotransmitter metabolic process.

LABEL: Fatty replacement of skeletal muscle
hasExactSynonym: Adipose infiltration of muscle|Fatty degeneration of skeletal muscle|Muscle fat infiltration|Myosteatosis|Skeletal muscle fatty infiltration|Steatosis of skeletal muscles
IAO_0000115: Muscle fibers degeneration resulting in fatty replacement of skeletal muscle fibers

LABEL: Global proximal tubulopathy
IAO_0000115: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption with bicarbonate loss and resulting acidosis.

LABEL: Calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis
hasExactSynonym: Ca phosphate nephrolithiasis|Ca phosphate urolithiasis|Ca2+ phosphate nephrolitiasis|Ca2+ phosphate urolithiasis
IAO_0000115: The presence of calcium- and phosphate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

LABEL: Renal atrophy
hasExactSynonym: Kidney degeneration
IAO_0000115: Atrophy of the kidney.

LABEL: Macroscopic hematuria
hasExactSynonym: Bloody urine|Gross hematuria
IAO_0000115: Hematuria that is visible upon inspection of the urine.

LABEL: Abnormal urine output
IAO_0000115: An abnormal amount of urine production.

LABEL: Nephrotic range proteinuria
IAO_0000115: Severely increased amount of excretion of protein in the urine, defined as 3.5 grams per day or more in adults and 40 mg per meter-squared body surface area per hour in children.

LABEL: Moderate albuminuria
hasExactSynonym: High urine albumin levels|Microalbuminuria
IAO_0000115: The presence of moderately increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as and albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) of 30 to 299 mg/gm (3.4 to 34 mg/mmol).

LABEL: Mild proteinuria
IAO_0000115: Mildly increased levels of protein in the urine (150-500 mg per day in adults).

LABEL: Abnormal urine potassium concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal urine K concentration
IAO_0000115: An abnormal concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

LABEL: Abnormal urine sodium concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal urine Na concentration|Abnormal urine Na+ levels
IAO_0000115: An abnormal concentration of sodium in the urine.

LABEL: Abnormal urine cytology
IAO_0000115: An anomalous finding in the examination of the urine for cells.

LABEL: Abnormal trabecular meshwork morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the trabecular meshwork
