IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the trabecular meshwork, which is the porelike structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber at the base of the cornea and near the ciliary body. The trabecular mesh work is responsible for draining the aqueous humor into the canal of Schlemm.

LABEL: Abnormal nervous system physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of nervous system physiology
IAO_0000115: A functional anomaly of the nervous system.

LABEL: Retractile testis
hasExactSynonym: Retractile testicle
IAO_0000115: A testis that is located at the upper scrotum or lower inguinal canal and that can be made to descend completely into the scrotum without resistance by manual reduction but returns to its original position by the cremasteric reflex.

LABEL: Abnormal inflammatory response
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal inflammatory response
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly of the inflammatory response, a response to injury or infection characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages.

LABEL: Increased inflammatory response
IAO_0000115: A abnormal increase in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.

LABEL: Perisylvian polymicrogyria
hasExactSynonym: Frontoparietal polymicrogyria
IAO_0000115: Polymicrogyria (an excessive number of small gyri or convolutions) that is maximal in perisylvian regions (the regions that surround the Sylvian fissures), which may be symmetric or asymmetric and may extend beyond perisylvian regions. The Sylvian fissures often extend posteriorly and superiorly.

LABEL: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
hasExactSynonym: Reduced ejection fraction
IAO_0000115: A diminution of the volumetric fraction of blood pumped out of the ventricle with each cardiac cycle.

LABEL: Vasovagal syncope
hasExactSynonym: Neurocardiogenic syncope|Reflex syncope|Situational syncope|Vasovagal episode
IAO_0000115: A vasovagal episode or vasovagal syncope is the most common form of reflex syncope. Reflex syncope is a general term used to describe types of syncope resulting from a failure in autoregulation of blood pressure, and ultimately, in cerebral perfusion pressure resulting in transient loss of consciousness. The mechanisms responsible for this are complex and involve both depression of cardiac output as well as a decrease in vascular tone.

LABEL: Iron accumulation in brain
hasExactSynonym: Brain iron deposition|Iron accumulation in brain
IAO_0000115: An abnormal build up of iron (Fe) in brain tissue.

LABEL: Abnormal thalamic MRI signal intensity
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus.

LABEL: Widened subarachnoid space
hasExactSynonym: Enlarged subarachnoid space
IAO_0000115: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater.

LABEL: Mild hearing impairment
hasExactSynonym: Mild hearing impairment
IAO_0000115: A mild form of hearing impairment (26-40 dB) in which individuals can hear speech at a normal volume from about one meter away but may struggle with softer sounds, such as whispers or quiet conversations. Understanding speech in noisy environments can also be challenging.

LABEL: Severe hearing impairment
hasExactSynonym: Severe deafness|Severe hearing impairment|Severe hearing loss
IAO_0000115: A severe form of hearing impairment (61-80 dB) in which individuals can only hear a few words spoken at a high volume and experience significant difficulty perceiving speech at normal levels.

LABEL: Profound hearing impairment
hasExactSynonym: Profound hearing impairment
IAO_0000115: A profound (essentially complete) form of hearing impairment (over 80 dB) in which speech is inaudible, even when spoken loudly.

LABEL: Abnormal gastrointestinal tract morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal shape of the digestive system|Morphological abnormality of the GI tract|Morphological abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract|Morphological anomaly of the digestive system
IAO_0000115: Abnormal structure of the gastrointestinal tract.

LABEL: Functional abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
hasExactSynonym: Functional abnormality of the GI tract|GI dysfunction
IAO_0000115: Abnormal functionality of the gastrointestinal tract.

LABEL: Venous malformation
hasExactSynonym: Venous malformations
IAO_0000115: A vascular malformation resulting from a developmental error of venous tissue composed of dysmorphic channels lined by flattened endothelium and exhibiting slow turnover. A venous malformation may present as a blue patch on the skin ranging to a soft blue mass. Venous malformations are easily compressible and usually swell in thewhen venous pressure increases (e.g., when held in a dependent position or when a child cries). They may be relatively localized or quite extensive within an anatomic region.

LABEL: Heart block
IAO_0000115: Impaired conduction of cardiac impulse occurring anywhere along the conduction pathway.

LABEL: Sinoatrial block
IAO_0000115: Disturbance in the atrial activation that is caused by transient failure of impulse conduction from the sinoatrial node to the cardiac atria.

LABEL: Anorectal anomaly
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the anus or rectum.

LABEL: Macule
hasExactSynonym: Flat, discolored area of skin|Flat, discoloured area of skin
IAO_0000115: A flat, distinct, discolored area of skin less than 1 cm wide that does not involve any change in the thickness or texture of the skin.

LABEL: Ketotic hypoglycemia
hasExactSynonym: Ketotic low blood sugar
IAO_0000115: Low blood glucose is accompanied by elevated levels of ketone bodies in the body.

LABEL: Cough
hasExactSynonym: Cough|Coughing
IAO_0000115: A sudden, audible expulsion of air from the lungs through a partially closed glottis, preceded by inhalation.

LABEL: Profound global developmental delay
hasExactSynonym: Global developmental delay, profound
IAO_0000115: A profound delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

LABEL: Unilateral cryptorchidism
hasExactSynonym: Cryptorchidism, unilateral
IAO_0000115: Absence of a testis from the scrotum on one side owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.

LABEL: Abdominal obesity
hasExactSynonym: Abdominal obesity|Central obesity
IAO_0000115: Excessive fat around the stomach and abdomen.

LABEL: Short palpebral fissure
hasExactSynonym: Decreased height of palpebral fissure|Short opening between the eyelids|Short palpebral fissures
IAO_0000115: Distance between the medial and lateral canthi is more than 2 SD below the mean for age (objective); or, apparently reduced length of the palpebral fissures.

LABEL: Abnormal brainstem MRI signal intensity
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem.

LABEL: Abnormal basal ganglia MRI signal intensity
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia.

LABEL: Neurodevelopmental delay
hasExactSynonym: NDD
IAO_0000115: Neurodevelopmental delay (NDD) refers to delays in the maturation of the brain and central nervous system; infants and young children with NDD may experience delays in the development of one or more skills including gross motor abilities, fine-motor coordination, language abilities and ability to solve increasingly complex problems.

LABEL: Neurodevelopmental abnormality
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal of the neurological development of a child, which may include any or all of the aspects of the development of personal, social, gross or fine motor, and cognitive abilities.

LABEL: Reduced social responsiveness
hasExactSynonym: Impaired social interaction|Impaired social interactions|Impaired social reciprocity|Poor social interactions
IAO_0000115: A reduced ability to participate in the back-and-forth flow of social interaction appropriate to culture and developmental level, which is normally characterized by an influence of the behavior of one person on the behavior of another person. This results in difficulty interacting with others through emotional, physical, or verbal communication.

LABEL: Cerebral white matter atrophy
IAO_0000115: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebral white matter.

LABEL: Orthopnea
IAO_0000115: A sensation of breathlessness in the recumbent position, relieved by sitting or standing.

LABEL: Neonatal asphyxia
hasExactSynonym: Asphyxia neonatorum
IAO_0000115: Respiratory failure in the newborn.

LABEL: Anisometropia
IAO_0000115: Inequality of refractive power of the two eyes.

LABEL: Iris transillumination defect
IAO_0000115: Transmission of light through the iris as visualized upon slit lamp examination or infrared iris transillumination videography. The light passes through defects in the pigmentation of the iris.

LABEL: Narrow nasal base
hasExactSynonym: Decreased width of base of nose|Decreased width of nasal base|Narrow base of nose|Narrow nasal base|Thin base of nose|Thin nasal base
IAO_0000115: Decreased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.

LABEL: Wide nasal base
hasExactSynonym: Broad base of nose|Broad nasal base|Increased width of base of nose|Increased width of nasal base|Wide base of nose|Wide nasal base
IAO_0000115: Increased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.

LABEL: Hypoplastic female external genitalia
hasExactSynonym: Underdeveloped female external genitalia
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of part or all of the female external reproductive organs (which include the mons pubis, labia majora, labia minora, Bartholin glands, and clitoris).

LABEL: Noncompaction cardiomyopathy
hasExactSynonym: Noncompaction of the ventricular myocardium|Spongiform cardiomyopathy
IAO_0000115: A type of cardiomyopathy characterized anatomically by deep trabeculations in the ventricular wall, which define recesses communicating with the main ventricular chamber.

LABEL: Biventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
IAO_0000115: Noncompaction cardiomyopathy that affects both ventricles.

LABEL: Severe
hasExactSynonym: Severe
IAO_0000115: Having a high degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between four and five standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.

LABEL: Abnormal scrotal rugation
IAO_0000115: Anomaly of the folded ridges (wrinkles) of skin of the scrotum.

LABEL: Abnormal sperm morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal shape of sperm|Teratospermia|Teratozoospermia
IAO_0000115: A structural anomaly of sperm.

LABEL: Abnormal sperm tail morphology
hasExactSynonym: Sperm tail anomaly
IAO_0000115: A structural abnormality of the sperm tail.

LABEL: Absent vas deferens
hasExactSynonym: Absent deferent duct|Absent ductus deferens|Congenital absence of the vas deferens
IAO_0000115: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the vas deferens.

LABEL: Premature ejaculation
hasExactSynonym: Premature ejaculation
IAO_0000115: The emission of semen and seminal fluid during the act of preparation for sexual intercourse, i.e. before there is penetration, or shortly after penetration.

LABEL: Retrograde ejaculation
IAO_0000115: The emission of semen and seminal fluid into the bladder instead of through the penis during orgasm.

LABEL: Handgrip myotonia
hasExactSynonym: Grip myotonia
IAO_0000115: Difficulty releasing one's grip associated with prolonged first handgrip relaxation times.

LABEL: Myotonia of the upper limb
IAO_0000115: Slowed relaxation of muscles in the arm.

LABEL: Esodeviation
hasExactSynonym: Convergent squint|Convergent strabismus
IAO_0000115: A manifest or latent ocular deviation in which one or both eyes tends to deviate nasally.

LABEL: Accommodative esotropia
IAO_0000115: A form of esotropia (convergent deviation of the eyes) associated with activation of the accommodative reflex.

LABEL: Furuncle
hasExactSynonym: Boil
IAO_0000115: An infection of a hair follicle that extends subcutaneously, forming an abscess.

LABEL: Invasive fungal infection
IAO_0000115: Fungal infection characterized by invasion of host tissues.

LABEL: History of recent insect bite
IAO_0000115: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an insect.

LABEL: Refractory drug response
hasExactSynonym: Drug resistance
IAO_0000115: Absent or significantly reduced efficacy of drug intervention characterized by lack of measurable benefit or deterioration of disease course.

LABEL: Hallux rigidus
hasExactSynonym: Arthritis of the big toe
IAO_0000115: Osteoarthritis of the metatarsophalangeal joint of the first toe.

LABEL: Abnormal brain lactate level by MRS
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal lactate level by magnetic resonance spectroscopy
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal of the level of lactate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

LABEL: Concomitant strabismus
hasExactSynonym: Comitant strabismus
IAO_0000115: Strabismus in which the angle of deviation of the squiting eye remains the same in relation to the other eye, in all directions of gaze, and whichever eye is fixing.

LABEL: Folliculitis
hasExactSynonym: Follicular pustule|Hair follicle inflammation
IAO_0000115: Inflammatory cells within the wall and ostia of the hair follicle, creating a follicular-based pustule.

LABEL: Bloody diarrhea
hasExactSynonym: Bloody bowel movement|Bloody diarrhea
IAO_0000115: Passage of many stools containing blood.

LABEL: Epidermal acanthosis
hasExactSynonym: Acanthosis|Acanthotic epidermis|Thickening of upper layer of skin
IAO_0000115: Diffuse hypertrophy or thickening of the stratum spinosum of the epidermis (prickle cell layer of the skin).

LABEL: Sneeze
IAO_0000115: A sudden violent, spasmodic, audible expiration of breath through the nose and mouth.

LABEL: Fetal distress
hasExactSynonym: Foetal distress
IAO_0000115: An intrauterine state characterized by suboptimal values in the fetal heart rate, oxygenation of fetal blood, or other parameters indicative of compromise of the fetus. Signs of fetal distress include repetitive variable decelerations, fetal tachycardia or bradycardia, late decelerations, or low biophysical profile.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating estrogen level
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal estrogen level|Abnormal oestrogen level
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal concentration of the hormone estrogen in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Constitutional symptom
IAO_0000115: A symptom or manifestation indicating a systemic or general effect of a disease and that may affect the general well-being or status of an individual.

LABEL: Frequent temper tantrums
IAO_0000115: Temper tantrums that occur more frequently compared to the temper tantrums that are a part of the normal developmental process.

LABEL: Abnormal optic chiasm morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of optic chiasm morphology
IAO_0000115: A structural abnormality of the optic chiasm.The optic chiasm, located below the hypothalamus, is a partial crossing of the optic nerves.

LABEL: Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction
IAO_0000115: Abnormal function of the left ventricule during left ventricular relaxation and filling.

LABEL: Posterolateral diaphragmatic hernia
hasExactSynonym: Bochdalek hernia
IAO_0000115: A posterolateral defect in the diaphragm, commonly referred to as a Bochdalek hernia, which is often accompanied by herniation of the stomach, intestines, liver, and/or spleen into the chest cavity.

LABEL: Muscle fiber actin filament accumulation
hasExactSynonym: Muscle fibre actin filament accumulation
IAO_0000115: Accumulation in muscle cells of filaments composed of actin.

LABEL: Parasomnia
hasExactSynonym: Event that disrupts sleep
IAO_0000115: A clinically observable or self-reported abnormal behavior, experience, or physiological event that occurs in association with sleep, specific sleep stages, or sleep-wake transitions.

LABEL: Sleep walking
hasExactSynonym: Sleep walking|Somnambulism
IAO_0000115: Ambulation during sleep with lack awareness and limited or no recall of the event.

LABEL: Trichilemmal cyst
hasExactSynonym: Pilar cyst
IAO_0000115: Nontender, round and firm, but slightly compressible, intradermal or subcutaneous cyst measuring 0.5-5 cm in diameter. Trichilemmal cysts are acquired rather than congenital, and tend to appear on the scalp rather than the face, and to be intradermal rather than subcutaneous.

LABEL: Stiff neck
hasExactSynonym: Neck stiffness|Stiff neck
IAO_0000115: A sensation of tightness in the neck when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity. Neck stiffness often involves soreness and difficulty moving the neck, especially when trying to turn the head to the side.

LABEL: Snoring
hasExactSynonym: Snore|Snores|Snoring symptoms
IAO_0000115: Deep, noisy breathing during sleep, accompanied by hoarse or harsh sounds, is caused by the vibration of respiratory structures, especially the soft palate. This vibration results in sound due to obstructed air movement during breathing while sleeping.

LABEL: Stuttering
hasExactSynonym: Stammering|Stuttering
IAO_0000115: Disruptions in the production of speech sounds, with involuntary repetitions of words or parts of words, prolongations of speech sounds, or complete blockage of speech production for several seconds.

LABEL: Abnormal esophagus physiology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of esophagus physiology|Abnormality of oesophagus physiology|Functional abnormality of the esophagus|Functional abnormality of the oesophagus
IAO_0000115: Any physiological abnormality of the esophagus.

LABEL: Cold-induced sweating
IAO_0000115: Sweating provoked by cold temperature rather than by heat.

LABEL: Cervical lymphadenopathy
hasExactSynonym: Swollen lymph nodes in the neck
IAO_0000115: Enlarged lymph nodes in the neck.

LABEL: Arterial occlusion
IAO_0000115: Blockage of blood flow through an artery.

LABEL: Antepartum hemorrhage
hasExactSynonym: Antepartum haemorrhage|Prepartum haemorrhage|Prepartum hemorrhage
IAO_0000115: Significant maternal hemorrhage/bleed in the second half of pregnancy and prior to the birth of the baby.

LABEL: Delayed ability to stand
IAO_0000115: A failure to achieve the ability to stand up at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children begin to walk alone at 11 to 15 months of age. On average, children can stand while holding on at the age of 9 to 10 months, can pull up to stand and walk with one hand being held at 12 months, and can stand alone and walk well at 18 months.

LABEL: Abnormal cellular phenotype
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of cellular morphology or physiology.

LABEL: Interictal EEG abnormality
IAO_0000115: Interictal refers to a period of time between epileptic seizures. Electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns are important in the differential diagnosis of epilepsy, and the EEG is almost always abnormal during a seizure. Some persons with seizures may show EEG abnormalities between seizures, while others do not. In some cases, multiple interictal EEGs must be recorded before an abnormality is observed. In most cases the electrographic pattern of seizure onset is completely different from the activity recorded during interictal discharge.

LABEL: Hypodipsia
IAO_0000115: Reduced fluid intake (drinking) in a clinical situation where the plasma molarity or sodium concentration normally would induce greater fluid intake.

LABEL: Abnormal larynx morphology
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly of the structure of the larynx.

LABEL: Laryngospasm
IAO_0000115: A spasm (involuntary contraction) of the vocal cords that can make it difficult to speak or breathe.

LABEL: Class III obesity
hasExactSynonym: Obesity grade 3
IAO_0000115: Obesity with a body mass index of 40 kg per square meter or higher.

LABEL: Overweight
IAO_0000115: Increased body weight with a body mass index of 25-29.9 kg per square meter.

LABEL: Hypoplastic hippocampus
hasExactSynonym: Small hippocampus|Underdeveloped hippocampus
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of the hippocampus.

LABEL: Ocular melanocytosis
hasExactSynonym: Melanosis oculi|Ocular melanosis
IAO_0000115: A congenital lesion of the sclera characterized by unilateral patchy but extensive slate-gray or bluish discoloration of the sclera . The conjunctiva are spared.

LABEL: Polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy
IAO_0000115: The presence of aneurysmal 'polypoidal' lesions in the choroidal vasculature. The aneurysmal dilatations, also known as polyps, may be found at subfoveal, juxtafoveal, extrafoveal, peripapillary or even peripheral regions. These polypoidal dilatations may be visible as reddish-orange subretinal nodules during ophthalmoscopic examination. The polypoidal lesions are best detected on indocyanine green angiography (ICGA) and might be associated with a branching vascular network (BVN) of neovascularization.

LABEL: Anhydramnios
IAO_0000115: A complete or near-complete lack of amniotic fluid surrounding a fetus. This finding can be observed sonographically in the third trimesters if the deepest pocket of amniotic fluid is less than or equal to 2 cm.

LABEL: Dyspareunia
IAO_0000115: Recurrent or persistent genital pain associated with sexual intercourse.

LABEL: Struvite nephrolithiasis
hasExactSynonym: Struvite kidney stones
IAO_0000115: Presence of struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate) containing calculi (kidney stones).

LABEL: Tip-toe gait
hasExactSynonym: Tiptoe gait|Toe walking|Walking on tiptoes
IAO_0000115: An abnormal gait pattern characterized by the failure of the heel to contact the floor at the onset of stance during gait.

LABEL: Inguinal freckling
hasExactSynonym: Freckles in groin region
IAO_0000115: The presence in the inguinal region (groin) of an increased number of freckles, small circular spots on the skin that are darker than the surrounding skin because of deposits of melanin.

LABEL: Stiff skin
hasExactSynonym: Indurated skin|Skin induration|Stiff skin
IAO_0000115: An induration (hardening) of the skin

LABEL: Hyperconvex toenail
IAO_0000115: When viewed on end (with the tip of the toe pointing toward the examiner's eye) the curve of the toenail forms a tighter curve of convexity.

LABEL: Sickled erythrocytes
IAO_0000115: An irreversible distortion of the morphology of an erythrocyte such that the cells are elongated and curved, resembling the blade of a sickle (the hand-held agricultural tool traditionally used to harvest grains).

LABEL: Abnormal drinking behavior
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal drinking behavior|Abnormal drinking behaviour
IAO_0000115: Abnormal consumption of fluids with excessive or insufficient consumption of fluid or any other abnormal pattern of fluid consumption.

LABEL: Clinodactyly
hasExactSynonym: Permanent curving of the finger
IAO_0000115: An angulation of a digit at an interphalangeal joint in the plane of the palm (finger) or sole (toe).

LABEL: Abnormal CSF lactate concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal CSF lactate level
IAO_0000115: Abnormal concentration of lactate in the cerebrospinal fluid.

LABEL: Abnormal muscle fiber dystrophin expression
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal muscle fibre dystrophin expression
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal in the amount of dystrophin in muscle fiber tissue. Dystrophin is located at the muscle sarcolemma in a membrane-spanning protein complex that connects the cytoskeleton to the basal lamina.

LABEL: Absent muscle fiber dysferlin
hasExactSynonym: Absent muscle fibre dysferlin
IAO_0000115: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of dysferlin protein in the muscle biopsy.

LABEL: Absent muscle fiber calpain-3
hasExactSynonym: Absent muscle fibre calpain-3
IAO_0000115: Western blot shows complete lack of calpain-3 protein in the muscle biopsy tissue.

LABEL: Reduced muscle fiber perlecan
hasExactSynonym: Reduced muscle fibre perlecan
IAO_0000115: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced perlecan protein in the muscle biopsy. Perlecan is a basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein (HSPG) also known as heparan sulfate proteoglycan 2 (HSPG2).

LABEL: Heart murmur
hasExactSynonym: Cardiac murmur|Cardiac murmurs|Heart murmur|Heart murmurs
IAO_0000115: An extra or unusual sound heard during a heartbeat caused vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart.

LABEL: Cholangitis
hasExactSynonym: Bile duct inflammation
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the biliary ductal system, affecting the intrahepatic or extrahepatic portions, or both.

LABEL: Flank pain
hasExactSynonym: Flank pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the flank.

LABEL: Cervical ectropion
hasExactSynonym: Cervical ectopy
IAO_0000115: Cervical ectropion occurs when eversion of the endocervix exposes columnar epithelium to the vaginal milieu

LABEL: Cervical polyp
hasExactSynonym: Cervical tumor|Cervical tumour
IAO_0000115: Abnormal growth of tissue projecting from a mucous membrane of the endocervix.

LABEL: Cervicitis
hasExactSynonym: Uterine cervicitis|Uterine cervix inflammation
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the uterine cervix.

LABEL: Tetraplegia/tetraparesis
IAO_0000115: Loss of strength in all four limbs. Tetraplegia refers to a complete loss of strength, whereas Tetraparesis refers to an incomplete loss of strength.

LABEL: Kinetic tremor
hasExactSynonym: Essential tremor
IAO_0000115: Tremor that occurs during any voluntary movement. It may include visually or non-visually guided movements. Tremor during target directed movement is called intention tremor.

LABEL: Oral motor hypotonia
IAO_0000115: Reduced muscle tone of oral musculature. In infants, this feature may be associated with difficulties in breast feeding, and may affect the latch, jaw motions, tongue placement, lip seal, suck/swallow/breathe pattern and overall feeding behavior.

LABEL: Fatigable weakness of swallowing muscles
IAO_0000115: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in swallowing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

LABEL: Slow pupillary light response
hasExactSynonym: Sluggish pupillary reaction|Sluggish pupillary reactions to light
IAO_0000115: Reduced velocity and acceleration in the pupillary light response.

LABEL: Visual agnosia
IAO_0000115: The condition is known as visual agnosia, which refers to the inability to recognize objects that are visually presented, even though the individual may have normal visual field, acuity, color vision, brightness discrimination, language, and memory.

LABEL: Central core regions in muscle fibers
hasExactSynonym: Central core regions in muscle fibres
IAO_0000115: The presence of disorganized areas called cores in the center of muscle fibers. There is a typical appearance of the biopsy on light microscopy, where the muscle cells have cores that are devoid of mitochondria and specific enzymes. Cores are typically well demarcated and centrally located, but may occasionally be multiple and of eccentric.

LABEL: Highly elevated creatine kinase
hasExactSynonym: Highly elevated CPK|Highly elevated creatine phosphokinase|Highly elevated serum CK|Highly elevated serum CPK|Highly elevated serum phosph-CK
IAO_0000115: An increased CPK level between 4X and 50X above the upper normal level.

LABEL: Abnormality of muscle size
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of muscle size
IAO_0000115: Abnormalities of the overall muscle bulk based on clinical observation.

LABEL: Hypoplasia of deltoid muscle
hasExactSynonym: Deltoid muscle hypoplasia
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of the deltoid muscle.

LABEL: Portal vein thrombosis
hasExactSynonym: Blood clot in portal vein
IAO_0000115: Thrombosis of the portal vein and/or its tributaries, which include the splenic vein and the superior and inferior mesenteric veins.

LABEL: Microphallus
IAO_0000115: Length of penis more than 2 SD below the mean for age accompanied by hypospadias.

LABEL: Ectopic scrotum
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal scrotum position
IAO_0000115: Scrotum in a position other than the usual position inferior to the base of the penis.

LABEL: Hypoplastic anterior commissure
IAO_0000115: Underdevelopment of the anterior commissure.

LABEL: Weakness of facial musculature
hasExactSynonym: Decreased facial muscle strength|Decreased strength of facial muscles|Face weakness|Facial muscle weakness|Facial weakness|Myasthenia of facial muscles|Reduced facial muscle strength|Weakness of face|Weakness of facial musculature
IAO_0000115: Reduced strength of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).

LABEL: Erythematous papule
IAO_0000115: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid that is reddish (erythematous) in color.

LABEL: Induced vaginal delivery
IAO_0000115: Vaginal delivery following induction of labor, a procedure used to stimulate uterine contractions during pregnancy before labor begins on its own.

LABEL: Abnormal platelet aggregation
IAO_0000115: An abnormality in the rate and degree to which platelets aggregate after the addition of an agonist that stimulates platelet clumping. Platelet aggregation is measured using aggregometer to measure the optical density of platelet-rich plasma, whereby platelet aggregation causes the plasma to become more transparent.

LABEL: Renal transitional cell carcinoma
hasExactSynonym: Renal urothelial carcinoma|Transitional renal cell carcinoma|renal TCC
IAO_0000115: A malignant tumor that arises from the transitional (urothelial) epithelial cells lining the urinary tract from the renal calyces to the ureteral orifice.

LABEL: Splenic cyst
hasExactSynonym: Cyst on spleen
IAO_0000115: A closed sac located in the spleen.

LABEL: Fibrofolliculoma
hasExactSynonym: Fibrofolliculomas
IAO_0000115: Fibrofolliculoma is a clinically asymptomatic, 2-4 mm, skin-colored, dome-shaped smooth papule. It usually arises in the form of multiple lesions in adults in different areas such as the scalp, forehead, face, and neck. According to histology, the lesion is a fibrotic hamartoma characterized by infundibular epithelial proliferation and perifollicular fibrous proliferation.

LABEL: Retinal neovascularization
hasExactSynonym: Retinal vascular proliferation
IAO_0000115: In ischemic retinal disease, neovascularization (NV) involves the sprouting of new vessels from pre-existent vessels. Ischemia invariably leads to the upregulation of Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF) production. Most frequently the new vessels grow internal to the plane of the retina. However, intraretinal proliferation of new vessels can also occur.

LABEL: Abnormal cardiovascular system morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of cardiovascular system morphology|Cardiovascular malformations
IAO_0000115: Any structural anomaly of the heart and blood vessels.

LABEL: Left ventricular noncompaction
IAO_0000115: Left ventricular noncompaction (LVNC) is defined by 3 markers: prominent left ventricular (LV) trabeculae, deep intertrabecular recesses, and the thin compacted layer.

LABEL: Right atrial enlargement
hasExactSynonym: Dilated right atrium|Enlarged heart right atrium|Right atrial dilatation
IAO_0000115: Increase in size of the right atrium.

LABEL: Intraventricular hemorrhage
hasExactSynonym: Intraventricular haemorrhage
IAO_0000115: Bleeding into the ventricles of the brain.

LABEL: Preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
hasExactSynonym: Preterm intraventricular haemorrhage
IAO_0000115: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a premature infant.

LABEL: Grade I preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
hasExactSynonym: Germinal matrix haemorrhage|Germinal matrix hemorrhage|Grade I preterm intraventricular haemorrhage
IAO_0000115: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that is restricted to subependymal region/germline matrix which is seen in the caudothalamic groove.

LABEL: Tooth abscess
hasExactSynonym: Dental abscess|Dentoalveolar abscess
IAO_0000115: A pocket of pus located within a region of a tooth.

LABEL: Ear pain
hasExactSynonym: Ear pain|Otalgia|Pain in the ear
IAO_0000115: Pain in the ear can be a consequence of otologic disease (primary or otogenic otalgia), or can arise from pathologic processes and structures other than the ear (secondary or referred otalgia).

LABEL: Modic type vertebral endplate changes
IAO_0000115: An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate according to a widely used classification published by Dr. Michael Modic.

LABEL: Increased circulating interleukin 6 concentration
hasExactSynonym: Increased serum IL-6|Increased serum interleukin-6
IAO_0000115: The concentration of interleukin-6 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Abnormal jaw morphology
IAO_0000115: A structural anomaly of the jaw, the bony structure of the mouth that consists of the mandible and the maxilla.

LABEL: Mizuo phenomenon
hasExactSynonym: Mizuo-Nakamura phenomenon
IAO_0000115: Change in the color of the fundus from red in the dark-adapted state to golden immediately or shortly after the onset of the light. The color of the fundus reflex in the light adapted state has also been described as golden-yellow, gray-white, and yellow-white. This reflex can appear either homogeneous or in streaks in the fundus. The retinal vessels appear to be protruding in contrast to the radiant background. Dark adaptation leads to disappearance of the unusual fundus coloration [Digital Journal of Ophthalmology 2008; Volume 14, Number 14].

LABEL: Wheezing
hasExactSynonym: Wheezing
IAO_0000115: A high-pitched whistling sound associated with labored breathing.

LABEL: Neck pain
hasExactSynonym: Neck pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the neck.

LABEL: Shoulder pain
hasExactSynonym: Shoulder pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the shoulder.

LABEL: Hip pain
hasExactSynonym: Hip pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the hip.

LABEL: Knee pain
hasExactSynonym: Knee pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the knee.

LABEL: High pulse pressure
IAO_0000115: Increased amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure).

LABEL: Heterotaxy
hasExactSynonym: Heterotaxia
IAO_0000115: An abnormality in which the internal thoraco-abdominal organs demonstrate abnormal arrangement across the left-right axis of the body.

LABEL: Abnormal cardiac ventricular function
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the cardiac ventricular function.

LABEL: Abnormality on pulmonary function testing
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal pulmonary function test
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly measure by pulmonary function testing, which includes spirometry, measures of diffusing capacity, and plethysmography.

LABEL: Hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
hasExactSynonym: White matter hyperintensity
IAO_0000115: A brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter.

LABEL: Abnormal gastrointestinal motility
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal GI motility
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the muscular contractions that propel food though the gastrointestinal tract.

LABEL: Decreased intestinal transit time
IAO_0000115: A reduction in the length of time required for food to pass through the intestines.

LABEL: Abnormal peristalsis
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the wave-like muscle contractions of the digestive tract.

LABEL: Addictive alcohol use
hasExactSynonym: Alcohol addiction|Alcoholism
IAO_0000115: An addictive behavior is defined as drinking excessive amounts of alcohol over a prolonged period of time, having difficulty in reducing the amount of alcohol consumed, strongly desiring alcohol, and experiencing withdrawal symptoms when not drinking alcohol.

LABEL: Abnormality of cardiovascular system electrophysiology
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the electrical conduction physiology of the heart.

LABEL: Microspherophakia
IAO_0000115: Microspherophakia is a rare congenital anomaly characterized by the abnormal spherical shape of the crystalline lens. It is characterized by an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens associated with reduced equatorial diameter. The primary pathology lies in the development of zonules. The condition is often bilateral and is characterized by small, thick, and spherical lenses.

LABEL: Abnormal systemic blood pressure
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal systemic BP
IAO_0000115: A chronic deviation from normal pressure in the systemic arterial system.

LABEL: Cryptozoospermia
hasExactSynonym: Cryptospermia
IAO_0000115: A type of oligozoospermia in which spermatozoa can be detected in an ejaculate only after centrifugation and inspection of the pellet.

LABEL: Elevated circulating mucin 16 concentration
hasExactSynonym: Elevated carcinoma antigen 125 level|Elevated circulating CA-125 concentration|Elevated mucin-16 concentration|Elevated mucin-16 level|Elevated mucin-16 level in blood|Increased mucin-16 concentration|Increased mucin-16 level|Increased mucin-16 level in blood|Increased plasma CA125
IAO_0000115: The concentration of mucin-16 (also known as CA-125) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Spermatogenesis maturation arrest
hasExactSynonym: Meiotic maturation arrest of spermatogenesis
IAO_0000115: Maturation arrest (MA) is defined as germ cells that fail to complete maturation. Uniform MA is characterized by spermatogenic arrest at the same stage of spermatogenesis throughout the seminiferous tubules. MA is subcategorized into early MA, in which only spermatogonia or spermatocytes are found, and late MA, in which spermatids are detected without spermatozoa.

LABEL: Spermatocyte maturation arrest
hasExactSynonym: Spermatocyte arrest|Spermatocyte meiotic arrest|Spermatocytic arrest
IAO_0000115: A type of spermatogenesis maturation arrest in which the block of developmental occurs in the spermatocyte stage. Testicular histology shows seminiferous tubules with Sertoli cells, spermatogonial cells and spermatocytes but no further differentiated cells like round spermatids.

LABEL: Paraproteinemia
hasExactSynonym: Monoclonal hypergammaglobulinemia
IAO_0000115: An abnormal immunoglobulin or part of an Ig (light chain) in the circulation. Paraproteins are typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.

LABEL: Impaired feeding ability
IAO_0000115: Applies to an individual who needs partial or total help with feeding or requires parenteral feeding.

LABEL: Empty ovarian follicle
IAO_0000115: A failure to collect oocytes after an apparently normal controlled ovarian hyperstimulation cycle for in vitro fertilization.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating thyroid-stimulating hormone concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal TSH level|Abnormal circulating thyrotropin concentration|Abnormal thyrotropin level
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland.

LABEL: Two-raphe bicuspid aortic valve
IAO_0000115: A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of two raphes that each extend from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV has developmental anlagen of three cusps, commissures, and sinuses, but two commissures are more or less malformed and obliterated, giving rise to a raphe, a fibrous ridge, which extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV is typically associated with a high degree of aortic stenosis.

LABEL: Multifocal seizures
hasExactSynonym: Multifocal onset seizures
IAO_0000115: Seizures that start from several different areas of the brain (i.e., with multiple ictal onset locations).

LABEL: Abnormal morphology of left ventricular trabeculae
IAO_0000115: Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).

LABEL: Hepatic hemangioma
hasExactSynonym: Hemangioma of the liver|Liver hemangioma
IAO_0000115: A congenital vascular malformation in the liver composed of masses of blood vessels that are atypical or irregular in arrangement and size.

LABEL: Hot flashes
IAO_0000115: Sudden feelings of warmth that are generally most pronounced over the face, neck and chest.

LABEL: Whooping cough
IAO_0000115: A type of cough characterized by a burst of numerous and rapid coughs followed by a long inhaling effort that is accompanied by a high-pitched whooping sound produced by the inhalation of air.

LABEL: Delirium
hasExactSynonym: Altered consciousness or cognition
IAO_0000115: A state of sudden and severe confusion.

LABEL: Shock
IAO_0000115: The state in which profound and widespread reduction of effective tissue perfusion leads first to reversible, and then if prolonged, to irreversible cellular injury.

LABEL: Flushing
IAO_0000115: Recurrent episodes of redness of the skin together with a sensation of warmth or burning of the affected areas of skin.

LABEL: Cutaneous abscess
hasExactSynonym: Skin abscess
IAO_0000115: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the skin (within the epidermis or dermis).

LABEL: Left atrial enlargement
hasExactSynonym: Enlarged heart left atrium
IAO_0000115: Increase in size of the left atrium.

LABEL: Interstitial cardiac fibrosis
IAO_0000115: A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in interstitial spaces.

LABEL: Dextrotransposition of the great arteries
hasExactSynonym: D-TGA|D-loop transposition of the great arteries
IAO_0000115: A type of transposition of the great arteries (TGA) in which aorta is in front of and primarily to the right of the pulmonary artery. This is the most common kind of TGA.

LABEL: Ecchymosis
hasExactSynonym: Ecchymoses
IAO_0000115: A purpuric lesion that is larger than 1 cm in diameter.

LABEL: Abnormal chromosome morphology
IAO_0000115: Any structural anomaly of a chromosome, which is a thread like molecule consisting of DNA and proteins (chromatin) that contains DNA sequences for genes and other genetic elements in linear order.

LABEL: Short telomere length
IAO_0000115: An abnormal reduction in telomere length. Telomeres are non-coding, repetitive sequences of DNA at the ends of the chromosomes of eukaryotic cells which become shorter as cells divide, and when telomere attrition reaches its limit, cell proliferation arrest, senescence, and apoptosis can occur.

LABEL: Ectopic pregnancy
IAO_0000115: A pregnancy in which the fertilized egg inserts in a location outside of the main cavity of the uterus (usually in the Fallopian tube).

LABEL: Adenoiditis
IAO_0000115: An inflammation of the adenoid tissue.

LABEL: Abnormal mitral valve physiology
IAO_0000115: Any functional anomaly of the mitral valve.

LABEL: Continuous spike and waves during slow sleep
hasExactSynonym: CSWS|Electrical status epilepticus during slow-wave sleep
IAO_0000115: Diffuse, bilateral and recently also unilateral or focal localization spike-wave occurring in slow sleep or non-rapid eye movement sleep.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating thyroid hormone concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal thyroid hormone level
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal range of the hormones produced by the thyroid gland.

LABEL: Abnormal meiosis
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly of meiosis, a type of cell division that reduces the number of chromosomes in the parent cell by half and produces four gamete cells.

LABEL: Aborted sudden cardiac death
hasExactSynonym: Sudden cardiac arrest
IAO_0000115: Cardiac arrest that would have led to rapid and unexpected death had an intervention not taken place to prevent it.

LABEL: Atherosclerotic lesion
IAO_0000115: A lesion associated with atherosclerosis, a multifactorial and multipart progressive disease manifested by the focal development within the arterial wall of lesions, that ranges from the development of a fatty streak, plaque progression, and plaque disruption. Atherosclerotic lesions demonstrate consistent morphological characteristics, which indicate that each type may stabilize temporarily or permanently and that progression to the next type may require an additional stimulus.

LABEL: Abnormal stool composition
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal faeces composition|Abnormal feces composition
IAO_0000115: Abnormal level of metabolite or other abnormal analyte result in a stool test.

LABEL: Opportunistic infection
IAO_0000115: An infection that is caused by a pathogen that would generally not be able to cause an infection in a host with a normal immune system. Such pathogens take advantage of the opportunity, so to speak, that is provided by a weakened immune system.

LABEL: Severe adenovirus infection
IAO_0000115: An unusually severe adenovirus infection.

LABEL: Abnormal ear morphology
IAO_0000115: Any structural anomaly of the ear.

LABEL: Non-accomodative esotropia
IAO_0000115: A form of esotropia in which the angle of deviation is not affected by accommodative effort.

LABEL: Vocal cord dysfunction
IAO_0000115: Any functional anomaly of the vocal cord.

LABEL: Abnormal reflex
IAO_0000115: Any anomaly of a reflex, i.e., of an automatic response mediated by the nervous system (a reflex does not need the intervention of conscious thought to occur).

LABEL: Decreased serum zinc
IAO_0000115: A reduced concentration of zinc in the blood.

LABEL: Euphoria
hasExactSynonym: Euphoric mood|Extreme elation|Inappropriate elation
IAO_0000115: Elevation of emotional tone or mood that significantly deviates from normative affective functioning. This state is characterized by an overwhelming and all-encompassing sense of joyous well-being; it is associated with unfounded grandiosity, or grossly inflated self-esteem, rapid speech, impulsivity, and an impaired capacity for self-regulation, irrespective of context.

LABEL: Abnormal heart rate variability
IAO_0000115: Any abnormality in the variability of the time interval between successive heartbeats.

LABEL: Delayed ability to walk
hasExactSynonym: Delayed walking
IAO_0000115: A failure to achieve the ability to walk at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children learn to walk in a series of stages, and learn to walk short distances independently between 12 and 15 months.

LABEL: Elevated circulating aspartate aminotransferase concentration
hasExactSynonym: Aspartate aminotransferase increased|Elevated serum AST|Elevated serum aspartate aminotransferase|Elevated serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase
IAO_0000115: The concentration of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Arm dystonia
IAO_0000115: A type of dystonia (abnormally increased muscular tone causing fixed abnormal postures) that affects muscles of the arms.

LABEL: Elevated circulating alanine aminotransferase concentration
hasExactSynonym: Alanine aminotransferase increased|Elevated serum ALT|Elevated serum alanine aminotransferase|Elevated serum glutamic-pyruvic transaminase
IAO_0000115: An abnormally high concentration in the circulation of alanine aminotransferase (ALT).

LABEL: Diminished ability to concentrate
hasExactSynonym: Concentration problems|Labored thinking|Lack of concentration|Poor concentration
IAO_0000115: The inability to focus or concentrate on a specific task, activity, or object. The subject may find themselves unable to grasp or understand written text and re-reads frequently without understanding. Familiar tasks or activities are severely compromised due to the lack of ability to concentrate. Thinking through multi-step problems is typically very difficult or impossible, leading to avoidance of such activities.

LABEL: Abnormal sputum
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal sputum morphology
IAO_0000115: Abnormal appearance of material expectorated (coughed up) from the respiratory system and that is composed of mucus but may contain other substances such as pus, blood, microorganisms, and fibrin.

LABEL: Decreased circulating alpha-1-antitrypsin concentration
hasExactSynonym: Decreased alpha-1-antitrypsin concentration|Decreased alpha-1-antitrypsin level|Decreased alpha-1-antitrypsin level in blood|Reduced alpha-1-antitrypsin concentration|Reduced alpha-1-antitrypsin level|Reduced alpha-1-antitrypsin level in blood|Reduced serum alpha-1-antitrypsin
IAO_0000115: The concentration of alpha-1-antitrypsin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Focal cortical dysplasia
IAO_0000115: A type of malformation of cortical development that primarily affects areas of neocortex. It can be identified on conventional magnetic resonance imaging as focal cortical thickening, abnormal gyration, and blurring between gray and white matter, often associated with clusters of heterotopic neurons.

LABEL: Mild malformation of cortical development
IAO_0000115: A malformation of cortical development characterized by mild abnormalities of the cortex: excessive heterotopic neurons in Layer 1 or microscopic neuronal clusters or excess of single neurons of normal morphology in deep white matter.

LABEL: Popliteal synovial cyst
hasExactSynonym: Baker's cyst
IAO_0000115: A fluid-filled mass that is a distention of a preexisting bursa in the popliteal fossa, most commonly the gastrocnemio-semimembranosus bursa. This bursa is unique in that it communicates with the knee joint, unlike other periarticular bursae, via an opening in the joint capsule posterior to the medial femoral condyle.

LABEL: Precordial pain
IAO_0000115: A type of chest pain that arises in the or under the left breast and often described as throbbing, stabbing, or burning, and lasting hours or longer. The pain may arise with or after effort, and may spread to the left arm or left side of the neck.

LABEL: Joint subluxation
IAO_0000115: A partial dislocation of a joint.

LABEL: Abdominal cramps
IAO_0000115: A type of abdominal pain characterized by a feeling of contractions and typically fluctuating in intensity.

LABEL: Skin detachment
hasExactSynonym: Detached skin|Epidermal detachment|Skin sloughing
IAO_0000115: Loss of sections of skin either spontaneously or after gentle handling.

LABEL: Abnormal meniscus morphology
IAO_0000115: Abnormal structure of the meniscus of the knee, two crescent shape fibrocartilaginous pads that disperse the weight of the body and reduce friction of the knee joint during movement.

LABEL: Granuloma
IAO_0000115: A compact, organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes, which may be but is not necessarily accompanied by accessory features such as necrosis.

LABEL: Increased blood pressure
hasExactSynonym: Increased BP
IAO_0000115: Abnormal increase in blood pressure. An individual measurement of increased blood pressure does not necessarily imply hypertension. In practical terms, multiple measurements are recommended to diagnose the presence of hypertension.

LABEL: Increased total granulocyte count
hasExactSynonym: Granulocytosis
IAO_0000115: An increased count of granulocytes in the peripheral blood circulation.

LABEL: Sulfocysteinuria
IAO_0000115: A increased concentration of sulfocysteine in the urine.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating growth hormone concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal growth hormone level|Abnormal somatotropin level
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal level of growth hormone (GH) in the blood circulation. GH or somatotropin is a peptide hormone that stimulates growth, cell reproduction, and cell regeneration. Its secretion from the pituitary is regulated by the neurosecretory nuclei of the hypothalamus, which can release Growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH or somatocrinin) and Growth hormone-inhibiting hormone (GHIH or somatostatin) into the hypophyseal portal venous blood surrounding the pituitary. GH is secreted in a pulsatile manner, which is one of the reasons why an isolated measurement of its blood concentration is not meaningful.

LABEL: Duffy blood group
IAO_0000115: The Duffy blood group system is based on the presence of a glycoprotein termed Fy that is on the surface of erythrocytes and some other cells. There are two Duffy antigens named Fya and Fyb, and thus there are four Duffy phenotypes: a+b+, a+b-, a-b+,a-b-.

LABEL: Periventricular laminar heterotopia
IAO_0000115: A large mass of heterotopia in a laminar configuration along the ventricular walls. Usually bilateral.

LABEL: Citrullinuria
hasExactSynonym: Citrulline high in urine
IAO_0000115: The amount of citrulline in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

LABEL: Breast mass
hasExactSynonym: Breast lump
IAO_0000115: A breast lump is any discrete mass in a breast noticed by the patient, significant other, or physician.

LABEL: Pulmonary bulla
hasExactSynonym: Pulmonary bullae
IAO_0000115: Pulmonary bullae are rounded focal regions of emphysema with a thin wall which measure more than 1 cm in diameter. They are often subpleural in location and are typically larger in the apices. In some cases, bullae can be very large and result in compression of adjacent lung tissue. A giant bulla is arbitrarily defined as one that occupies at least one third of the volume of a hemithorax. When large, bullae can simulate pneumothorax. The most common cause is paraseptal emphysema but bullae may also be seen in association with centrilobular emphysema.

LABEL: Preimplantation lethality
hasExactSynonym: Early embryonic arrest|Preimplantation embryonic lethality
IAO_0000115: It is estimated that about 40-70 percent of human embryos produced in vitro fertilization (IVF) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) are viable embryos, whereas others arrest at different early stages of development. The phenotype of preimplantation lethality is inferred if IVF and ICSI cycles fail because all of an individual's embryos are arrested at early stages of development.

LABEL: Low intraocular pressure
hasExactSynonym: Ocular hypotony
IAO_0000115: An abnormal decrease of the pressure within the eye.

LABEL: Renal tubular epithelial cell apoptosis
IAO_0000115: Increased apoptosis (programmed cell death) of tubular epithelial cells. The cells are rounded with increased eosinophilia and contain fragmented, densely basophilic nuclear debris.

LABEL: Convulsive status epilepticus
hasExactSynonym: Tonic-clonic status epilepticus
IAO_0000115: A type of status epilepticus characterized by a prolonged bilateral tonic-clonic seizure, or repeated bilateral tonic-clonic seizures without recovery between.

LABEL: Neonatal seizure
IAO_0000115: A seizure occurring within the neonatal period (28 days beyond the full term date).

LABEL: Diffuse alveolar damage
IAO_0000115: Diffuse alveolar damage (DAD) describes a common histologic injury pattern of the lung. The early stages are characterized by epithelial cell necrosis and sloughing, fibrous exsudate, edema, and hyaline membranes made of surfactant and proteins, filling the alveoli. This results in impaired gas exchange. In later stages, type II cells and myofibroblasts proliferate within the interstitium and airspaces. The corresponding clinical entity is acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). DAD may result from pulmonary drug toxicity, occurs in immunosuppressed, severe viral infections, acute interstial pneumonitis, and crack cocaine inhalation.

LABEL: Non-epileptic seizure
hasExactSynonym: Functional seizure|Psychogenic non-epileptic seizure|Psychosomatic seizure
IAO_0000115: Psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (PNES) are not abnormal perceptions or abnormal beliefs/judgments, nor are they epileptic attacks. They are behaviors that simulate epileptic attacks, not fully consciously.

LABEL: Abnormality of the musculoskeletal system
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the musculoskeletal system, which consists of the bones of the skeleton, muscles, cartilage, tendons, ligaments, joints, and other connective tissue. The musculoskeletal system supports the weight of the body, maintains body position and produces movements of the body or of parts of the body.

LABEL: Renal cortical hyperechogenicity
IAO_0000115: Increased echogenecity of the kidney cortex.

LABEL: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
hasExactSynonym: SUDEP
IAO_0000115: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) is a sudden, unexpected, witnessed or unwitnessed, non-traumatic and non-drowning death, occurring in benign circumstances, in an individual with epilepsy, with or without evidence for a seizure and excluding documented status epilepticus, in which postmortem examination has not revealed a cause of death.

LABEL: Systemic autoinflammation
IAO_0000115: Dysregulation of the innate immune system characterized by systemic pathobiology, i.e., with symptoms that can affect the entire body.

LABEL: Tube feeding
IAO_0000115: Feeding problem necessitating food and nutrient delivery via a tube.

LABEL: Abnormal cardiac output
IAO_0000115: A deviation from normal Cardiac output, which is defined as the amount of blood pumped by the heart minute and is the mechanism whereby blood flows around the body, especially providing blood flow to the brain and other vital organs.

LABEL: Hypoesthesia
hasExactSynonym: Hypoaesthesia|Numbness
IAO_0000115: Decreased ability to perceive touch.

LABEL: Fetal anomaly
IAO_0000115: Structural or functional abnormalities of the fetus. Note that this section comprises terms that describe abnormalities that are specific to the fetus or differ from the corresponding general terms. A term from anywhere in the Human Phenotype Ontology can be applied to a fetus if appropriate.

LABEL: Prenatal death
hasExactSynonym: Death before birth|Intrauterine death
IAO_0000115: Death of a fetus in the uterus.

LABEL: Enteroviral encephalitis
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the brain related to infection by an enterovirus.

LABEL: Cognitive regression
IAO_0000115: Loss of cognitive developmental skills, as manifested by loss of developmental cognitive milestones.

LABEL: Fetal alcohol exposure
hasExactSynonym: Alcohol during pregnancy|Alcohol exposure before birth|Alcohol exposure during gestation|Alcohol exposure during pregnancy|Alcohol exposure in pregnancy|Alcohol use during pregnancy|Antenatal ETOH exposure|Antenatal alcohol exposure|Exposure to alcohol during gestation|Exposure to alcohol in the womb|Exposure to alcohol in utero|Prenatal ETOH exposure|Prenatal alcohol exposure|Prenatal exposure to ETOH|Prenatal exposure to alcohol
IAO_0000115: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to ethanol (alcohol).

LABEL: Abnormal nasal hair morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of nasal hair|Abnormality of nose hair

LABEL: Abnormality of limbs
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal limbs|Abnormality of limbs|Limb anomaly

LABEL: Abnormal upper limb bone morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal morphology of bones of the upper limbs|Abnormal shape of bones of the upper limbs|Abnormality of upper limb bone

LABEL: Irregular dentition
hasExactSynonym: Irregular teeth

LABEL: Happy demeanor
hasExactSynonym: Happy demeanor|Happy demeanour
IAO_0000115: A conspicuously happy disposition, characterized by frequent smiling and laughing, which may be contextually inappropriate or unrelated to the situation.

LABEL: obsolete Toe walking
IAO_0000115: Toe walking is a pattern of walking in which a person walks on balls of his or her feet, with no contact between the heels and ground. Toe-walking is common in children who are learning to walk, but most children outgrow it around the age of two years. This term refers to the persistence of toe-walking beyond the usual age.

LABEL: Periostitis
hasExactSynonym: Periostalgia
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the periosteum

LABEL: Platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase deficiency
IAO_0000115: Reduced level of platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase.

LABEL: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia
IAO_0000115: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia is a nonparoxysmal tachyarrhythmia characterized by an increased resting heart rate (HR) and/or an exaggerated HR response to minimal exertion or a change in body posture. HR is constantly above the physiological range with no appropriate relation to metabolic or physiological demands.

LABEL: Encopresis
hasExactSynonym: Stool holding|Stool soiling

LABEL: Macrothrombocytopenia
hasExactSynonym: Macrothrombozytopenia

LABEL: Neonatal sepsis
IAO_0000115: Systemic inflammatory response to infection in newborn babies.

LABEL: Osteochondrosis
IAO_0000115: Abnormal growth ossification centers in children. Initially a degeneration/ necrosis followed by regeneration or recalcification.

LABEL: Scaling skin
hasExactSynonym: Desquamation|Scaling skin|Scaly skin|flaking skin|peeling skin
IAO_0000115: Refers to the loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes.

LABEL: Decreased head circumference
hasExactSynonym: Decreased head circumference
IAO_0000115: An abnormally reduced head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart. Microcephaly is defined as a head circumference (HC) that is great than two standard deviations below the mean of age- and gender-matched population based samples. Severe microcephaly is defined with an HC that is three standard deviations below the mean.

LABEL: Mild microcephaly
IAO_0000115: Decreased occipito-frontal (head) circumference (OFC). For the microcephaly OFC must be between -3 SD and -2 SD compared to appropriate, age matched, normal standards (i.e. -3 SD <= OFC < -2 SD).

LABEL: Hypopnea
hasExactSynonym: Shallow breathing
IAO_0000115: Hypopnea is referring to breathing that is abnormally shallow.

LABEL: Hypoinsulinemia
IAO_0000115: A decreased concentration of insulin in the blood.

LABEL: Pulmonary hemorrhage
hasExactSynonym: Intrapulmonary haemorrhage|Intrapulmonary hemorrhage|Pulmonary haemorrhage
IAO_0000115: Pulmonary hemorrhage is a bleeding within the lungs. Older children and adults may spit blood or bloody sputum. Neonates, infants and young children usually do not spit up blood. Anemia, pulmonary infiltrates, increasingling bloody return on BAL and the presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in broncho-alveolar lavage (BAL) fluid or lung biopsy can diagnose lung bleeding. Alveolar macrophages contain phagocytosed red blood cells and stain positive for hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, after about 48-72 hours following pulmonary hemorraghe. Previous or recurrent bleeding can thus be distinguished from fresh events. A differentiation into local or diffuse is of importance. Also differentiate if pulmonary hemorrhage is due to a primary lung disorder or a manifestation of a systemic disease.

LABEL: Factor XIII subunit A deficiency
hasExactSynonym: Reduced factor XIII, subunit A
IAO_0000115: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit A, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.

LABEL: Blocked Eustachian tube
hasExactSynonym: Obstruction of Eustachian tube

LABEL: Impaired glucose tolerance
hasExactSynonym: Decreased glucose tolerance|Glucose tolerance decreased
IAO_0000115: An abnormal resistance to glucose, i.e., a reduction in the ability to maintain glucose levels in the blood stream within normal limits following oral or intravenous administration of glucose.

LABEL: Hyperplasia of the endometrium
hasExactSynonym: Hyperplastic endometrium

LABEL: Ageusia
hasExactSynonym: Absent sense of taste|Impaired taste sensation|Lost taste
IAO_0000115: A rare condition that is characterized by a complete loss of taste function of the tongue.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal LDH level|Abnormal circulating LDH concentration|Abnormal lactate dehydrogenase level|AbnormalLDH level
IAO_0000115: A deviation from the normal serum concentration/activity of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), which catalyzes the reduction of pyruvate to form lactate.

LABEL: Decreased circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
hasExactSynonym: Acid-labile subunit deficiency|Decreased insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit concentration|Decreased insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level|Decreased insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level in blood|Decreased levels of acid labile subunit|Reduced insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit level|Reduced insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit concentration|Reduced insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level|Reduced insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level in blood
IAO_0000115: The concentration of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Hyperkeratotic papule
IAO_0000115: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point that is composed of localized hyperkeratosis (the latter may be demonstrated histopathologically).

LABEL: Sparse eyebrow
hasExactSynonym: Hypotrichosis of eyebrow|Sparse eyebrow|Sparse eyebrows
IAO_0000115: Decreased density/number of eyebrow hairs.

LABEL: Limb myoclonus
hasExactSynonym: Myoclonus of limbs

LABEL: Epiretinal membrane
hasExactSynonym: Cellophane maculopathy|Macular pucker|Premacular fibrosis|Surface wrinkling retinopathy
IAO_0000115: An epiretinal membrane is a thin sheet of fibrous tissue on the surface of the retina along the inner limiting membrane. It appears as a greyish semi-translucent avascular membrane over the internal limiting membrane (ILM) on the surface of the retina.

LABEL: Abnormality of movement
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of movement|Movement disorder|Unusual movement
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of movement with a neurological basis characterized by changes in coordination and speed of voluntary movements.

LABEL: Recurrent hand flapping
IAO_0000115: A type of repetitive behavior in which the affected individual repeatedly waves the hands and/or arms rhythmically.

LABEL: Conspicuously happy disposition
hasExactSynonym: Conspicious happy aspect|Happy aspect
IAO_0000115: An unusually happy demeanor over time, which can also be observed during inappropriate situations that should, for example, cause distress, fear, or anger.

LABEL: Recurrent pancreatitis
hasExactSynonym: Recurring pancreas inflammation|Recurring pancreatitis
IAO_0000115: A recurrent form of pancreatitis.

LABEL: Accessory ectopic thyroid tissue
IAO_0000115: Accessory ectopic thyroid tissue arising from remnants of the thyroglossal duct anywhere along the path of the thyroglossal duct tract.

LABEL: Tics
hasExactSynonym: Tic disorder
IAO_0000115: Repeated, individually recognizable, intermittent movements or movement fragments that are almost always briefly suppressible and are usually associated with awareness of an urge to perform the movement.

LABEL: Motor tics
IAO_0000115: Movement-based tics affecting discrete muscle groups.

LABEL: Phonic tics
hasExactSynonym: Verbal tics|Vocal tics
IAO_0000115: Tics are defined as movements or sounds that resemble physiological motor behaviors, but are typically inopportune to social context and appear sudden, repetitive, and often exaggerated. Tic vocalizations commonly termed vocal or phonic tics may include any possible sound (eg, sniffing, coughing, throat clearing, whistling, or grunting), word, or sentence and are most commonly encountered within the spectrum of primary tic disorders, as Tourette syndrome.

LABEL: Pseudo-fractures
hasExactSynonym: Looser zones
IAO_0000115: A band of bone material of decreased density forming alongside the surface of the cortical bone with thickening of the periosteum. Callus formation in the affected area is common and gives the appearance of a false fracture.

LABEL: Calcification of muscles
hasExactSynonym: Skeletal muscle calcinosis
IAO_0000115: Deposition of calcium salts in muscle tissue.

LABEL: Metaphyseal dysplasia
IAO_0000115: The presence of dysplastic regions in metaphyseal regions.

LABEL: Senile plaques
hasExactSynonym: Braindruse|Neuritic plaques|Senile druse
IAO_0000115: Senile plaques are extracellular deposits of amyloid in the gray matter of the brain.

LABEL: Ectrodactyly
hasExactSynonym: Cleft hand|Lobster claw hand
IAO_0000115: A condition in which middle parts of the hands and/or feet (digits and meta-carpals and -tarsals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic 3rd toe/fingers over absent 2nd or 3rd toes/fingers as far as oligo- or monodactyl hands and/or feet.

LABEL: Lip pit
IAO_0000115: A depression located on a lip.

LABEL: Chronic colitis
IAO_0000115: A chronic inflammatory disease of the large intestine (colon, cecum and rectum).

LABEL: EMG: myotonic discharges
IAO_0000115: High frequency discharges in electromyography (EMG) that vary in amplitude and frequency, waxing and waning continuously with firing frequencies ranging from 150/second down to 20/second and producing a sound that has been referred to as a dive bomber sound.

LABEL: Muscle fiber inclusion bodies
hasExactSynonym: Muscle fibre inclusion bodies

LABEL: Muscle fiber hyaline bodies
hasExactSynonym: Muscle fibre hyaline bodies
IAO_0000115: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions in the cytoplasm of muscle fibers. Hyaline bodies show significant reactivity to myofibrillar ATPase after acid pre-incubation and with immunohistochemistry, show intense reactivity with only slow myosin heavy chain. Electron microscopy of the affected areas show a lack of myofibrils and a uniform, finely granular matrix, sometimes suggesting a filamentous nature, containing few scattered nuclei and mitochondria.

LABEL: Subdural hemorrhage
hasExactSynonym: Subdural haematoma|Subdural haemorrhage|Subdural hematoma
IAO_0000115: Hemorrhage occurring between the dura mater and the arachnoid mater.

LABEL: Scleroderma
hasExactSynonym: Progressive systemic scleroderma|Pseudoscleroderma
IAO_0000115: A chronic autoimmune phenomenon characterized by fibrosis (or hardening) and vascular alterations of the skin.

LABEL: Bilateral cleft palate
hasExactSynonym: Bilateral palatoschisis|Right and left cleft palate
IAO_0000115: Nonmidline cleft palate on the left and right sides.

LABEL: Hypoammonemia
IAO_0000115: A decreased concentration of ammonia in the blood.

LABEL: Recurrent bronchiolitis
IAO_0000115: An increased susceptibility to bronchiolitis as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchiolitis.

LABEL: Decreased circulating vitamin B12 concentration
hasExactSynonym: Vitamin B12 deficiency
IAO_0000115: The concentration of vitamin B12 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Decreased circulating vitamin B2 concentration
hasExactSynonym: Low levels of vitamin B2|Riboflavin deficiency|Vitamin B2 deficiency
IAO_0000115: The concentration of vitamin B2 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Abnormality of vitamin metabolism
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of vitamin metabolism
IAO_0000115: An anomaly in the metabolism of a vitamin.

LABEL: Decreased circulating vitamin D concentration
hasExactSynonym: Deficient in vitamin D|Low levels of vitamin D|Vitamin D deficiency
IAO_0000115: The concentration of vitamin D in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

LABEL: Liver abscess
hasExactSynonym: Hepatic abscess|Liver abscess|Purulent hepatic collection
IAO_0000115: A localized, circumscribed collection of purulent material (pus) within the liver parenchyma, typically resulting from a bacterial, parasitic, or fungal infection. Unlike hepatitis, which is often diffuse, an abscess is a focal lesion.

LABEL: Neoplasm of the lung
hasExactSynonym: Lung tumor|Lung tumour
IAO_0000115: Tumor of the lung.

LABEL: Abnormal circulating phosphate ion concentration
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal blood phosphate concentration|Abnormal phosphate ion level|Abnormality of phosphate homeostasis
IAO_0000115: Any deviation from the normal concentration of phosphate ion in the blood circulation.

LABEL: Episcleritis
hasExactSynonym: Inflammation of the thin layer on top of the white part of eye
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the episclera, a thin layer of tissue covering the white part (sclera) of the eye.

LABEL: Fasciitis
hasExactSynonym: Inflammation of the fascia
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of fascia, the tissue under the skin and over the muscle.

LABEL: Cognitive impairment
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of cognition|Cognitive abnormality|Cognitive defects|Cognitive deficits|Cognitive impairment|Intellectual impairment
IAO_0000115: Abnormal cognition is characterized by deficits in thinking, reasoning, or remembering.

LABEL: Arterial stenosis
hasExactSynonym: Narrowing of an artery
IAO_0000115: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of an artery.

LABEL: Tendon rupture
hasExactSynonym: Rupture of tendons|Ruptured tendon|Tendon rupture|Tendon/muscle rupture
IAO_0000115: Breakage (tear) of a tendon.

LABEL: Lower limb asymmetry
hasExactSynonym: Left and right leg differ in length or width
IAO_0000115: A difference in length or diameter between the left and right leg.

LABEL: Upper limb asymmetry
hasExactSynonym: Unequal size of arms
IAO_0000115: Difference in length or size between the right and left arm.

LABEL: Neoplasm of the endocrine system
hasExactSynonym: Endocrine neoplasia
IAO_0000115: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the endocrine system.

LABEL: Lipoatrophy
hasExactSynonym: Atrophy of fat|Loss of fat tissue in localised area|Loss of fat tissue in localized area
IAO_0000115: Localized loss of fat tissue.

LABEL: Nasal polyposis
hasExactSynonym: Nasal polyps|Polyposis nasi|Polyps of nose
IAO_0000115: Polypoidal masses arising mainly from the mucous membranes of the nose and paranasal sinuses. They are freely movable and nontender overgrowths of the mucosa that frequently accompany allergic rhinitis.

LABEL: Endocarditis
IAO_0000115: An inflammation of the endocardium, the inner layer of the heart, which usually involves the heart valves.

LABEL: Telangiectasia of the skin
hasExactSynonym: Teleangiectasia of the skin
IAO_0000115: Presence of small, permanently dilated blood vessels near the surface of the skin, visible as small focal red lesions.

LABEL: Camptocormia
IAO_0000115: An abnormal forward-flexed posture e.g. forward flexion of the spine, which is noticeable when standing or walking but disappears when lying down. It is becoming an increasingly recognized feature of Parkinson's disease and dystonic disorders.

LABEL: Eclampsia
IAO_0000115: An acute and life-threatening complication of pregnancy, which is characterized by the appearance of tonic-clonic seizures, usually in a patient who had developed pre-eclampsia. Eclampsia includes seizures and coma that happen during pregnancy but are not due to preexisting or organic brain disorders.

LABEL: Dysmenorrhea
hasExactSynonym: Painful menstruation
IAO_0000115: Pain during menstruation that interferes with daily activities.

LABEL: Metrorrhagia
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal uterus bleeding|Intermenstrual bleeding|Menstrual spotting
IAO_0000115: Bleeding at irregular intervals.

LABEL: Death in early adulthood
hasExactSynonym: Death in early adulthood
IAO_0000115: Death between the age of 16 and 40 years.

LABEL: Midline facial cleft
hasExactSynonym: Midline facial cleft
IAO_0000115: A congenital malformation with a cleft (gap or opening) in the midline of the face.

LABEL: Esophagitis
hasExactSynonym: Inflammation of the esophagus|Inflammation of the oesophagus|Oesophagitis
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the esophagus.

LABEL: Cellulitis
hasExactSynonym: Bacterial infection of skin|Skin infection
IAO_0000115: A bacterial infection and inflammation of the skin und subcutaneous tissues.

LABEL: Abnormal cerebral vascular morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the cerebral blood vessels|Abnormality of the cerebral vasculature
IAO_0000115: An anomaly of the cerebral blood vessels.

LABEL: Dyskinesia
hasExactSynonym: Disorder of involuntary muscle movements|Dyskinesis
IAO_0000115: A movement disorder which consists of effects including diminished voluntary movements and the presence of involuntary movements.

LABEL: Intestinal duplication
hasExactSynonym: Bowel duplication
IAO_0000115: A developmental disorder in which there is a duplication the entire intestine or of a portion of the intestine.

LABEL: Vaginal hydrocele
IAO_0000115: A type of hydrocele testis in which the processus vaginalis remains patent only around the testes, and, as fluid accumulates, it renders the testes impalpable.

LABEL: Tibial torsion
IAO_0000115: Twisted position of the tibia (shin bone) associated with pathological rotation of the leg.

LABEL: Subcutaneous neurofibroma
IAO_0000115: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the subcutis (subcutaneous region).

LABEL: Scarring
hasExactSynonym: Scarring
IAO_0000115: A scar refers to a lesion in which wound, burn, or sore has not healed completely and fibrous connective tissue has developed.

LABEL: Cerebral visual impairment
hasExactSynonym: CVI|Cortical blindness|Cortical visual impairment|Cortical/cerebral visual impairment
IAO_0000115: A form of loss of vision caused by damage to the visual cortex rather than a defect in the eye.

LABEL: Self-injurious behavior
hasExactSynonym: Autoagression|Self injury|Self-harm|Self-injurious behavior|Self-injurious behaviors|Self-injurious behaviours
IAO_0000115: Self-aggression.

LABEL: Hypercoagulability
hasExactSynonym: Blood hyperviscosity|Thrombophilia
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of coagulation associated with an increased risk of thrombosis.

LABEL: Histiocytosis
IAO_0000115: An excessive number of histiocytes (tissue macrophages).

LABEL: Transverse facial cleft
hasExactSynonym: Lateral facial cleft
IAO_0000115: A horizontal cleft of the face, varying from slight widening of the mouth, to a cleft extending to the ear.

LABEL: Abnormal soft palate morphology
hasExactSynonym: Abnormality of the muscular palate|Abnormality of the soft palate|Abnormality of the velum|Abnormality of the velum palatinum
IAO_0000115: An abnormality of the soft palate.

LABEL: Abnormal eating behavior
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal eating behavior|Abnormal eating behaviour
IAO_0000115: Abnormal eating habits involve excessive or insufficient consumption of food, or any other abnormal pattern of food consumption.

LABEL: Chest pain
hasExactSynonym: Chest pain|Thoracic pain
IAO_0000115: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the chest.

LABEL: Abnormality of salivation
hasExactSynonym: Abnormal spit|Abnormality of salivation

LABEL: Clubbing of fingers
hasExactSynonym: Clubbed fingers|Clubbing (hands)|Clubbing of fingers|Finger clubbing
IAO_0000115: Terminal broadening of the fingers (distal phalanges of the fingers).

LABEL: Abnormality of the lymphatic system
