LABEL: mosquito bite reaction size measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of the size of a mosquito bite reaction, generally through the use of a standardised questionnaire

LABEL: P wave terminal force measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of P wave terminal force, the product of the duration and the amplitude of the terminal negative part of the P-wave

LABEL: perceived unattractiveness to mosquitos measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of an individual's perceived unattractiveness to mosquitos, generally through the use of a standardised questionnaire

LABEL: total cortical area measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of the surface area of the cerebral cortex, the largest region of the mammalian brain

LABEL: TP53 mutation status
IAO_0000115: quantification of some aspect of TP53 mutation, such as the number of accummulated mutations, determined either through immunohistochemistry or DNA sequencing

LABEL: treatment outcome measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of some treatment outcome

LABEL: visual acuity measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of visual acuity

LABEL: body odor measurement
hasExactSynonym: body odour measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of body odor, a perceived unpleasant smell given off by the body

LABEL: caudate nucleus measurement
hasExactSynonym: caudate measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of the caudate nucleus, part of the basal ganglia of the brain, primarily associated with voluntary movement and reward.

LABEL: gamma wave measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the wave-like oscillations in the alpha band (8-13 Hz) of electric potential between parts of the brain

LABEL: prothrombin time measurement
hasExactSynonym: International normalized ratio of prothrombin time measurement|PT/INR measurement|ProTime INR measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the clotting tendency of blood plasma following the addition of tissue factor. Prothrombin time requires the presence of factors I, II, V, VII, and X. It measures the extrinsic pathway of coagulation and can be used in conjunction with the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) which measures the intrinsic pathway. It is used as a screening test and can be affected by vitamin K deficiency, liver disease, warfarin therapy or intestinal problems.

LABEL: erythropoetin measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the glycoprotein erythropoetin typically in the blood

LABEL: triiodothyronine measurement
hasExactSynonym: T3 measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the thyroid hormone triiodothyronine (T3) typically in the blood, usually as an indicator of thyroid function

LABEL: reaction time measurement
IAO_0000115: In psychology, the quantification of the interval of time between the presentation of a stimulus to a subject and the beginning of the subject's response to that stimulus. Several categories of reaction time, such as simple reaction time and choice reaction time, have been established and studied in experimental psychology to assess general alertness and motor speed.

LABEL: verbal-numerical reasoning measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of verbal and/or numerical reasoning, typically based on a written or multiple choice test

LABEL: response to darapladib
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of darapladib stimulus. Darapladib is a  lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 inhibitor, developed for the treatment of cardiovascular disease.

LABEL: response to reward
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a reward stimulus such as food or recreational drugs.

LABEL: response to disappointment
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of anticipating a reward stimulus such as food or recreational drugs, which is subsequently withheld.

LABEL: T wave morphology measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the morphology of the T wave, the part of the electrocardiograph that represents the repolarisation or recovery of the ventricles

LABEL: mean fractional anisotropy measurement
hasExactSynonym: fractional anisotropy
IAO_0000115: A quantitative parameter derived from diffusion tensor imaging that measures the degree of directional preference of water molecule diffusion within a tissue. Fractional anisotropy (FA) values range from 0 (isotropic diffusion) to 1 (highly directional diffusion) and provide information about tissue microstructure, fiber organization, and structural integrity. This measurement can be applied to various biological tissues including brain white matter, skeletal muscle, kidney, and other organs.

LABEL: susceptibility to chickenpox measurement
hasExactSynonym: susceptibility to varicella zoster virus infection measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to chickenpox, resulting from results from primary Varicella zoster virus infection, typically occurring in childhood.

LABEL: susceptibility to shingles measurement
hasExactSynonym: susceptibility to herpes zoster measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to shingles, a pinaful rash resultin from reactivation of latent Varicella zoster virus infection within a dorsal root ganglion, typically occuring in later life.

LABEL: susceptibility to cold sores measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to cold sores, vesicular lesions of the lips and mouth caused by another member of the human herpesvirus family, herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1)

LABEL: susceptibility to mononucleosis measurement
hasExactSynonym: susceptibility to glandular fever measurement|susceptibility to infectious mononucleosis measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to infectious mononucleosis, a syndrome of fever, tonsillitis, swollen lymph nodes, and persistent fatigue resulting from primary infection with the Epstein-Barr virus.

LABEL: susceptibility to mumps measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to mumps, a syndrome of low-grade fever, malaise, headache, and characteristic swelling of the parotid glands that is caused by the mumps virus

LABEL: susceptibility to hepatitis B infection measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to hepatitis B

LABEL: susceptibility to plantar warts measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to plantar warts

LABEL: susceptibility to Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis

LABEL: susceptibility to scarlet fever measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to scarlet fever, a syndrome of rash, sore throat and fever caused by Group A Streptococcal infection

LABEL: susceptibility to pneumonia measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to pneumonia, an infection of the lung tissue, typically by bacteria or viruses

LABEL: susceptibility to bacterial meningitis measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to bacterial meningitis

LABEL: susceptibility to vaginal yeast infection measurement
hasExactSynonym: susceptibility to Candida vulvovaginitis measurement|susceptibility to thrush measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to vaginal yeast infection or thrush, typically by Candida albicans or other Candida species.

LABEL: susceptibility to measles measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to measles

LABEL: susceptibility to hepatitis A infection measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to hepatitis A

LABEL: susceptibility to rheumatic fever measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to rheumatic fever, arising as a complication of primary infection with Group A Streptococcus

LABEL: susceptibility to common cold measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to the common cold

LABEL: susceptibility to rubella infection measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to shingles

LABEL: susceptibility to chronic sinus infection measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of an individual's susceptibility to chronic sinus infections, requiring surgery.

LABEL: non-alcoholic fatty liver disease severity measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the severity of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, typically by a histological grading.

LABEL: IgG monogalactosylation measurement
hasExactSynonym: IgG mono-galactosylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of monogalactosylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG digalactosylation measurement
hasExactSynonym: IgG di-galactosylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of digalactosylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG galactosylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of galactosylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG bisecting N-acetyl glucosamine measurement
hasExactSynonym: IgG GlcNAc measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of bisecting N-acetyl glucosamine-containing N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG fucosylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of fucosylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG sialylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of sialylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG disialylation measurement
hasExactSynonym: IgG di-sialylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of disialylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: IgG monosialylation measurement
hasExactSynonym: IgG mono-sialylation measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of monosialylated N-glycans of IgG in a biological sample, typically serum

LABEL: maximal voluntary ventilation
IAO_0000115: Qunatification of the maximum volume of air that an organism can breathe in and out during a specified period of time, often 1 minute.

LABEL: lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A(2) change measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the rate of change in lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A(2) over the course of time, used as an indicator of risk of cardiovascular events, and a target for certain cardiovascular drugs.

LABEL: pursuit maintenance gain measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the accuracy of matching eye velocity to target velocity during sustained pursuit, typically measured using a video-based eye tracker. Abnormalities of this system have been observed in psychiatric disoreders such as aschizophrenia.

LABEL: initial pursuit acceleration
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the rate of change of eye velocity during the first 100ms of pursuit, typically measured using a video-based eye-tracker. Abnormalities of this sysmtem have been observed in psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia.

LABEL: gestational weight gain measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of weight gained by a woman during pregnancy.

LABEL: late gestational weight gain
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of weight gained by a woman during late pregnancy.

LABEL: early gestational weight gain
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of weight gained by a woman during early pregnancy.

LABEL: single cell nucleic acid sequencing protocol
IAO_0000115: A protocol describing the processes performed and equipment used to determine the order of nucleotide bases in a nucleic acid sample from a single cell specimen

LABEL: tag based single cell RNA sequencing
IAO_0000115: Single cell sequencing process using an approach where only a short fragment (tag) at a defined position in each RNA molecule is sequenced

LABEL: full length single cell RNA sequencing
IAO_0000115: Single cell sequencing process using an approach where the full length of each RNA molecule is sequenced

LABEL: Smart-seq2 protocol
IAO_0000115: The standard protocol supplied by Illumina for single cell nucleic acid sequencing

LABEL: 10x sequencing protocol
IAO_0000115: The standard protocol supplied by 10x Genomics for single cell nucleic acid sequencing

LABEL: Drop-seq sequencing protocol
IAO_0000115: The standard protocol defined by Macosko et al for isolating and sequencing the nucleic acid material from single cell specimens

LABEL: platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio
hasExactSynonym: platelet:lymphocyte ratio
IAO_0000115: The ratio of platelet count to lymphocyte count, quantified in a blood sample. Both neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio have been proposed as biomarkers for the diagnosis or prognostic prediction of disease.

LABEL: neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio
hasExactSynonym: neutrophil:lymphocyte ratio
IAO_0000115: The ratio of neutrophil count to lymphocyte count, quantified in a blood sample. Both neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio have been proposed as biomarkers for the diagnosis or prognostic prediction of disease.

LABEL: magnesium:creatinine ratio measurement
IAO_0000115: quantification of the ratio of magnesium to creatinine in a sample, typically a urine sample, a proxy measure for Mg2+ homeostasis

LABEL: fractional excretion of magnesium measurement
hasExactSynonym: FEMg
IAO_0000115: quantification of fractional excretion of magnesium based on the calculation of serum and urinary levels of magneiusm and creatinine. Used as a marker of renal tubular function.

LABEL: activities of daily living score measurement
hasExactSynonym: ADL|Katz ADL index
IAO_0000115: quantification of ability to perform daily living activities independently. A proxy to assess functional status in the elderly.

LABEL: mid-arm muscle circumference measurement
hasExactSynonym: MAMC
IAO_0000115: quatification of the muscle circumference of the mid arm. A proxy for muscle mass of the arm.

LABEL: calf circumference measurement
hasExactSynonym: CC
IAO_0000115: quatification of the muscle circumference of the calf. A proxy for muscle mass of the leg.

LABEL: short physical performance battery score measurement
hasExactSynonym: SPPB
IAO_0000115: quantification of physical performance. A proxy to assess lower extremity function in the elderly.

LABEL: sleep apnea measurement during REM sleep
IAO_0000115: A pause in breathing or shallow breaths during REM sleep.

LABEL: sleep apnea measurement during non-REM sleep
IAO_0000115: A pause in breathing or shallow breaths during non-REM sleep.

LABEL: cannabis dependence measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the degree to which an individual is dependent on cannabis, for example based on the number of DSM-IV criteria met for cannabis dependence.

LABEL: tacrolimus measurement
hasExactSynonym: tacrolimus hydrate measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of tacrolimus in a sample.  Tacrolimus (TAC) is a common immunosuppressive agent that potently inhibits T-cell function and proliferation through inhibition of calcineurin by binding to FKB12.

LABEL: response to mepolizumab
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of mepolizumab stimulus. Mepolizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of severe eosinophilic asthma.

LABEL: colorectal health
IAO_0000115: The characteristics of a person?s colorectal health, assessed for example by colonoscopy.

LABEL: pregnancy induced alloimmunization
hasExactSynonym: Rh-isoimmunization|maternal alloimmunization
IAO_0000115: An immune response to foreign (donor) antigens due to fetomaternal hemorrhage (ie, transplacental passage of fetal erythrocytes) associated with delivery, trauma, spontaneous or induced abortion, ectopic pregnancy, or invasive obstetric procedures.

LABEL: glucagon measurement
IAO_0000115: The quantification of glucagon, a hormone involved in glucose homeostasis.

LABEL: glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide measurement
IAO_0000115: The quantification of glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide, an incretin hormone secreted in response to nutrient stimulation that acts to increase insulin secretion.

LABEL: glucagon-like peptide-1 measurement
IAO_0000115: The quantification of glucagon-like peptide 1, an incretin hormone secreted in response to nutrient stimulation that acts to increase insulin secretion.

LABEL: behavioural inhibitory control measurement
hasExactSynonym: inhibitory control measurement
IAO_0000115: Some quantification of the ability to inhibit maladaptive or inappropriate behavior.

LABEL: midregional pro atrial natriuretic peptide measurement
hasExactSynonym: MR-proANP
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the levels of midregional pro atrial natriuretic peptide.

LABEL: B-type natriuretic peptide to N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide ratio
hasExactSynonym: BNP:NT-proBNP ratio
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the ratio of B-type natriuretic levels to N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide levels.

LABEL: dietary potassium intake measurement
IAO_0000115: Quatification of dietary potassium intake by measuring 24 hr urinary potassium levels.

LABEL: cardiac stress biomarker measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some protein which is used as a measure of heart failure.

LABEL: insulin response measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of insulin response, typically measuring insulin levels in the blood following a glucose challenge

LABEL: mood instability measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantifiication of some aspect of mood instability.

LABEL: delayed reward discounting measurement
hasExactSynonym: delay discounting measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of impulsivity related to the increased perceived value of immediate gratification as compared to a larger future reward. The more remote the future reward, the lower its perceived present value (the more it is discounted) and the less likely it is to be chosen.

LABEL: genomic DNA
hasExactSynonym: gDNA
IAO_0000115: The DNA that is part of the normal chromosomal complement of an organism.

LABEL: mitochondrial DNA
hasExactSynonym: mtDNA
IAO_0000115: Typically small, circular, intronless, and maternally inherited, mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) is the multicopy deoxyribonucleic acid genome of mitochondria, intracellular organelles responsible for vital respiratory chain and oxidative phosphorylation reactions in higher eukaryotes. Replicated and transcribed by a separate enzymatic machinery from that of nuclear DNA, mtDNA encodes only a subset of mitochondrial functions.

LABEL: cDNA
hasExactSynonym: complementary DNA
IAO_0000115: cDNA or complementary DNA is complementary in sequence to a particular messenger RNA (mRNA). It is synthesized from mRNA in a reverse transcription reaction by reverse transcriptase enzyme. cDNA can be cloned in a vector and introduced into cells to bring about the expression of that particular gene in those cells.

LABEL: response to trauma exposure
hasExactSynonym: post traumatic response|post-traumatic response|response to trauma|response to traumatic event
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of exposure to traumatic events.

LABEL: lateral ventricle volume measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the volume of the lateral ventricle, the largest cavity of the ventricular system of the human brain which contains cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

LABEL: atypical ductal hyperplasia
hasExactSynonym: DIN 1B|atypical breast ductal hyperplasia|atypical ductal breast hyperplasia|atypical ductal hyperplasia|atypical ductal hyperplasia of breast|atypical ductal hyperplasia of the breast|ductal intraepithelial neoplasia, Grade 1B
IAO_0000115: Atypical ductal hyperplasia is an atypical proliferative lesion that falls in between the continuum from normal hyperplasia to low grade ductal carcinoma in situ.

LABEL: breast hyperplasia
IAO_0000115: Breast hyperplasia refers to hyperplastic proliferations of the epithelial cells in the breast parenchyma.

LABEL: cerebral small vessel disease
hasExactSynonym: small vessel cerebrovascular disease
IAO_0000115: Cerebral small vessel disease is the term currently used to pathological processes that affect the brain parenchymal circulation (arterioles, capillaries, and veins). It is a major contributor to stroke, and a leading cause of cognitive impairment and dementia.

LABEL: Chikungunya encephalitis
hasExactSynonym: Chikungunya associated encephalitis
IAO_0000115: A viral infectious disease that results in inflammation of the brain caused by Chikungunya virus. The disease is usually manifested as fever, arthralgia and rash.

LABEL: chronic hepatitis
IAO_0000115: An active inflammatory process affecting the liver for more than six months. Causes include viral infections, autoimmune disorders, drugs, and metabolic disorders.

LABEL: chronic lung allograft dysfunction
IAO_0000115: Chronic lung allograft dysfunction encompasses a range of pathologies that cause a transplanted lung to not achieve or maintain normal function. It manifests as airflow restriction and/or obstruction and is predominantly a result of chronic rejection.

LABEL: ductal breast hyperplasia
hasExactSynonym: breast epithelial hyperplasia|ductal hyperplasia of breast|ductal hyperplasia of the breast|epithelial hyperplasia of breast|epithelial hyperplasia of the breast
IAO_0000115: Hyperplasia of the epithelial cells in the breast ducts. It includes the atypical ductal hyperplasia, papillary intraductal hyperplasia, intraductal myoepitheliosis, and ductal hyperplasia of the usual type.

LABEL: dysplasia
hasExactSynonym: dyscrasia|dysplasia|dysplastic
IAO_0000115: A usually neoplastic transformation of the cell, associated with altered architectural tissue patterns. The cellular changes include nuclear and cytoplasmic abnormalities. Molecular genetic abnormalities are also often found and, in some instances, may lead to cancer.

LABEL: gastric non-cardia carcinoma
hasExactSynonym: non-cardia gastric carcinoma|noncardia gastric carcinoma
IAO_0000115: Non-cardia gastric carcinoma is a gastric carcinoma arising from distal regions of the stomach.

LABEL: hepatitis B virus induced hepatocellular carcinoma
hasExactSynonym: hepatitis B virus related hepatocellular carcinoma|hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma
IAO_0000115: A hepatocellular carcinoma that develops following hepatitis B virus exposure and injury of the liver parenchyma.

LABEL: hepatitis C virus induced hepatocellular carcinoma
hasExactSynonym: hepatitis C virus related hepatocellular carcinoma|hepatitis C virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma
IAO_0000115: A hepatocellular carcinoma that develops following hepatitis C virus exposure and injury of the liver parenchyma.

LABEL: hepatitis virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma
hasExactSynonym: hepatitis virus-related hepatocellular cancer
IAO_0000115: A hepatocellular carcinoma that develops following hepatitis virus exposure and injury of the liver parenchyma.

LABEL: metopic craniosynostosis
hasExactSynonym: interfrontal craniofaciosynostosis|metopic synostosis
IAO_0000115: Metopic craniosynostosis is the early fusion of the forehead (frontal) bones. It accounts for 5%?15% of all craniosynostosis cases. This premature fusion of the frontal bones results in a characteristically altered skull shape, termed trigonocephaly, that usually requires surgical correction.

LABEL: micropapillary urothelial carcinoma
hasExactSynonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, micropapillary variant|micropapillary variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
IAO_0000115: An infiltrating bladder transitional cell carcinoma exhibiting micropapillary growth pattern. -- 2003

LABEL: morphologic finding
IAO_0000115: A light microscopic finding that describes the cellular characteristics and architectural patterns of cell populations in a tissue sample.

LABEL: oral lichen planus
hasExactSynonym: OLP
IAO_0000115: Oral lichen planus is a chronic inflammatory oral condition of unknown aetiology characterized by T-cell-mediated chronic immune response and abnormal epithelial keratinization cycle.

LABEL: sessile serrated polyp
hasExactSynonym: serrated adenoma type I|serrated polyp with abnormal proliferation|sessile serrated adenoma/polyp|sessile serrated polyp/adenoma
IAO_0000115: A sessile serrated polyp is a serrated polyp that demonstrates abnormal cellular proliferation characterized by a proximally displaced proliferative zone, epithelial serrations, and characteristic distorted basilar crypt architecture with crypt dilation, branching, and lateral growth along the muscularis mucosa.

LABEL: status epilepticus
IAO_0000115: Status epilepticus is defined as a continuous seizure lasting more than 30 min, or two or more seizures without full recovery of consciousness between any of them.

LABEL: steatosis
hasExactSynonym: fatty change
IAO_0000115: Increased lipid within the cytoplasm of cells.

LABEL: kynurenine measurement
hasExactSynonym: KYN
IAO_0000115: Quatification of plasma levels of kynurenine, a ketone that is alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-aminobenzoyl group.

LABEL: kynurenine:tryptophan ratio
hasExactSynonym: KYN:TRP
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the ration of kynurenine to tryptophan in plasma.

LABEL: GLP-1-stimulated insulin response
hasExactSynonym: glucagon-like-peptide-1-stimulated insulin response
IAO_0000115: Quantification of insulin release in response to stimulation with GLP-1, typically measured under hyperglycemic clamp.

LABEL: clinically amyopathic dermatomyositis
hasExactSynonym: CADM
IAO_0000115: Subset of dermatomyositis that lacks distinct muscle features and often manifests rapidly progressive interstitial pneumonia (RPIP).

LABEL: tryptophan measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the levels of tryptophan in a sample, typically cerebrospinal fluid or blood

LABEL: post-traumatic stress disorder symptom measurement
hasExactSynonym: PTSD symptom measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the severity of post-traumatic stress disorder symptoms, typically quantified as the sum score of items of a diagnostic instrument such as the Semi-Structured Assessment for the Genetics of Alcoholism

LABEL: anti-centromere-antibody-positive systemic scleroderma
hasExactSynonym: ACA-positive systemic scleroderma|ACA-positive systemic sclerosis|anti-centromere-antibody-positive systemic sclerosis
IAO_0000115: A sub-type of systemic scleroderma characterised by the presence of antibodies to centromere proteins

LABEL: anti-topoisomerase-I-antibody-positive systemic scleroderma
hasExactSynonym: ATA-positive systemic scleroderma|ATA-positive systemic sclerosis|anti-topoisomerase-1-antibody-positive systemic scleroderma|anti-topoisomerase-1-antibody-positive systemic sclerosis|anti-topoisomerase-I-antibody-positive systemic sclerosis
IAO_0000115: A sub-type of systemic scleroderma characterised by the presence of antibodies to topoisomerase-1 protein

LABEL: vitamin D dietary intake measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of dietary vitamin D intake.

LABEL: helping behaviour
IAO_0000115: Some aspect of helping behavior, for example helping others without being paid.  Helping behavior is an example of prosocial behavior.

LABEL: response to opioid
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an opioid stimulus. Opioids include opiates, an older term that refers to such drugs derived from opium, including morphine itself. Other opioids are semi-synthetic and synthetic drugs such as hydrocodone, oxycodone and fentanyl; antagonist drugs such as naloxone; and endogenous peptides such as the endorphins.

LABEL: complement C3d subcomponent measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of complement C3d subcomponent in a blood sample.

LABEL: c3d:C3 ratio
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the ratio of complement C3d to C3 in a blood sample. This measure is a biomarker for systemic complement activation.

LABEL: analgesia requirement measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of analgesic drug required during a painful procedure such as surgery.

LABEL: femur fracture
hasExactSynonym: Fracture of Femur
IAO_0000115: A traumatic or pathologic injury to the femur in which the continuity of the femur is broken. [ NCI ]

LABEL: Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus Pneumonia
hasExactSynonym: MRSA Pneumonia|Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus Pneumonia|Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Pneumonia
IAO_0000115: Pneumonia that is caused by Staphylococcus aureus and is resistant to methicillin treatment. [ NCI ]

LABEL: Methicillin-Susceptible Staphylococcus Aureus Infection
hasExactSynonym: MSSA|MSSA bacteremia|MSSA bacteremias|MSSA infection|Methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus (MSSA) infection|infection by MSSA|methicillin-susceptible S. aureus (MSSA) infection|methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus (MSSA) bacteremia
IAO_0000115: A bacterial infection that is caused by Staphylococcus aureus and can be treated by methicillin class antibiotics.

LABEL: Vancomycin-Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus Infection
hasExactSynonym: VRSA|VRSA bacteremia|VRSA bacteremias|VRSA infection|Vancomycin-Resistant S. Aureus (VRSA) infection|Vancomycin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus (VRSA) bacteremia|Vancomycin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus (VRSA) infection|infection by VRSA|slow-intermediate vancomycin-resistant S. aureus (sVISA)|vancomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (VRSA)
IAO_0000115: A bacterial infection that is caused by Staphylococcus aureus and is resistant to vancomycin treatment.

LABEL: American trypanosomiasis
hasExactSynonym: Chagas disease|Chagas' Disease|South American trypanosomiasis|Trypanosoma cruzi Infection|human American trypanosomiasis
IAO_0000115: A parasitic infection caused by Trypanosoma cruzi. It is transmitted by insect bites. It is characterized by an acute and chronic phase; in the acute phase patients may have fever, malaise, and swelling at the site of the insect bite. In the chronic phase patients develop hepatosplenomegaly, lymphadenopathy, cardiomyopathy and arrhythmias. [ NCI ]

LABEL: diaphragmatic hernia
IAO_0000115: A congenital or acquired weakness or opening in the diaphragm which allows abdominal contents to protrude into the chest cavity; congenital diaphragmatic hernias are caused when the embryonic diaphragm fails to fuse. [ NCI ]

LABEL: postpartum
IAO_0000115: The period of time immediately after labor and delivery.

LABEL: Illumina HiSeq 4000
IAO_0000115: The Illumina HiSeq 4000 is a high-throughput sequencing machine developed by Illumina.

LABEL: Illumina HiSeq 3000
IAO_0000115: The Illumina HiSeq 3000 is a high-throughput sequencing machine developed by Illumina.

LABEL: Illumina HiSeq 2500
IAO_0000115: The Illumina HiSeq 2500 is a sequencing machine developed by Illumina.

LABEL: Illumina NextSeq 550

IAO_0000115: A multiple congenital anomaly syndrome with delayed psychomotor development with intellectual disability, short stature, obesity, variable dysmorphic facial features (round face, proptosis, hypertelorism, thick eyebrows and hair, long eyelashes, short nose and downturned corners of the mouth), heart defects, increased chance of chronic lung disease, skeletal defects such as brachydactyly, gastroesophageal reflux.

LABEL: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 21
hasExactSynonym: COXPD21
IAO_0000115: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 21 is a rare mitochondrial disease characterized by axial hypotonia with limb hypertonia, developmental delay, hyperlactatemia, central nervous system anomalies visible on magnetic resonance imaging (e.g. corpus callosum hypoplasia, lesions of the globus pallidus) and multiple deficiency of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes in muscle tissue, but not in fibroblasts or liver.

LABEL: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 23
hasExactSynonym: COXPD23
IAO_0000115: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 23 is an autosomal recessive disorder characterized by early childhood onset of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and/or neurologic symptoms, including hypotonia and delayed psychomotor development. Laboratory investigations are consistent with a defect in mitochondrial function resulting in lactic acidosis, impaired activities of respiratory complexes I and IV, and defective translation of mitochondrial proteins. Brain imaging shows abnormal lesions in the basal ganglia, thalamus, and brainstem. The severity of the disorder is variable, ranging from death in early infancy to survival into the second decade (summary by Kopajtich et al., 2014).

LABEL: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 24
hasExactSynonym: COXPD24
IAO_0000115: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 24 is an autosomal recessive mitochondrial disorder with wide phenotypic variability. Some patients have a milder form affecting only skeletal muscle, whereas others may have a more severe infantile-onset neurodegenerative disorder (Vanlander et al., 2015; Sofou et al., 2015).

LABEL: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 26
hasExactSynonym: COXPD26
IAO_0000115: A highly variable phenotype resulting from a defect in mitochondrial respiratory chain activity.

LABEL: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 27
hasExactSynonym: COXPD27
IAO_0000115: A combined mitochondrial respiratory chain deficiency associated with epileptic encephalopathy and a complex movement disorder.

LABEL: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 30
hasExactSynonym: COXPD30
IAO_0000115: A fatal systemic mitochondrial disease.

LABEL: Cranio-cervical dystonia with laryngeal and upper-limb involvement
hasExactSynonym: DYT24|Dystonia 24
IAO_0000115: An autosomal dominant form of focal dystonia affecting the neck, laryngeal muscles, and muscles of the upper limbs.

LABEL: Estrogen resistance syndrome
IAO_0000115: Estrogen resistance syndrome is a rare, genetic endocrine disease characterized by estrogen-receptor insensitivity to estrogens and the presence of elevated estrogen and gonadotropin serum levels. Clinical manifestations include absent breast development and primary amenorrhea in association with multicystic ovaries and/or hypoplastic uterus in female patients, normal or abnormal gonadal development in male patients and markedly delayed bone maturation, persistence of open epiphyses, reduced bone mineral density, and variable tall stature in both sexes. Glucose intolerance, hyperinsulinemia and lipid abnormalities may also be present.

LABEL: Fanconi anemia complementation group A
hasExactSynonym: FA-H|FAA|FAH
IAO_0000115: Fanconi anemia complementation group A is a protein which in humans is encoded by the FANCA gene. It belongs to the Fanconi anaemia complementation group (FANC) family of genes of which 12 complementation groups are currently recognized and is hypothesised to operate as a post-replication repair or a cell cycle checkpoint. FANCA proteins are involved in inter-strand DNA cross-link repair and in the maintenance of normal chromosome stability that regulates the differentiation of haematopoietic stem cells into mature blood cells.

LABEL: Fanconi anemia complementation group F
hasExactSynonym: FAF
IAO_0000115: Fanconi anemia complementation group F is a protein encoded by the FANCF gene in humans.

LABEL: Fanconi anemia complementation group G
hasExactSynonym: DNA repair protein XRCC9|FAG|X-ray repair complementing defective repair in Chinese hamster cells 9|X-ray repair, complementing defective, in Chinese hamster, 9
IAO_0000115: Fanconi anemia complementation group G is a protein encoded by the FANCG gene in humans.

LABEL: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy
hasExactSynonym: Gravidic intrahepatic cholestasis|Pregnancy-related cholestasis|Recurrent intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy
IAO_0000115: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) is a cholestatic disorder characterized by (i) pruritus with onset in the second or third trimester of pregnancy, (ii) elevated serum aminotransferases and bile acid levels, and (iii) spontaneous relief of signs and symptoms within two to three weeks after delivery.

LABEL: Macrocephaly-intellectual disability-neurodevelopmental disorder-small thorax syndrome
hasExactSynonym: MINDS syndrome|Smith-Kingsmore syndrome
IAO_0000115: A rare autosomal dominant syndromic intellectual disability syndrome characterized by macrocephaly, seizures, umbilical hernia, and facial dysmorphic features including frontal bossing, midface hypoplasia, small chin, hypertelorism with downslanting palpebral fissures, depressed nasal bridge, smooth philtrum, and thin upper lip (Smith et al., 2013; Baynam et al., 2015).

LABEL: Non-immune hydrops fetalis
hasExactSynonym: NIHF|Non-immune HF|Non-immune fetal edema|Non-immune fetal hydrops
IAO_0000115: A type of hydrops fetalis in which there is no identifiable circulating antibody to red blood cell antigens .

LABEL: Pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease
hasExactSynonym: PAH associated with congenital heart disease|congenital heart disease-associated PAH
IAO_0000115: Pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease (PAH-CHD) is a form of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, see this term), characterized by elevated pulmonary arterial resistance leading to right heart failure occurring as a common complication of congenital heart malformations (see this term) with left to right cardiac shunts. Eisenmenger syndrome (see this term) is the most advanced form of PAH-CHD and is defined as the complete or partial reversal of an initial left-to-right shunt to a right-to-left shunt, causing cyanosis and limited exercise capacity. PAH-CHD also includes mild to moderate systemic-to-pulmonary shunts with no cyanosis at rest, patients with small defects, and those with residual PAH following corrective cardiac surgery.

LABEL: RIDDLE syndrome
hasExactSynonym: RNF168 deficiency|Radiosensitivity-immunodeficiency-dysmorphic features-learning difficulties syndrome
IAO_0000115: A syndrome of increased radiosensitivity, immunodeficiency, mild motor control and learning difficulties, facial dysmorphism, and short stature.

LABEL: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 38
hasExactSynonym: SCA38
IAO_0000115: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 38 (SCA38) is a subtype of autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia type 3 characterized by the adult-onset (average age: 40 years) of truncal ataxia, gait disturbance and gaze-evoked nystagmus. The disease is slowly progressive with dysarthria and limb ataxia following. Additional manifestations include diplopia and axonal neuropathy.

LABEL: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 40
hasExactSynonym: SCA40|spinocerebellar ataxia 40
IAO_0000115: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 40 (SCA40) is a very rare subtype of autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia type 1, characterized by the adult-onset of unsteady gait and dysarthria, followed by wide-based gait, gait ataxia, ocular dysmetria, intention tremor, scanning speech, hyperreflexia and dysdiadochokinesis.

LABEL: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 41
hasExactSynonym: SCA41
IAO_0000115: Spinocerebellar ataxia is characterized by progressive imbalance and gait ataxia with mild atrophy of the cerebellar vermis.

LABEL: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 43
hasExactSynonym: SCA43
IAO_0000115: Spinocerebellar ataxia-43 is an autosomal dominant, slowly progressive neurologic disorder characterized by adult-onset gait and limb ataxia and often associated with peripheral neuropathy mainly affecting the motor system, although some patients may have distal sensory impairment (summary by Depondt et al., 2016).

LABEL: TELO2-related intellectual disability-neurodevelopmental disorder
hasExactSynonym: You-Hoover-Fong syndrome
IAO_0000115: Disorder characterized by severely delayed global development, microcephaly, abnormal balance and movement.

LABEL: Temple-Baraitser syndrome
hasExactSynonym: Severe intellectual disability-aplasia/hypoplasia of thumb and hallux syndrome|TMBTS
IAO_0000115: Temple-Baraitser syndrome is a rare developmental anomalies syndrome characterized by severe intellectual disability and distal hypoplasia of digits, particularly of thumbs and halluces, with nail aplasia or hypoplasia. Facial dysmorphism with a pseudo-myopathic appearance has been reported, which may include high anterior hairline or low frontal hairline with central cowlick, flat forehead, ptosis, hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, epicanthal folds, ears with thick helices, broad depressed nasal bridge with anteverted nares, short columella, long philtrum, high-arched palate, broad mouth with thick vermilion border of the upper or the lower lip and downturned corners. Marked hypotonia, seizures and global developmental delay have been reported, associated with autistic spectrum disorder manifestations in some patients.

LABEL: Wolfram-like syndrome
IAO_0000115: Wolfram-like syndrome is a rare endocrine disease characterized by the triad of adult-onset diabetes mellitus, progressive hearing loss (usually presenting in the first decade of life and principally of low to moderate frequencies), and/or juvenile-onset optic atrophy. Psychiatric (i.e. anxiety, depression, hallucinations) and sleep disorders, the only neurologic abnormalities observed in this disease, have been reported in rare cases. Unlike Wolfram syndrome, patients with Wolfram-like syndrome do not report endocrine or cardiac findings.

LABEL: calcium oxalate urolithiasis
IAO_0000115: Urolithiasis in which the composition of the stones is predominantly calcium oxalate.

LABEL: clcn4-related disorder
IAO_0000115: X-linked intellectual disability and epilepsy associated with variants in the CLCN4 gene.

LABEL: combined partial 17-alpha-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency
hasExactSynonym: 17-Alpha-Hydroxylase/17,20 Lyase Deficiency
IAO_0000115: Decreased or absent activity of the enzyme 17-alpha-hydroxylase/17,20 lyase due to loss-of-function mutation(s) in the CYP17A1 gene. The clinical manifestations of the deficiency are dependent on whether one or both activities of the enzyme are affected, and may include hypertension due to reduced 17-hydroxylase activity and incomplete genital masculinization in 46,XY infants due to reduced 17,20 lyase activity. [

LABEL: hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase deficiency
IAO_0000115: A metabolic disorder usually inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern and caused by mutations in the MAT1A gene. Affected individuals usually do not have clinical abnormalities.

LABEL: intellectual developmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and ptosis
IAO_0000115: Intellectual developmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and ptosis is an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by delayed psychomotor development, intellectual disability, delayed language, and dysmorphic facial features, most notably ptosis/blepharophimosis. Additional features may include poor growth, hypotonia, and seizures (summary by Mattioli et al., 2017).

LABEL: mbd5 associated neurodevelopmental disorder
IAO_0000115: Neurodevelopmental disorder associated with the MBD5 gene.

LABEL: methylmalonic aciduria (cobalamin deficiency) cblA type
hasExactSynonym: cblA
IAO_0000115: An autosomal recessive form of methylmalonic aciduria, caused by mutation(s) in the MMAA gene, encoding MMAA protein.

LABEL: methylmalonic aciduria cblb type
hasExactSynonym: Methylmalonic Aciduria, cblB Type
IAO_0000115: An autosomal recessive form of methylmalonic aciduria, caused by mutation(s) in the MMAB gene, encoding cob(I)yrinic acid a,c-diamide adenosyltransferase, mitochondrial.

LABEL: neuropathy, hereditary motor and sensory, type vib
IAO_0000115: Hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy type VIB is an autosomal recessive complex progressive neurologic disorder characterized mainly by early-onset optic atrophy resulting in progressive visual loss and peripheral axonal sensorimotor neuropathy with highly variable age at onset and severity. Affected individuals also have cerebellar or pontocerebellar atrophy on brain imaging, and they may show abnormal movements, such as ataxia, dysmetria, and myoclonus. The most severely affected patients are hypotonic at birth and die in infancy (summary by Abrams et al., 2015 and Wan et al., 2016).

LABEL: nonsyndromic deafness
hasExactSynonym: nonsyndromic hearing loss|nonsyndromic hereditary hearing loss
IAO_0000115: An auditory system disease that is associated with permanent hearing loss caused by damage to structures in the inner ear and/or the middle ear, which is not associated with other signs and symptoms.

LABEL: premature chromatid separation trait
IAO_0000115: Premature chromatid separation consists of separate and splayed chromatids with discernible centromeres and involves all or most chromosomes of a metaphase. It is found in up to 2% of metaphases in cultured lymphocytes from approximately 40% of normal individuals. When PCS is present in 5% or more of cells, it is known as the 'heterozygous PCS trait' and has no obvious phenotypic effect, although some have reported decreased fertility (Gabarron et al., 1986). Inheritance is autosomal codominant (Kajii and Ikeuchi, 2004).

LABEL: stag1-related disorder
IAO_0000115: Disorder associated with the STAG1 gene.

LABEL: white-sutton syndrome
hasExactSynonym: MRD37|WHSUS|autosomal dominant intellectual disability 37
IAO_0000115: An autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability that has_material_basis_in an autosomal dominant mutation of POGZ on chromosome 1q21.3.

LABEL: x-linked ichthyosis with steryl-sulfatase deficiency
IAO_0000115: X-linked ichthyosis is clinically characterized by widespread, dark brown, polygonal scales and generalized dryness. Cutaneous manifestations are present soon after birth and usually do not improve with age. The histopathology of XLI typically shows compact hyperkeratosis and slight acanthosis with a normal granular layer (summary by Takeichi and Akiyama, 2016).

LABEL: Heterotaxia
hasExactSynonym: Heterotaxy syndrome|Lateralization defect|Visceral heterotaxy
IAO_0000115: Heterotaxia (coming from the Greek 'heteros' meaning different and 'taxis' meaning arrangement) is the right/left transposition of thoracic and/or abdominal organs. It encompasses a wide variety of disorders since there are multiple possibilities of right/left reversals, which may be complete (situs inversus totalis or situs inversus i.e. all the organs normally found on the right are on the left and vice versa) or partial (incomplete situs inversus i.e. a limited number of organs are inversed - or situs inversus ambiguous i.e. a normally lateral organ is centrally located).

LABEL: absent or delayed speech development
IAO_0000115: Speech development, referring to the process of making sounds, that is absent or significantly behind developmental milestones.

LABEL: Endarteritis
IAO_0000115: Inflammation of the arterial intima. [ NCI ]

LABEL: arterial occlusive disease
hasExactSynonym: Arterial Insufficiency|occlusive arterial disease
IAO_0000115: Pathological processes which result in the partial or complete obstruction of ARTERIES. They are characterized by greatly reduced or absence of blood flow through these vessels. They are also known as arterial insufficiency. [ MeSH ]

LABEL: arteriosclerosis
hasExactSynonym: Arterial Sclerosis|Vascular Sclerosis
IAO_0000115: A vascular disorder characterized by thickening and hardening of the walls of the arteries. [ NCI ]

LABEL: non-typhoidal Salmonella bacteremia
hasExactSynonym: non-typhoidal Salmonella bacteraemia|nontyphoidal Salmonella bacteraemia|nontyphoidal Salmonella bacteremia
IAO_0000115: The presence of Salmonella bacteria (of the non-typhoidal type) in the blood.

IAO_0000115: Describes the procedure by which a biological specimen is dissociated into individual cells or a cell suspension

LABEL: enrichment protocol
IAO_0000115: Describes the procedure by which the concentration of an entity of interest in a sample is increased.

LABEL: enrichment process
IAO_0000115: An experimental process which results in the increased concentration of an entity of interest.

LABEL: sample dissociation
IAO_0000115: process which results in the separation of a biological specimen into individual cells or a cell suspension

LABEL: choroidal melanoma
IAO_0000115: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the choroid. The classic appearance of choroidal melanoma is a pigmented dome-shaped or collar button-shaped tumor with an associated exudative retinal detachment. Choroidal melanoma is usually pigmented, but can be variably pigmented and even amelanotic (non-pigmented).

LABEL: idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy
IAO_0000115: Decreased function of the heart associated with cardiac enlargement and congestive heart failure, of unknown cause.

LABEL: psychological measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some aspect of human psychology.

LABEL: negative domain measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some aspect of psychological negative valence systems e.g. those responsible for responses to aversive situations or context, such as fear, anxiety and loss

LABEL: positive domain measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some aspect of psychological positive valence systems e.g. those responsible for responses to positive motivational situations or contexts, such as reward seeking, consummatory behavior, and reward/habit learning.  Based on the NIH NIMH's research domain criteria (RDoC).  https://www.nimh.nih.gov/research-priorities/rdoc/definitions-of-the-rdoc-domains-and-constructs.shtml

LABEL: cognitive domain measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some aspect of cognitive systems e.g. those responsible for various cognitive processes.  Based on the NIH NIMH's research domain criteria (RDoC).  https://www.nimh.nih.gov/research-priorities/rdoc/definitions-of-the-rdoc-domains-and-constructs.shtml

LABEL: arousal domain measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some aspect of psychological arousal/regulatory systems e.g. those responsible for generating activation of neural systems as appropriate for various contexts, and providing appropriate homeostatic regulation of such systems as energy balance and sleep.  Based on the NIH NIMH's research domain criteria (RDoC).  https://www.nimh.nih.gov/research-priorities/rdoc/definitions-of-the-rdoc-domains-and-constructs.shtml

LABEL: social domain measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of some aspect of psychological systems for social processes e.g. those that mediate responses in interpersonal settings of various types, including perception and interpretation of others? actions.  Based on the NIH NIMH's research domain criteria (RDoC).  https://www.nimh.nih.gov/research-priorities/rdoc/definitions-of-the-rdoc-domains-and-constructs.shtml

LABEL: age at first birth measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of the age at which a woman gave birth to her first live child

LABEL: number of children ever born measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of the number of children born

LABEL: theory of mind measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of theory of mind ability, defined as the ability to attribute mental states to one self and others and to use such mental state attribution to make sense of behaviour and predict it. Theory of mind can be quantified using the Emotional Triangles Task test ("Triangles task").

LABEL: hyperuricemia
IAO_0000115: An abnormally high level of uric acid.

LABEL: high altitude adaptation
IAO_0000115: Evolutionary modification in certain human populations who have acquired the ability to survive at extremely high altitudes. This adaptation means irreversible, long-term physiological responses to high-altitude environments, associated with heritable behavioural and genetic changes.

LABEL: sample enrichment
IAO_0000115: process which results in the increased concentration of an entity of interest, such as a particle or cell, in a sample

LABEL: fluorescence-activated cell sorting
hasExactSynonym: FAC sorting|FACS
IAO_0000115:
A flow cytometry assay that provides a method for sorting a heterogeneous mixture of biological cells into two or more containers, one cell at a time, based upon the specific light scattering and fluorescent characteristics of each cell.
The cells are suspended in a stream of fluid and forced individually through a vibrating nozzle, then exposed to a laser beam and the resulting fluorescence and scattered light is detected. Finally the cells are sorted by applying an electrical charge to droplets of the fluid and deflecting it to the left or right using charged electrodes.

LABEL: magnetic affinity cell sorting
hasExactSynonym: MAC sorting|MACS
IAO_0000115: A method of cell sorting that uses paramagnetic beads that are coated with antibodies, antigens, receptors, receptor substrates, binding proteins, etc to separate target cells from solution.

LABEL: Ficoll-Hypaque method
hasExactSynonym: Ficoll WBC Isolation|Ficoll gradient
IAO_0000115: A centrifugation procedure that utilizes a density-gradient medium to separate mononuclear and polymorphonuclear leukocytes from other formed elements in the blood.

LABEL: laser capture microdissection
hasExactSynonym: LCM|LMD|laser-assisted microdissection
IAO_0000115:
Laser capture microdissection is a technique used for isolating specific cells of interest from microscopic regions of tissue/cells/organisms.
It allows sampling of specific cells under direct microscopic visualization. A film is placed against the heterogeneous tissue and activated by a laser beam to capture only the cells of interest. Those cells are transferred to the film to provide a visual microscopic record of what was transferred, which can be analyzed for DNA, RNA, or protein. The film upon which the cells are transferred is incorporated into the cap of a vial so that, when the transfer is done under a routine microscopic visualization, the microdissected material can immediately be put into a vial for processing. The system is integrated into a microscope so that the cells are microdissected, transferred to the cap, and then rotated into a vial by a rotating arm in a hands-off operation. (from Cancer Genome Anatomy Project (CGAP) Update) [ NCI ]

LABEL: density gradient centrifugation
hasExactSynonym: cell separation by density gradient centrifugation|density gradient
IAO_0000115: A method of separating cells in a sample by either their differential rate of sedimentation in a centrifugal gradient or their differential buoyancy in a density gradient.

LABEL: alcohol exposure measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of alcohol exposure.

LABEL: in utero exposure measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of the exposure of a fetus to an agent while in the womb.

LABEL: tobacco smoke exposure measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of tobacco smoke exposure.

LABEL: vitamin supplement exposure measurement
hasExactSynonym: vitamin use exposure measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of the consumption of dietry vitamin supplements.

LABEL: female reproductive endometrioid cancer
hasExactSynonym: endometrioid neoplasm|endometrioid tumor (morphologic abnormality)
IAO_0000115: A benign, borderline, or malignant epithelial tumor of the female reproductive system characterized by the presence of glands and/or cysts lined by neoplastic cells that resemble endometrial cells.

LABEL: biopsy
IAO_0000115: The removal of tissue specimens or fluid from the living body for examination, for example by microscopy, performed to establish a diagnosis.

LABEL: blood draw
hasExactSynonym: blood harvesting|blood specimen collection
IAO_0000115: extraction of a blood specimen from an organism

LABEL: scraping
IAO_0000115: collection of a biological specimen by scraping epithelia with a sampling device such as a sterile scalpel

LABEL: urine collection
IAO_0000115: collection of a urine specimen from an organism

LABEL: organ extraction
hasExactSynonym: organ harvesting
IAO_0000115: collection of a whole organ from an organism

LABEL: bronchial brush biopsy
hasExactSynonym: bronchial brushing
IAO_0000115: The use of a brush to obtain tissue samples from one or more bronchi.

LABEL: leukapheresis
hasExactSynonym: leukocytopheresis|therapeutic leukopheresis
IAO_0000115: A procedure that collects white blood cells from the peripheral blood while returning the rest to the donor.

LABEL: enzymatic dissociation
IAO_0000115: dissociation process which uses enzymes to separate the cells in a specimen

LABEL: mechanical dissociation
IAO_0000115: dissociation process which uses mechanical forces to separate the cells in a specimen

LABEL: clostridium difficile infection
hasExactSynonym: CDI|clostridium difficile disease
IAO_0000115: Symptomatic infection due to the spore-forming bacterium clostridium difficile.

LABEL: response to polyunsaturated fatty acid supplementation
IAO_0000115: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a dietary polyunsaturated fatty acid supplement.

LABEL: cholesterol efflux capacity measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of cholesterol efflux capacity, a measure of HDL functionality that quantifies the ability of an individual?s HDL to extract cholesterol from cholesterol-loaded macrophages. Efflux capacity is considered to be a predictor of atherosclerotic burden.

LABEL: cholesteryl ester transfer protein measurement
hasExactSynonym: CETP|plasma lipid transfer protein measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the amount of cholestryl ester transfer protein in a sample, typically serum.

LABEL: trimethyllysine measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of trimethyllysine (N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysine) in the blood.

LABEL: leigh syndrome due to mitochondrial complex iv deficiency
IAO_0000115: Deficiency in the terminal enzyme of the respiratory chain, complex IV, causing the progressive neurodegenerative disorder, Leigh syndrome.

LABEL: heterotaxy, visceral, x-linked
IAO_0000115: X-linked, right/left transposition of thoracic and/or abdominal organs. This condition is caused by mutations in the ZIC3 gene, is inherited in an X-linked recessive fashion , and is usually seen in males. Physical features include heart abnormalities such as dextrocardia , transposition of great vessels , ventricular septal defect , patent ductus arteriosus , pulmonic stenosis ; situs inversus, and missing (asplenia) and/or extra spleens (polysplenia).Affected individualscan also experience abnormalities in the development of the midline of the body, which can cause holoprosencephaly , myelomeningocele , urological anomalies, widely spaced eyes (hypertelorism), cleft palate , and abnormalities of the sacral spine and anus. Heterotaxia with recurrent respiratory infections are called primary ciliary dyskinesia .

LABEL: renal hypodysplasia/aplasia 3
hasExactSynonym: RHDA3
IAO_0000115: Renal hypodysplasia/aplasia 3 (RHDA3) is an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by abnormal kidney development beginning in utero. The phenotype is highly variable, even within families, and there is evidence for incomplete penetrance. Some affected individuals have bilateral renal agenesis, which is usually fatal in utero or in the perinatal period, whereas others may have unilateral agenesis that is compatible with life, or milder manifestations, such as vesicoureteral reflux (VUR). Female mutation carriers may also have uterine or ovarian abnormalities. Renal aplasia falls at the most severe end of the spectrum of congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT; see 610805) (summary by Brophy et al., 2017 and Sanna-Cherchi et al., 2017).

LABEL: laminin alpha 2-related dystrophy
hasExactSynonym: LAMA2-related muscular dystrophy
IAO_0000115: Llaminin alpha 2-related dystrophy is a disorder that causes weakness and wasting (atrophy) of muscles used for movement (skeletal muscles). This condition generally appears in one of two ways: as a severe, early-onset type or a milder, late-onset form.

LABEL: glut1 deficiency syndrome 1, autosomal recessive
hasExactSynonym: glucose transport defect, blood-brain barrier
IAO_0000115: GLUT1 deficiency syndrome is a disorder affecting the nervous system that can have a variety of neurological signs and symptoms.

LABEL: metastatic pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours
IAO_0000115: Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors with metastases to other sites in the body, such as the liver.

LABEL: fgfr2 related craniosynostosis
hasExactSynonym: Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 2 related craniosynostosis
IAO_0000115: Craniosynostosis associated with FGFR2 (Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 2) gene.

LABEL: autosomal dominant dilated cardiomyopathy
IAO_0000115: Dilated cardiomyopathy, characterized by dilation and contractile dysfunction of the left and right ventricles, with an autosomal dominant pattern of inheritance.

LABEL: ryr1-related disorders
IAO_0000115: RYR-1-related diseases are conditions caused by changes (mutations) in the RYR-1 gene. RYR-1 mutations are typically associated with core myopathies and are the most common overall cause of congenital myopathy. [ https://rarediseases.org/rare-diseases/ryr-1-related-diseases/ ]

LABEL: Lethal neonatal spasticity-epileptic encephalopathy syndrome
hasExactSynonym: Lethal neonatal rigidity-multifocal seizure syndrome
IAO_0000115: An autosomal-recessive epileptic encephalopathy, which is characterized by drug-resistant seizures, and rigidity.

LABEL: limb-girdle muscular dystrophy-dystroglycanopathy, type c1
hasExactSynonym: MDDGC1|Muscular Dystrophy-Dystroglycanopathy (Limb-Girdle) Type C, 1
IAO_0000115: An autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy caused by mutations in the POMT1 gene, encoding protein O-mannosyl-transferase 1. It is characterized by intellectual disability without structural brain abnormalities and limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.

LABEL: pik3ca related overgrowth spectrum
hasExactSynonym: PROS
IAO_0000115: PIK3CA-related overgrowth spectrum (PROS) is a group of rare diseases associated with having parts of the body that grow too quickly (overgrowth). Specifically, people with these diseases have overgrowth of the brain and other parts of the body.

LABEL: partial adenosine deaminase deficiency
hasExactSynonym: partial ADA deficiency
IAO_0000115: Partial deficiency of the purine salvage enzyme adenosine deaminase.

LABEL: acth-independent macronodular adrenal hyperplasia 2
hasExactSynonym: AIMAH2|primary macronodular adrenal hyperplasia
IAO_0000115: ACTH-independent macronodular adrenal hyperplasia-2 is an autosomal dominant tumor susceptibility with syndromic incomplete penetrance, as a second hit to the ARMC5 gene is required to develop macronodular hyperplasia (Assie et al., 2013).

LABEL: muscular dystrophy, congenital, with cataracts and intellectual disability
hasExactSynonym: MDCCAID
IAO_0000115: A congenital muscular dystrophy characterized by onset of progressive muscle weakness in early childhood with autosomal recessive inheritance that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the INPP5K gene (607875) on chromosome 17p13. [ url:https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/28190459 ]

LABEL: cholestasis, intrahepatic, of pregnancy 3
hasExactSynonym: Cholestasis, Intrahepatic, of Pregnancy type 3
IAO_0000115: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy is a reversible form of cholestasis that occurs most often in the third trimester of pregnancy and recurs in 45 to 70% of subsequent pregnancies. Symptoms include pruritus, jaundice, increased serum bile salts, and abnormal liver enzymes, all of which resolve rapidly after delivery. However, the condition is associated with fetal complications, including placental insufficiency, premature labor, fetal distress, and intrauterine death. LABEL: epilepsy, hearing loss, and intellectual disability syndrome

Most affected individuals are nonambulatory, cannot sit unassisted, and have no speech development. More variable features include feeding difficulties, poor growth, cortical visual impairment, spasticity, scoliosis, immunodeficiency, and thrombocytopenia.

Therefore, RAG2 is essential for generation of mature B and T lymphocytes.

IAO_0000115: A hyperplasia due to proliferation and migration of vascular smooth muscle cells primarily in the tunica intima. It may develop after percutaneous coronary interventions such as stenting or angioplasty, and involves platelet aggregation at site of injury, recruitment of inflammatory cells, proliferation and migration of vascular smooth muscle cells, and collagen deposition, resulting in the thickening of arterial walls and decreased arterial lumen space. The term neointima is used because the cells in the hyperplastic regions of the vascular wall have histological characteristics of both intima and normal artery cells.

LABEL: post term pregnancy
hasExactSynonym: post-term pregnancy|postterm pregnancy|prolonged pregnancy
IAO_0000115: A gestation that lasts greater than or equal to 42 weeks and 0 days. [def-source: NCI][attr: NICHD]

LABEL: thiopurine metabolite measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the metabolites of thiopurine compounds.

LABEL: beta-lactam allergy measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of the presence or severity of an allergy to beta-lactam, including beta-lactam antibiotics.

LABEL: household income

LABEL: social deprivation

LABEL: pathological complete response

LABEL: visceral:total adipose tissue ratio
IAO_0000115: Quantification of visceral to total adipose tissue.

IAO_0000115: Quantification of the variability in reaction time (the interval of time between the presentation of a stimulus to a subject and the beginning of the subject's response to that stimulus) of an individual, over successive tasks. LABEL: radiation-induced brain injury
IAO_0000115: An injury to the brain which results results from exposure to radiation.

LABEL: small intestine enteropathy
hasExactSynonym: small bowel enteropathy

LABEL: latent autoimmune diabetes in adults
hasExactSynonym: LADA
IAO_0000115: Latent autoimmune diabetes in adults (LADA) is a form of diabetes mellitus type 1 that occurs in adulthood, often with a slower course of onset than type 1 diabetes diagnosed in juveniles.

LABEL: fractures, ununited
hasExactSynonym: Nonunion

LABEL: surgical resection

IAO_0000115: Any change in the state of an organism as a result of a ketamine stimulus. Ketamine is a selective antagonist of the NMDA receptor, used primarily in anaesthesia, sedation and pain management.

LABEL: age at first sexual intercourse measurement
IAO_0000115: A measurement of the age at which a person has the first sexual intercourse.

LABEL: dissociation measurement
hasExactSynonym: dissociative symptom measurement
IAO_0000115: Quantification of some aspect of the psychological experience of dissociation. Dissociation in community samples is most commonly measured by the Dissociative Experiences Scale. The DSM-IV considers symptoms such as depersonalization, derealization and psychogenic amnesia to be core features of dissociative disorders. However, in the normal population, dissociative experiences that are not clinically significant are highly prevalent with 60% to 65% of the respondents indicating that they have had some dissociative experiences. The SCID-D is a structured interview used to assess and diagnose dissociation.

IAO_0000115: Quantification of assymetry of the face.

IAO_0000115: Impairment of visuospatial functioning.

LABEL: non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy

LABEL: central serous retinopathy
hasExactSynonym: central serous chorioretinopathy

The direct component is due to transmission of a pressure wave from the left ventricle to the finger via the most direct route. The reflected component is formed by pressure transmitted from the heart to the lower body where it is reflected back up the aorta and thence to the finger. If 'b' is the height of direct wave peak and 'a' is the height of reflected wave peak, the reflected index = (a/b) * 100%.

LABEL: whole body water mass
IAO_0000115: The weight of an individual's body water, i.e. the water content of a body that is contained in the tissues, the blood, the bones and elsewhere. The percentages of body water contained in various fluid compartments add up to total body water (TBW).

LABEL: total hip arthroplasty
hasExactSynonym: Hip Prosthesis Implantation|Hip Replacement|Hip Replacement Arthroplasty|Total Hip Replacement

LABEL: ligation-free chromosome conformation capture assay
IAO_0000115: Chromosome conformation capture assays that assay the 3-dimensional organization and interaction of chromatin without a proximity ligation step.

IAO_0000115: 2-stage repli-seq is a type of repli-seq assay that compares nascent DNA sequencing profiles between two stages, early and late replicating DNA.

LABEL: multi-stage Repli-seq
IAO_0000115: Multi-stage repli-seq is a type of repli-seq assay that compares nascent DNA sequencing profiles of many different replication time points.

LABEL: TSA-seq
IAO_0000115: TSA-seq is an assay that uses tyramide signal amplification (TSA) to assess distance of DNA regions to a targeted nuclear compartment or protein, typically on a scale of 100-1000 nm.

LABEL: NAD-seq
IAO_0000115: NAD-seq is an assay in which nucleoli are isolated and the DNA associated with them is sequenced to identify nucleoli-associating domains.

LABEL: CUT&RUN
IAO_0000115: CUT&RUN stands for cleavage under targets and release using nuclease and is a method for assessing DNA-protein interactions. It involves incubating samples with an antibody against a specific target, typically a transcription factor or a chromatin modification or regulator. Next protein A-conjugated micrococcal nuclease is added to cleave DNA on either side of the target. The remaining protein-DNA complexes are isolated and high-throughput sequencing is performed on the DNA. The experimental purpose is similar to ChIP-seq but has been observed to result in lower background.

LABEL: in situ HiC
IAO_0000115: A version of the Hi-C assay in which nuclei are not disrupted prior to the ligation step but instead digestion and ligation of DNA fragments is performed in intact nuclei.

LABEL: dilution HiC
IAO_0000115: A Hi-C assay in which cells and their nuclei are lysed during the digestion step, and the solution is then diluted many fold to limit the possibility of two non-crosslinked DNA fragments being ligated by chance.

LABEL: DNase Hi-C
IAO_0000115: DNase Hi-C is a Hi-C assay in which DNase I is used for digesting DNA fragments rather than a restriction enzyme, which can result in a higher resolution of mapped chromosome contacts.

LABEL: sci-Hi-C
IAO_0000115: sci-Hi-C stands for single-cell combinatorial indexed Hi-C, and is a Hi-C assay performed on massively multiplexed single-cell samples.

LABEL: sn-Hi-C
IAO_0000115: sn-Hi-C stands for single nucleus Hi-C and is a Hi-C assay performed on isolated nuclei.

LABEL: single cell Hi-C
IAO_0000115: A single cell Hi-C assay.

LABEL: MC-Hi-C
hasExactSynonym: MC-3C
IAO_0000115: A multi-contact chromosome conformation capture assay in which DNA is not sheared after proximity ligation so that long read sequencing can be performed on reads with multiple ligated fragments.

LABEL: PLAC-seq

This results in a Hi-C library enriched for a specific DNA-protein interaction. This procedure differs from ChIA-PET in that the proximity ligation step is performed prior to chromatin shearing and immunoprecipitation.

LABEL: Trac-Loop
IAO_0000115: Trac-loop (transposase-mediated analysis of chromatin looping) is an assay designed to detect interacting genomic regions. Rather than the traditional Hi-C approach of digestion and proximity ligation, the procedure involves transposase-mediated insertion of an oligonucleotide linker between the pair of interacting regions.

LABEL: MC-4C
IAO_0000115: MC-4C is a multi-contact 4C experiment. After proximity ligation and target region amplification, multiple DNA fragments may be ligated together, and rather than shearing into smaller pieces for short read library preparation, the DNA is isolated and long read sequencing is performed.

LABEL: SPRITE
IAO_0000115: SPRITE (split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension) is an assay designed to detect multi-way interactions between nucleic acids. The procedure involves crosslinking nuclei, and then splitting the lysate among wells in a 96-well or other multi-well plate. A different barcode is ligated to the fragments in each well, and the lysates are pooled together again. This sequence of splitting, tagging, and re-combining is repeated several times so that fragments with the same sequences of barcodes represent fragments that have co-associated throughout the experiment. Finally, a sequencing library is constructed and high-throughput sequencing is performed.

LABEL: DNA SPRITE
IAO_0000115: DNA SPRITE is a SPRITE experiment that only assays interactions between regions of genomic DNA.

LABEL: RNA-DNA SPRITE
IAO_0000115: RNA-DNA SPRITE is a type of SPRITE experiment in which RNA in the cross-linked complexes is converted to cDNA before the initial splitting step, allowing analysis of RNA-DNA interactions.

LABEL: GAM
IAO_0000115: Genome architecture mapping (GAM) is an assay designed to analyze 3D chromatin structure without relying on digestion and ligation. The procedure involves cryosectioning samples in random orientation, and then single nuclear profiles are isolated by laser microdissection. Each nuclear profile then undergoes high-throughput sequencing, and subsequent analysis can generate a matrix of inferred proximity between genomic regions.

LABEL: MARGI
IAO_0000115: MARGI is a method for probing RNA-DNA interactions in the nucleus. Nuclei are crosslinked, and RNA fragments are ligated to proximal DNA fragments via a special linker molecule. After reverse transcription, high-throughput sequencing is performed.

LABEL: long read sequencer
IAO_0000115: A sequencing instrument which supports the sequencing of single DNA molecules that are considerably longer than those resulting from traditional short-read sequencing.

LABEL: Fluidigm C1 microfluidics platform
IAO_0000115: The Fluidigm C1 is a microfluidic platform for single-cell RNA-Seq and DNA-Seq library preparation. Cell suspensions are added to the integrated fluidic circuit which shuttles individual cells into microfluidic chambers which are flooded with reagents in order to carry out library construction in very small volumes.

LABEL: Nuc-Seq
IAO_0000115: Nuc-Seq is an RNA sequencing technique optimized for isolating and sequencing nuclear RNA from frozen tissue samples

LABEL: Bubble-Seq
IAO_0000115: Bubble-Seq prepares libraries of restriction fragments that contain replication initiation sites (bubbles) in vivo
